66405.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的組織球細胞質呈細泡沫狀，內含許多大小一致、約 2–4 µm 的小圓形體，各有淡色透明暈；在骨髓切片中看到組織球內塞滿小酵母樣顆粒，應想到組織漿菌感染，並以 GMS/PAS 染色證實。
features: Histiocytes (arrows) with expanded, finely bubbly cytoplasm containing numerous small round 2-4 um bodies with pale halos
Organisms are uniform in size and confined to histiocyte cytoplasm; individual yeast detail is subtle on H&E
Surrounding hematopoietic marrow with erythroid precursors, myeloid cells, and plasma cells
Dilated sinusoids and adipocyte spaces with focal interstitial edema/proteinaceous material
No well-formed granulomas or necrosis evident in this field
66405.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows cellular marrow with erythroid and myeloid precursors, scattered plasma cells, dilated sinusoids, and adipocyte spaces. Scattered histiocytes (arrows) have expanded, finely bubbly cytoplasm containing numerous uniform, small round bodies measuring approximately 2-4 um with pale surrounding halos. Well-formed granulomas and necrosis are not seen in this field. Because intracellular organisms are subtle on H&E, confirmation with GMS or PAS stains and culture or antigen testing is recommended. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by disseminated histoplasmosis.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a kinetoplast on Giemsa and are GMS-negative, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are GMS/PAS-positive.
Talaromyces forms elongated sausage-shaped yeasts with transverse septa on GMS rather than uniform oval budding yeasts.
Storage cells show striated or uniformly foamy cytoplasm without discrete haloed organisms, and special stains for fungi are negative.
MAC-laden histiocytes have striated, pseudo-Gaucher cytoplasm with numerous acid-fast bacilli on AFB stain rather than GMS-positive yeasts.

66341.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，骨小樑之間的造血組織大片被細胞質豐富、淡粉紅灰色且呈細纖維狀的大型細胞取代，這些細胞核小而分散、核質比低，形成片狀浸潤，符合儲積症巨噬細胞（storage cell）。
features: Low-power trephine with bony trabeculae and extensive replacement of marrow spaces
Sheets of large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic-grey, finely fibrillary to granular cytoplasm
Small, evenly spaced, round to oval nuclei giving a low N:C ratio
Residual hematopoietic cells and small lymphocytes compressed at the periphery of the infiltrate
Low magnification limits evaluation of the 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasmic texture
66341.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows extensive replacement of the intertrabecular spaces by sheets of large histiocytic cells with abundant pale, finely fibrillary eosinophilic cytoplasm and small bland nuclei, resulting in a low nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. Residual hematopoiesis is displaced to the periphery. No atypia, necrosis or granuloma formation is evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by storage cell macrophages, as seen in lysosomal storage disorders such as Gaucher disease; higher-power review, PAS stain and enzyme assay are recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but scattered in a background neoplasm or infection, with normal glucocerebrosidase activity.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or signet ring cells
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive with nuclear atypia and are cytokeratin positive, whereas storage cells are CD68/CD163 positive with bland nuclei.
Epithelioid granulomas are compact nodules with elongated nuclei, lymphocytic cuffs and sometimes necrosis rather than diffuse sheets of voluminous pale cells.
Mast cell infiltrates are spindled, paratrabecular and fibrotic with tryptase/CD117/CD25 positivity.

exam.answer_en: Bone marrow infiltration by storage macrophages (Gaucher-type) — sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale fibrillary cytoplasm and small bland nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：trephine 低倍看到片狀淡染大細胞取代造血組織，問「這是什麼細胞浸潤、如何確認」；答 storage histiocytes，做 CD68/PAS 並驗酵素活性。
Storage cell 浸潤可呈片狀大範圍取代，導致 cytopenias 與骨骼併發症（骨壞死、bone crisis）。
IHC：組織球 CD68、CD163 陽性，keratin 陰性，可排除 signet-ring/clear cell 轉移癌；Gaucher cell PAS 陽性。
片狀組織球浸潤的鑑別：Gaucher、Niemann-Pick、pseudo-Gaucher（CML、myeloma）、MAC 感染（AFB 染色）、crystal-storing histiocytosis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 片狀淡染大細胞易被誤認為 hairy cell leukemia、systemic mastocytosis 或轉移性透明細胞癌；組織球核小而偏心、細胞質纖維狀，CD68 陽性且 CD20/tryptase/keratin 陰性。

quiz.q: 要確認圖中片狀淡染大細胞為組織球而非轉移癌，應選哪兩個 IHC 標記？
quiz.a: CD68（或 CD163）陽性、keratin（如 AE1/AE3）陰性。

66213.recognize_zh: 這是非對比電腦斷層（CT）腦部軸切面的螢幕翻拍照，綠色箭頭指向後方中線旁一小塊高密度（亮白）病灶，代表急性顱內出血；本身不是形態學影像，需結合遺傳性血小板功能異常（如 Bernard-Soulier 症候群）的臨床背景解讀。
features: Axial non-contrast CT head image, photographed from a monitor (non-morphologic)
Small, well-defined hyperdense focus in the posterior paramedian region indicated by the green arrow, consistent with acute blood
No large mass effect or midline shift is evident on this single slice
Posterior falx and paranasal sinuses/skull base visible; image quality limited by screen photography and windowing
66213.describe_en: Axial non-contrast CT image of the brain (photograph of a monitor) shows a small, well-circumscribed hyperdense focus in the posterior paramedian region, marked by the arrow, consistent with acute intracranial hemorrhage. No substantial mass effect or midline shift is apparent on this single slice, although image quality and a single level limit assessment of size and compartment. In the context of an inherited platelet function disorder, this illustrates a serious bleeding complication rather than a diagnostic morphologic feature.

ddx.vs: Calcification is typically denser (bone-like, >100 HU), stable, and located at characteristic midline/ventricular sites, whereas acute blood measures ~50-80 HU and correlates with new symptoms; comparison or HU measurement resolves it.
Tumor-related hemorrhage shows surrounding edema and enhancing tissue on contrast imaging, which cannot be assessed on this single non-contrast slice.

ddx.dx: Hypertensive or traumatic hemorrhage without a bleeding disorder
ddx.vs: Imaging cannot separate etiologies; the bleeding diathesis is established by platelet count, blood film (giant platelets) and platelet aggregation/flow studies (absent ristocetin response, reduced CD42b).

66085.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的細胞大小約同紅血球，含一顆小而圓、非常緻密深紫色的核（染色質幾乎無結構），周圍是淡灰紫色胞質，這是有核紅血球（NRBC）中的正染性紅母細胞（orthochromatic normoblast）。
features: Small cell about the size of a red cell with a single round, pyknotic, homogeneously dark nucleus
Chromatin fully condensed without visible structure or nucleoli
Moderate amount of lilac-gray cytoplasm, slightly bluer than surrounding mature red cells
Adjacent large mononuclear cell with open chromatin and gray vacuolated cytoplasm, a band/segmented neutrophil at top right
Background red cells largely normochromic with occasional irregular forms
66085.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a nucleated red blood cell (arrow) of approximately red cell size, with a small, round, pyknotic nucleus with homogeneously condensed chromatin and a rim of lilac-gray cytoplasm. Nearby are a larger mononuclear cell with open chromatin and vacuolated gray cytoplasm and a band neutrophil. Red cells are largely normochromic. Findings are consistent with a circulating late (orthochromatic) normoblast; NRBCs in adult blood suggest marrow stress, hemolysis, hypoxia or marrow infiltration.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a larger nucleus with clumped but visible chromatin and a thin rim of sky-blue cytoplasm, unlike the tiny pyknotic nucleus in pink-gray hemoglobinized cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Red cell with overlying platelet or Howell-Jolly body
ddx.vs: Howell-Jolly bodies and platelets are much smaller than this nucleus and lack a well-defined nuclear shape occupying a large portion of the cell.
Polychromatic normoblasts have a larger nucleus with checkerboard chromatin and bluer cytoplasm, whereas this nucleus is fully condensed and pyknotic.

exam.answer_en: Nucleated red blood cell (orthochromatic normoblast) in peripheral blood — small pyknotic nucleus in hemoglobinized cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：指這顆細胞問是淋巴球還是 NRBC；答 orthochromatic normoblast，重點是胞質已含血紅素（灰紫色）且核極度濃縮。
NRBC 以「每 100 顆 WBC」報告；部分血球計數儀會把 NRBC 算入 WBC，需校正白血球數。
成人周邊血出現 NRBC 的原因：溶血、嚴重缺氧、骨髓浸潤（leukoerythroblastic picture 合併淚滴紅血球與不成熟骨髓細胞）、脾臟切除後；新生兒可為正常。
重症病人（如 ICU）周邊血出現 NRBC 與較差預後相關，可作為疾病嚴重度的線索。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為小型成熟淋巴球；淋巴球核較大、染色質塊狀但仍有結構、胞質為天藍色，而 NRBC 核小而均質深染、胞質帶血紅素的灰紫色。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指細胞是什麼？它在白血球分類時如何報告？
quiz.a: Nucleated RBC（orthochromatic normoblast）；以每 100 顆 WBC 的數目報告，並校正 WBC。

65893.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，不是形態學影像：紅色母細胞群 CD45 弱、側散射低，表現 CD34、CD117、CD13 與 cCD3/cTdT，但 CD1a、CD5、CD4、CD8 陰性、cMPO 陰性；T 系標記加上幹細胞/骨髓系標記且缺 CD1a/CD8、CD5 陰性，符合早期 T 前驅細胞淋巴母細胞白血病（ETP-ALL）。
features: Blast gate (red) is CD45-dim with low side scatter, distinct from brighter CD45 mature lymphocytes (blue)
Cytoplasmic CD3 positive with cytoplasmic TdT co-expression (~75% double positive)
Stem/myeloid markers expressed: CD34 (majority) and CD117, CD13 positive (~86%)
CD1a negative, CD4/CD8 double negative, and CD5 entirely negative; CD2 positive
Cytoplasmic MPO negative on gated blasts, excluding myeloid lineage assignment
65893.describe_en: Flow cytometric immunophenotyping of bone marrow identifies a dominant CD45-dim, low side scatter blast population (red). The blasts express cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT together with CD34, CD117 and CD13, and are positive for CD2. They are negative for CD1a, CD4, CD8, CD5 and cytoplasmic MPO. The combination of T-lineage commitment (cCD3) with absent CD1a/CD8, absent CD5 and expression of stem cell/myeloid markers (CD34, CD117, CD13) without MPO fulfils the immunophenotypic criteria for early T-cell precursor lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: MPAL T/myeloid requires MPO positivity or monocytic differentiation in addition to cCD3, whereas these blasts are cMPO negative.
Non-ETP T-ALL is usually CD5 positive and often CD1a or CD8 positive, and lacks CD117/CD13 expression.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML with minimal differentiation shares CD34/CD117/CD13 but lacks cytoplasmic CD3.
Near-ETP blasts have the ETP profile except for CD5 expression on at least 75% of blasts, whereas CD5 is negative here.

exam.answer_en: Early T-cell precursor lymphoblastic leukemia — cCD3+ blasts, CD1a−/CD8−/CD5−, expressing CD34, CD117 and CD13, MPO−
pearls_zh: 讀圖順序：先用 CD45/SSC 找 CD45 dim、低 SSC 的母細胞，再看譜系：cCD3 是 T 系專一標記，cMPO 陰性排除骨髓系歸屬，最後看成熟度標記 CD1a、CD8、CD5。
ETP 表型定義：CD1a−、CD8−、CD5 陰性或弱（陽性細胞 <75%），且至少一個幹細胞/骨髓系標記（CD34、CD117、HLA-DR、CD13、CD33、CD11b、CD65）在 ≥25% 母細胞表現。
CD5 在 ≥75% 母細胞表現但其餘符合者稱 near-ETP；分子上 ETP-ALL 較像骨髓系/幹細胞腫瘤，常見 FLT3、RAS、DNMT3A、IDH 等突變，而 NOTCH1/CDKN2A 相對少。
臨床：傳統化療誘導緩解率較差，治療決策高度依賴 MRD；ICC 2022 另分出帶 BCL11B 重組的 ETP-ALL 亞型。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被判成 MPAL T/myeloid：本例 cCD3+ 但 MPO 陰性，CD13/CD117/CD34 表現不足以歸骨髓系；MPAL 需 MPO 陽性或明確單核球分化。

quiz.q: 這群 cCD3+ 母細胞 CD1a、CD8、CD5 皆陰性並表現 CD117/CD34/CD13，但 MPO 陰性，最可能的診斷？
quiz.a: Early T-cell precursor lymphoblastic leukemia (ETP-ALL)

65829.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個細長、兩端較鈍的香腸形寄生蟲，細胞質淡藍色，染色質散開並夾雜多顆散在的暗紫色顆粒/色素，較女性配子體淡且鬆散，符合惡性瘧（P. falciparum）男性配子體。
features: Elongated parasite roughly the length of a red cell with bluntly rounded ends (sausage shape)
Pale blue cytoplasm, lighter than a typical female gametocyte
Diffuse, loosely distributed chromatin with multiple scattered dark purple granules and pigment
Irregular outline in this field, possibly from smear distortion
Background: crenated and overlapping red cells, platelets, and a cluster of small round blue stain precipitate/debris particles
65829.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows an elongated sausage-shaped parasite with blunt ends, pale blue cytoplasm and loosely dispersed chromatin intermixed with scattered dark pigment granules. The outline is somewhat irregular, which limits assessment of the classic crescent shape. The background shows crenated red cells, platelets and a small cluster of blue precipitate particles, likely artifact. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium falciparum gametocyte, with pale cytoplasm and dispersed chromatin favoring a male (micro)gametocyte.

ddx.vs: Female macrogametocytes are more slender with pointed ends, darker blue cytoplasm and compact central chromatin with pigment.
P. vivax gametocytes are round to oval within an enlarged red cell with Schüffner stippling.

ddx.dx: Platelet aggregate overlying a red cell
ddx.vs: Platelet clumps have granular purple centers with pale hyalomere and lack a defined parasite outline with pigment.
Babesia forms small rings or tetrads (Maltese cross) without pigment and never forms elongated gametocytes.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum gametocyte, favoring male (microgametocyte) — sausage shape with blunt ends, pale cytoplasm and dispersed chromatin/pigment
pearls_zh: 考法：與雌配子體並列比較：雄配子體（microgametocyte）較短胖、兩端鈍圓、細胞質淡藍或粉紫、染色質鬆散、色素散布；雌配子體細長尖端、細胞質深藍、染色質與色素集中。
雄配子體在蚊胃中會進行 exflagellation 產生鞭毛狀雄配子；此步驟在體外血片放置過久時偶可見，勿誤認為其他病原。
形態上判雌雄僅屬學術重點，臨床報告重點是：確認為 P. falciparum、同時找 ring forms 並計算 parasitemia、評估重症條件。
惡性瘧需當日開始治療：重症用靜脈 artesunate；非重症依流行區抗藥性選擇 artemisinin-based combination therapy（ACT）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 外形不規則時易誤認為紅血球上的血小板團塊：血小板團為顆粒狀紫色中心加淡色 hyalomere、無瘧色素；配子體有清楚蟲體輪廓、染色質與暗色 hemozoin。

quiz.q: 這個兩端鈍圓、細胞質淡、染色質鬆散的香腸形寄生蟲，最可能是哪一種瘧原蟲的哪個時期（含性別）？
quiz.a: P. falciparum 雄配子體（microgametocyte）

65701.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的嗜中性球核只有兩個圓形分葉，由細絲相連呈眼鏡狀（pince-nez），染色質粗而濃縮，是低分葉的假性 Pelger-Huët 細胞；需搭配臨床與其他系列發育不良判斷是否後天性。
features: Mature neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus: two round, symmetric lobes joined by a thin strand (pince-nez configuration)
Coarse, markedly condensed nuclear chromatin
Moderate pale pink cytoplasm with fine granules
Background of numerous platelets and normocytic red cells
Only a single neutrophil in the field, so the proportion of affected cells cannot be assessed
65701.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus composed of two round lobes connected by a thin chromatin bridge in a pince-nez configuration, with coarsely clumped chromatin and pale granular cytoplasm. Platelets are numerous and red cells are normocytic in this field. Only one neutrophil is present, so the frequency of this change and dysplasia in other lineages cannot be evaluated here. The finding represents a Pelger-Huet-type hyposegmented neutrophil; in the absence of a family history it is suggestive of pseudo-Pelger-Huet anomaly and warrants evaluation for myelodysplasia, drug effect or infection.

ddx.vs: The inherited form affects the vast majority of neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias, and family members show the same finding.
Band forms have a C- or U-shaped nucleus of uniform width with less condensed chromatin, without two discrete round lobes.
Eosinophils are often bilobed but contain large refractile orange-red granules.
MDS-associated pseudo-Pelger cells are often hypogranular and accompanied by cytopenias and dysplasia in other lineages, requiring marrow and cytogenetic studies.

exam.answer_en: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët neutrophil — bilobed pince-nez nucleus with coarsely condensed chromatin (acquired hyposegmentation)
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭細胞問名稱與意義：兩個圓葉以細絲相連的眼鏡狀核（pince-nez）＝Pelger-Huët 型低分葉；後天性者稱 pseudo-Pelger-Huët，需想到 MDS。
先天性 Pelger-Huët anomaly：LBR 基因突變、體染色體顯性、幾乎所有嗜中性球一致受影響、功能正常無症狀；純合子可見圓形不分葉核。
後天性原因：MDS 與其他髓系腫瘤（常伴低顆粒化、血球低下）、藥物（如 mycophenolate、tacrolimus 等免疫抑制劑）、嚴重感染；藥物性停藥後可恢復。
MDS 形態門檻：某系列發育不良細胞 ≥10% 才算該系列 dysplasia；pseudo-Pelger 在 del(17p)/TP53 異常的髓系腫瘤中常見。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為帶狀核（band）：band 核為粗細一致的 C/U 形、染色質較鬆；Pelger 型為兩個圓形分葉以細絲相連、染色質異常粗濃。雙葉嗜伊紅性球則有橘紅色大顆粒。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指嗜中性球的雙葉眼鏡狀核稱為什麼？若家族成員正常且病人有血球低下，應優先懷疑什麼？
quiz.a: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly；MDS（或藥物性，需查用藥）

65637.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片有兩群細胞：一群是 N:C 比接近 1、染色質未成熟且有明顯核仁的母細胞（A、B），另一群核偏位、細胞質淡藍並拖出尾狀延伸的漿細胞樣樹突細胞（C）；流式顯示母細胞 cCD3、CD7、TdT、CD34、CD13/CD33 陽性而 CD1a、CD5 陰性，另一群 CD123、CD304、HLA-DR 陽性且 CD34/CD56 陰性，符合 ETP-ALL 合併成熟 pDC 增生。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, fine immature chromatin and visible nucleoli (panels A-B)
Second population of medium-sized cells with eccentric round nucleus, finer chromatin and a pale blue cytoplasmic tail-like extension (plasmacytoid dendritic cells, panel C)
Flow D: two CD45-dim, low side-scatter populations gated as blasts and pDC
Flow E-G (blasts): CD7 bright, CD2 negative, CD5 negative to dim, CD1a negative, TdT positive
Flow H-K (pDC): CD123 bright/CD45RA+, CD304+, CD33+, CD4+, CD56 negative, CD34 negative, HLA-DR positive
65637.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two distinct populations. The predominant population consists of medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed immature chromatin and prominent nucleoli. A second population comprises medium-sized cells with eccentric nuclei, fine chromatin and pale basophilic cytoplasm forming tail-like extensions, typical of plasmacytoid dendritic cells. Flow cytometry shows blasts positive for CD7, TdT, cytoplasmic CD3, CD34 and myeloid markers CD13/CD33 but negative for CD1a, CD5, CD2 and CD4/CD8, and a separate mature pDC population expressing CD123, CD304, HLA-DR, CD4 and CD33 without CD34 or CD56. Findings are consistent with early T-precursor lymphoblastic leukemia with an associated mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation.

ddx.vs: BPDCN cells are CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ neoplastic blasts, whereas the pDCs here are CD56-negative and accompany a separate cCD3+/TdT+ blast population.

ddx.dx: AML with pDC expansion (e.g., RUNX1-mutated AML, CMML)
ddx.vs: Blasts would lack cytoplasmic CD3 and show MPO or other myeloid lineage-defining features rather than an ETP T-lineage profile.
Requires MPO or definitive monocytic differentiation in addition to cCD3; this case is MPO-negative.
Cortical T-ALL expresses CD1a and often CD5/CD4/CD8, lacks stem/myeloid markers, and does not meet ETP criteria.

65573.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球比周圍的大、顏色偏灰藍、沒有中央淡染區，這就是多染性紅血球（polychromatophilic cells，對應網狀紅血球）。
features: Scattered large red cells (arrows) with bluish-gray (polychromatophilic) cytoplasm and no central pallor
Polychromatophilic cells are larger than surrounding normocytic red cells
Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop and elongated forms
Occasional small red cells with reduced central pallor, possible spherocytes
Platelets present; no nucleated red cells or red cell inclusions in this field
65573.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis. Several larger red cells with bluish-gray cytoplasm and absent central pallor (polychromatophilic cells) are highlighted by arrows, indicating increased reticulocytes. Occasional small red cells with reduced central pallor are present and may represent spherocytes; no nucleated red cells, schistocytes, or inclusions are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with polychromasia reflecting a marrow regenerative response, as seen in hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: Macrocytes and oval macrocytes are large but retain normal pink hemoglobin color without a blue-gray RNA tint.
Spherocytes are small, dense, and hyperchromatic without central pallor, whereas polychromatophilic cells are large and paler blue-gray.

Artifactual bluish tint affects cells diffusely in thick areas, whereas true polychromasia involves individual larger cells scattered among normally stained cells and correlates with a raised reticulocyte count.

exam.answer_en: Polychromasia — larger bluish-gray red cells without central pallor (reticulocytes), indicating marrow regenerative response
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指著灰藍色大紅血球問名稱與代表意義；答 polychromatophilic RBC，Wright 染色下的 reticulocyte（殘留 RNA 呈藍色）。
定量需 supravital stain（new methylene blue）做 reticulocyte count，再計算 reticulocyte production index 校正貧血程度。
增加見於溶血、急性失血、缺乏性貧血治療後恢復；貧血但無 polychromasia 應想 hypoproliferative 原因。
背景若有 spherocytes，需驗 DAT 區分 AIHA 與 hereditary spherocytosis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 megaloblastic 的 macro-ovalocytes 混淆：後者雖大但顏色正常粉紅、無藍灰色調；染色太厚或偏藍也會假性呈現灰藍色。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指細胞為何？用哪種染色做定量計數？
quiz.a: Polychromatophilic RBC（reticulocyte）；new methylene blue supravital stain（reticulocyte count）。

65381.recognize_zh: PAS 染色下可見大量洋紅色、粗細一致的菌絲交織成團，並有一個深紫色、放射狀排列的圓形孢子頭（conidial head），周圍散布許多棕色小圓形孢子，背景為壞死骨髓，符合侵襲性麴菌症（Aspergillus）。
features: Dense meshwork of PAS-positive magenta fungal hyphae of fairly uniform width within necrotic marrow
Hyphae show parallel walls with branching; septation is suggested but not clearly resolved at this magnification
Round dark purple radiate structure consistent with an Aspergillus conidial (fruiting) head
Numerous small brown round bodies in clusters, suggestive of pigmented conidia
A discrete aggregate of polygonal, sharply outlined clear compartments of uncertain nature (possible contaminant or plant-like material)
Sparse residual hematopoietic cells and fat spaces at the periphery
65381.describe_en: Bone marrow section stained with periodic acid-Schiff shows extensive necrotic material permeated by a dense meshwork of PAS-positive fungal hyphae of relatively uniform width with branching. A round, radiating fruiting head and clusters of small brown round conidia are present, together with a discrete aggregate of polygonal clear compartments of uncertain nature. Residual hematopoietic cells are sparse. The presence of a conidial head is unusual in tissue and suggests growth in an aerated site; culture and molecular speciation are recommended. Findings are consistent with invasive aspergillosis involving the marrow.

ddx.vs: Mucorales hyphae are broad, ribbon-like, pauci-septate with right-angle branching and stain weakly with PAS/GMS, unlike the narrow septate acute-angle hyphae here.
These hyaline molds mimic Aspergillus in tissue and can only be reliably separated by culture or PCR, although fruiting heads favor Aspergillus.
Candida shows budding yeasts with pseudohyphae constricted at septa rather than true parallel-walled hyphae and conidial heads.

65317.recognize_zh: 皮膚粗針切片中真皮被密集、單一形態的中型細胞瀰漫浸潤，細胞在粉紅色膠原束之間穿插生長，核深染、細胞質少，這種以真皮為主的母細胞浸潤型態配合臨床皮膚腫塊，支持 BPDCN 皮膚侵犯。
features: Dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate of monomorphous medium-sized cells
Tumor cells dissect between and around eosinophilic collagen bundles
Hyperchromatic round to oval nuclei with scant cytoplasm
No epidermis present in the core to assess a grenz zone
No necrosis, angioinvasion or prominent inflammatory background in this field
65317.describe_en: Skin core biopsy shows a dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate of monomorphous medium-sized cells with hyperchromatic round to oval nuclei and scant cytoplasm, infiltrating between and around collagen bundles. The epidermis is not represented, so the presence of a grenz zone cannot be assessed. No prominent necrosis or angiocentricity is seen. The appearance is that of a cutaneous blastic hematolymphoid infiltrate, and with CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1 co-expression is consistent with cutaneous involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Myeloid infiltrates are MPO, lysozyme or CD68-positive and often show eosinophilic myelocytes, whereas BPDCN is MPO-negative with CD123, TCF4 and TCL1.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: Large B cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli express CD20, BCL2 and MUM1 rather than the pDC markers.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is angiocentric with necrosis and EBER positivity and expresses cytotoxic granule proteins.
Merkel cell carcinoma has salt-and-pepper chromatin with nuclear molding and shows perinuclear dot-like CK20 and neuroendocrine marker positivity.

65253.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一個核偏位、染色質粗塊狀的漿細胞，細胞質被大量圓形、淡藍灰色的球狀包涵體（Russell bodies）塞滿，呈葡萄串樣外觀，即 Mott 細胞。
features: Single medium-sized plasma cell in peripheral blood, roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Round, somewhat eccentric nucleus with coarse, clumped chromatin; no nucleolus evident
Cytoplasm packed with numerous round, pale blue-gray globular inclusions of varying size (Russell bodies), imparting a grape-cluster (morular) appearance
Deeply basophilic cytoplasmic rim between the globules
Background red cells largely normocytic with an occasional crenated cell (echinocyte); scattered small platelets
65253.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating plasma cell with a round, slightly eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin. The cytoplasm is distended by innumerable round, pale-staining globular inclusions consistent with Russell bodies, producing a grape-like (Mott cell) appearance. Background red cells show occasional echinocytes; no blasts or other abnormal cells are present in this field. Findings represent a Mott cell (plasma cell with Russell bodies); in this clinical setting it is suggestive of a reactive plasmacytosis associated with COVID-19, although correlation to exclude a plasma cell neoplasm is warranted.

ddx.dx: Circulating myeloma cells / plasma cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Plasma cell neoplasms show numerous circulating plasma cells, often with nucleoli or immature chromatin and a monoclonal immunophenotype, rather than a rare isolated Mott cell in a reactive setting.

ddx.dx: Burkitt lymphoma or blast with cytoplasmic vacuoles
ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have sharply punched-out empty lipid vacuoles in deeply basophilic cytoplasm with finer chromatin and nucleoli, whereas Russell bodies are larger, rounded, pale-staining globules in a cell with mature clumped plasma cell chromatin.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes have basophilic cytoplasm but lack the cytoplasm-filling globular immunoglobulin inclusions.
Basophils have dark purple-black metachromatic granules overlying a lobulated nucleus rather than pale, uniformly rounded globules around a round plasma cell nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Mott cell in peripheral blood — plasma cell with cytoplasm packed by Russell bodies (grape-like), reactive plasmacytosis with COVID-19
pearls_zh: 考法：指葡萄串樣細胞問名稱；答 Mott cell（grape/morular cell），其內容物為 Russell bodies，即堆積於粗內質網的免疫球蛋白。
相關名詞：Dutcher body 為看似核內的 PAS 陽性免疫球蛋白包涵體，常見於 lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma；Russell body 則位於細胞質。
周邊血零星漿細胞或 Mott cell 多為反應性（病毒感染、敗血症、自體免疫）；若數量多需做 flow light chain restriction、SPEP 與 free light chain 排除 plasma cell neoplasm。
IMWG 2021 將 plasma cell leukemia 門檻定為周邊血循環漿細胞 ≥5%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Burkitt 細胞空泡或 basophil 混淆；Russell body 為淡灰藍實心圓球、核為成熟漿細胞粗染色質，Burkitt 空泡為透明打孔狀且核染色質細緻有核仁。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質內塞滿的圓形球狀包涵體稱為什麼？主要成分是什麼？
quiz.a: Russell bodies（Mott cell）；堆積的免疫球蛋白。

65189.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見多對兩顆黏在一起、缺乏中央淡染區的小而緻密紅血球（doublet spherocytes，箭頭），背景有多染性大紅血球；結合 DAT 陽性與溶血指標，符合溫型自體免疫溶血性貧血。
features: Paired, closely apposed red cells forming figure-of-eight doublets that lack central pallor (arrows)
Background red cells with variable size, including larger polychromatic cells reflecting reticulocytosis
Some red cells appear dense with reduced central pallor; no schistocytes or agglutinated clumps are evident
Platelets present and adequate; one neutrophil and one mononuclear cell with unremarkable morphology
65189.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cell doublets composed of two conjoined dense, round red cells lacking central pallor (doublet spherocytes), with anisocytosis and polychromasia. Schistocytes and large red cell agglutinates are not seen in this field, and leukocytes and platelets are morphologically unremarkable. In the setting of hemolysis with a positive direct antiglobulin test for IgG, findings are consistent with warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: HS shows single microspherocytes with a negative DAT and family history, rather than predominant doublet forms with a positive IgG DAT.
Cold agglutinins produce irregular multi-cell clumps that disperse on warming and a C3d-positive DAT, not discrete paired spherocytes.
Rouleaux are linear stacks of normal discocytes with central pallor in thick areas of the smear associated with high plasma protein, not paired spherocytic cells.
Overlapping cells in thick areas retain central pallor and occur randomly, whereas doublet spherocytes are dense conjoined pairs in the monolayer.

65061.recognize_zh: 一團彼此融合的大型細胞，核大且深染、細胞質強嗜鹼性，其中一顆細胞含巨大透明空泡把核擠到邊緣（類印戒樣），細胞遠大於右上角的淋巴球，提示骨髓轉移性腺癌。
features: Cohesive syncytial aggregate of very large atypical cells dwarfing adjacent lymphocytes
Large hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei with nuclear overlap and crowding
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Large clear intracytoplasmic vacuole compressing a nucleus to the periphery (signet-ring-like)
Image is out of focus, limiting assessment of chromatin and nucleoli
65061.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large atypical non-hematopoietic cells with crowded hyperchromatic nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders. One cell contains a large clear cytoplasmic vacuole displacing the nucleus, suggesting mucin or secretory vacuolation. The image is out of focus, limiting evaluation of nuclear detail. In a patient with known pulmonary adenocarcinoma, the findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma in the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are single cells with one lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm rather than a cohesive group of separate nuclei with vacuoles.
Histiocytes have small bland nuclei and pale cytoplasm and do not form crowded cohesive aggregates of hyperchromatic cells.
Hematopoietic cells are discohesive with well-defined cell borders and are CD45-positive, cytokeratin-negative.

64933.recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示舌背呈不規則、灰褐至黑色的斑片狀色素沉著，與粉紅色正常黏膜交錯形成花斑樣外觀，舌乳頭仍保留、沒有毛狀增生，配合鐮刀型貧血病人服用 hydroxyurea 的病史，符合藥物性色素沉著。
features: Clinical photograph of the dorsal tongue with patchy, irregular gray-brown to black hyperpigmentation
Pigmented patches interspersed with normal pink mucosa producing a variegated pattern
Pigmentation predominantly along the lateral borders, tip and posterior dorsum
Filiform papillae preserved without elongation or hairy coating
No ulceration, mass lesion or white plaques evident
64933.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows irregular patchy gray-brown to black pigmentation of the dorsal and lateral tongue alternating with normal pink mucosa, producing a variegated appearance. The papillae are preserved without elongation, coating, ulceration or mass formation. This is a clinical rather than microscopic image, so histologic confirmation of pigment type is not possible from the photograph. In a patient with sickle cell anemia receiving hydroxyurea, the findings are consistent with hydroxyurea-associated mucosal hyperpigmentation.

ddx.vs: Black hairy tongue shows elongated, coated filiform papillae with a hair-like surface, which is absent here.
Physiologic pigmentation is usually symmetric, stable and more common on gingiva, without temporal relation to a new drug.
Addisonian pigmentation is accompanied by skin hyperpigmentation, hypotension and hyponatremia with low cortisol.
B12 deficiency may cause glossitis with smooth atrophic tongue and macrocytic anemia with hypersegmented neutrophils, reversible with replacement.

64741.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個巨大原紅血球，深藍色細胞質在核周形成較淡區，巨大圓核內可見淡粉紫色均質毛玻璃樣包涵體與數個淡色核仁樣區域，染色質推向核緣，旁邊嗜中性球顯得很小，是 Parvovirus B19 的巨大原紅血球（lantern cell）。
features: Single giant pronormoblast about three to four times the diameter of neighboring erythrocytes (scale bar 10 µm)
Round cell with a thick rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Large round nucleus with pale, homogeneous glassy pink-lilac intranuclear inclusion and peripheral chromatin condensation
Two to three pale nucleolus-like inclusion bodies within the nucleus
Surrounding band and segmented neutrophils, myelocytes and erythrocytes appear morphologically normal
64741.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single giant pronormoblast with a thick rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a very large nucleus occupied by pale, glassy intranuclear inclusion material with marginated chromatin and several pale nucleolus-like bodies. The surrounding granulocytic cells and red cells are unremarkable. The morphology is characteristic of a parvovirus B19-infected giant pronormoblast (lantern cell) and, in the setting of anemia with reticulocytopenia, is consistent with parvovirus B19 infection.

ddx.vs: Leukemic proerythroblasts are numerous and form sheets with fine chromatin and distinct nucleoli, lacking a glassy viral inclusion.
These are smaller and have granular or sieve-like chromatin with sharp nucleoli rather than a homogeneous glassy inclusion with chromatin margination.
Megakaryoblasts may have deep basophilic blebby cytoplasm but lack intranuclear inclusions and are CD61-positive.

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19 infection — single giant pronormoblast with thick basophilic cytoplasm and glassy intranuclear inclusion (lantern cell)
pearls_zh: 考法：視野只有一顆巨大細胞時，考官會問「大小」與「核內淡色構造是核仁還是包涵體」；答 viral intranuclear inclusion。
典型臨床組合：原本代償良好的慢性溶血病人（如遺傳性球形紅血球症）突然血紅素驟降且網狀紅血球趨近 0 → transient aplastic crisis。
兒童感染表現為 erythema infectiosum（fifth disease，slapped cheek）；成人常見對稱性關節炎。
孕婦感染可致胎兒嚴重貧血與 hydrops fetalis，需以超音波監測胎兒 MCA 血流，必要時子宮內輸血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把核內淡色包涵體當成核仁而誤判為 proerythroblast 性白血病：白血病細胞成片出現、核仁清楚；parvovirus 是散在巨大細胞，核內為均勻毛玻璃樣物質並染色質邊緣化。

quiz.q: 慢性溶血病人感染此病毒後，突然發生的嚴重貧血稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Transient aplastic crisis。

64613.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中有一團立體、邊緣呈圓弧「砲彈/桑椹狀」（cannonball/morula）的外來上皮細胞簇，細胞核深染重疊、細胞間緊密黏合，左側細胞有大空泡使核被擠向一側，與背景零散的間皮與發炎細胞明顯不同。
features: Three-dimensional cohesive cluster of epithelial cells with smooth knobby community borders (morula/cannonball pattern)
Crowded, overlapping, hyperchromatic nuclei with high N:C ratio
Some cells contain large cytoplasmic vacuoles displacing the nucleus to the periphery (signet-ring-like)
Size of cluster cells markedly larger than background single cells
Clean proteinaceous background with scattered small inflammatory/mesothelial cells
64613.describe_en: Cytospin of pleural fluid shows a three-dimensional cohesive cluster of large epithelial cells with knobby, smooth community borders, crowded hyperchromatic overlapping nuclei and high N:C ratios. Several cells display cytoplasmic vacuoles, including signet-ring-like forms. The cluster is distinctly foreign to the background population of scattered small inflammatory cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma in pleural fluid, compatible with the known breast primary; immunocytochemistry (e.g., GATA3, ER, Ber-EP4/MOC-31 vs calretinin) on a cell block would confirm.

ddx.vs: Reactive mesothelial clusters are flat or loosely cohesive with knobby borders but show 'windows' between cells, two-tone cytoplasm and calretinin/WT1 positivity, and lack a distinct foreign second population.
Mesothelioma cells retain mesothelial features (windows, skirt-like cytoplasm) and express calretinin, WT1 and D2-40 while being negative for adenocarcinoma markers.
Hematolymphoid cells are dyscohesive single cells without true three-dimensional epithelial clusters.
Macrophage clusters have loosely arranged bean-shaped nuclei with foamy cytoplasm and CD68/CD163 positivity rather than tight cohesive hyperchromatic epithelial groups.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic adenocarcinoma in pleural fluid — foreign 3D cohesive 'cannonball' cluster with hyperchromatic nuclei and signet-ring-like vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：體液抹片中指這團大細胞問「是間皮細胞還是癌細胞？」——關鍵是「兩群細胞（two-cell population）」：與背景明顯不同的外來 3D 細胞團屬轉移癌。
IHC 必考組合：腺癌 MOC-31、Ber-EP4、claudin-4 陽性；間皮細胞 calretinin、WT1、D2-40 陽性。乳癌來源加做 GATA3、ER。
惡性胸水最常見原發：整體以肺癌最多，女性則乳癌占重要比例；惡性胸水代表晚期（M1）疾病。
血液實驗室做體液細胞計數時，發現此類細胞應回報 atypical/malignant cells 並轉細胞病理確認，勿歸入 mesothelial 或 other。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與反應性間皮細胞團混淆；間皮細胞間有「windows」、細胞質雙色調且與單顆間皮細胞呈連續形態，癌細胞團則緊密、核深染擁擠且形成獨立第二族群。

quiz.q: 胸水中這團邊緣圓凸、核深染重疊並有印戒樣空泡的細胞團，最可能是什麼？用哪兩類 IHC 標記與間皮細胞區分？
quiz.a: 轉移性腺癌；上皮/腺癌標記（MOC-31、Ber-EP4、claudin-4）vs 間皮標記（calretinin、WT1、D2-40）

64421.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中的中至大型淋巴細胞，細胞質深藍並含清楚的小空泡、核不規則有核仁；流式為 CD19+/CD10+ kappa 限制，FISH 顯示 IGH::MYC 雙融合與 BCL6 斷裂，另有 11q 異常，符合 MYC/BCL6 高惡性度 B 細胞淋巴瘤的白血病期。
features: PB smear (A-C): medium to large lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Distinct punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles (A, C)
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and one or more visible nucleoli
Flow (D): CD19+ CD20+ CD10+ population with kappa light chain restriction, CD4-
Karyotype (E): complex karyotype with arrows marking abnormal chromosomes 3, 8, 11 and 14 (t(8;14))
FISH: MYC/IGH double fusion (F), BCL6 break-apart split signal (G), 11q triple-color probe showing 11q23 gain/11q24 loss (H)
64421.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing punched-out vacuoles, round to irregular nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, and visible nucleoli. Flow cytometry identifies a CD19-, CD20- and CD10-positive B-cell population with kappa light chain restriction. The karyotype is complex with t(8;14)(q24;q32), and FISH confirms IGH::MYC fusion, BCL6 rearrangement, and an 11q23 gain/11q24 loss pattern, without BCL2 rearrangement. Findings are consistent with leukemic high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL6 rearrangements and concurrent 11q aberration.

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma shares vacuolated basophilic cells and IG::MYC, but typically has a simple karyotype without BCL6 rearrangement or complex abnormalities, in a younger patient.
This entity shows the 11q23 gain/11q24 loss pattern by definition without MYC rearrangement, whereas IGH::MYC fusion is present here.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Distinguished only by FISH: BCL2 rearrangement is absent in this case.
B-ALL blasts are TdT+ and usually CD34+ with surface light chain negativity, whereas these cells are mature kappa-restricted B cells.

64357.recognize_zh: 視野中有兩團鬆散的紫色小顆粒血小板聚集（platelet clumps），但更顯眼的是紅血球彼此黏成不規則分支狀團塊（agglutination 樣），且紅血球上佈滿小黑點，因此本圖僅部分符合標題的血小板凝集。
features: Two loose aggregates of platelets with purple granules (upper left and right mid field)
Red cells stuck together in irregular, branching three-dimensional clumps rather than linear rouleaux
Numerous small dark punctate/ring-like dots overlying red cell clumps (nature uncertain: precipitate, drying artifact or inclusions)
Dark angular stain precipitate crystal in the background
No leukocytes present in this field
64357.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small loose aggregates of platelets, consistent with platelet clumping, which can cause spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counts. The field is dominated by irregular, branching clumps of red cells resembling agglutination, with numerous small dark punctate bodies overlying the red cells and scattered stain precipitate; these dots cannot be characterized reliably and may be artifactual. No leukocytes are present in this field. Findings show platelet clumping as described, but the prominent red cell clumping suggests additional red cell agglutination (for example, cold agglutinins) or a thick, poorly spread area, and correlation with a repeat smear is advised.

ddx.vs: True agglutination forms irregular grape-like red cell clusters that disperse on warming to 37 C, whereas rouleaux form linear stacks and platelet clumps consist only of platelets.
Rouleaux are linear coin-stack arrangements of red cells associated with increased plasma proteins, unlike the branching irregular clumps here.
Satellitism shows platelets rimming neutrophils rather than free-lying platelet aggregates.

Parasites show defined ring forms with chromatin dots and cytoplasm within individual cells, whereas these dots are uniform and present over clumped cells, favoring artifact; thin-film review is needed.

64293.recognize_zh: 約七顆嗜中性球緊密聚成一團，周邊與細胞之間黏附許多小顆紫色血小板，形成環繞狀；此張呈現的是多顆中性球與血小板共同聚集，而非單一中性球周圍一圈血小板的典型衛星現象。
features: Aggregate of about seven segmented and band neutrophils in close contact
Numerous small granular platelets adhering to the periphery of the neutrophils and between cells
Neutrophils with normal lobation, clumped chromatin and pale granular cytoplasm
No free platelet clumps elsewhere in the field; free platelets appear sparse
Background red cells normochromic and slightly out of focus
64293.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of approximately seven mature neutrophils in tight apposition. Numerous platelets are adherent to the neutrophil membranes around the perimeter of the cluster and in the spaces between cells, while few free platelets are present in the surrounding field. The neutrophils themselves show normal nuclear segmentation without toxic change. Findings are consistent with EDTA-associated platelet satellitism, here accompanied by neutrophil aggregation, which can cause spurious thrombocytopenia; a platelet count on a citrate-anticoagulated sample is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps are aggregates of platelets alone, sometimes entrapping leukocytes, whereas satellitism shows platelets arranged along neutrophil membranes.
Pure leukocyte clumping lacks the rim of adherent platelets around the neutrophils.
True thrombocytopenia shows uniformly sparse platelets without platelets sequestered around leukocytes, and the count remains low in a citrate sample.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism with neutrophil aggregation — platelets adherent around a clump of neutrophils (EDTA-associated in vitro artifact)
pearls_zh: 考法：多顆中性球聚團並有血小板黏附，可問「為何血小板計數偏低、白血球數也可能偏低？」因血小板與中性球被困在聚集中而漏計。
EDTA 相關體外現象包括 platelet clumping、platelet satellitism 與 leukocyte agglutination，皆可造成 pseudo-cytopenia，且可同時存在。
判讀時先看抹片邊緣與 feathered edge 是否有血小板或白血球團塊，儀器的 PLT clumps flag 也是線索。
處置：以 citrate 管（需稀釋校正）或 heparin 管重算、或指尖血直接抹片；不應依偽低數值輸注血小板。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被當成典型「單顆中性球周圍一圈血小板」的衛星現象或單純白血球聚集；此圖是多顆中性球聚團合併血小板黏附，描述時兩者都要提到。

quiz.q: 用 sodium citrate 管重新計數血小板時，為何需要校正結果？
quiz.a: 液態 citrate 與血液約 1:9 混合造成稀釋，計數需乘以稀釋係數（約 1.1）。

64165.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 AE1/AE3 角蛋白染色中，許多大型細胞的細胞質只出現棕色點狀或小團塊狀（dot-like）著色，而不是整個細胞質瀰漫陽性；這種點狀角蛋白要與真正的上皮癌轉移區分。
features: Numerous medium-to-large cells with ovoid pale nuclei in a cellular marrow
AE1/AE3 shows dot-like and small clumped paranuclear/cytoplasmic staining
Staining is focal and granular rather than diffuse membranous-cytoplasmic
No cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests or glands
Scattered adipocyte spaces
64165.describe_en: Pan-cytokeratin AE1/AE3 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow core shows dot-like and small clumped cytoplasmic staining in many of the large cells, without diffuse strong cytoplasmic or membranous positivity and without cohesive epithelial nests. This pattern is not typical of metastatic carcinoma; in view of strong CD163 expression and CD34 negativity, the dot-like keratin reactivity is interpreted in the context of a histiocytic infiltrate. Correlation with additional lineage markers is recommended.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma usually shows strong diffuse cytoplasmic keratin in cohesive clusters and is CD163-negative.

ddx.dx: Neuroendocrine carcinoma (e.g., small cell or Merkel cell)
ddx.vs: Paranuclear dot-like keratin is classic for neuroendocrine tumors, but these are CD163-negative and express synaptophysin/chromogranin/INSM1.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with aberrant keratin
ddx.vs: Plasma cells may show aberrant keratin but are CD138/MUM1-positive with light-chain restriction rather than CD163-positive.

64101.recognize_zh: 畫面中央一顆漿細胞（plasma cell），核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀，但細胞質呈洋紅至紫紅色、邊緣有不規則火焰狀突起，這就是火焰細胞（flame cell）；周圍還有多顆帶核周淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞，背景漿細胞明顯增加。
features: Central plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus and coarse clock-face chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm with intense magenta/fuchsia peripheral staining and ragged, flame-like cytoplasmic projections
Numerous additional plasma cells with deep basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof, some with slightly immature open chromatin
Occasional binucleate/larger plasma cell forms (lower left)
Scattered neutrophil and red cells in a hemodilute background
64101.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in plasma cells, many of which have eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, deep basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof; some show slightly more open chromatin. One plasma cell has cytoplasm with a distinctive magenta-red peripheral hue and irregular frayed projections, characteristic of a flame cell. Flame cells reflect accumulation of glycosylated immunoglobulin (classically IgA) and are not by themselves diagnostic of malignancy. In the context of a clonal plasma cell proliferation, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, polytypic and usually <10% without sheets or atypia, and flame cells can occasionally occur, so clonality must be shown by flow, IHC or ISH for light chains.
Mott cells contain multiple round clear or pink globular inclusions (Russell bodies) filling the cytoplasm rather than a diffuse magenta peripheral hue with frayed edges.
The pink material here is continuous with the cytoplasm of a cell bearing a plasma cell nucleus, not a free granular anucleate fragment.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma with flame cell — plasma cell with magenta-red frayed peripheral cytoplasm among increased plasma cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指胞質邊緣呈洋紅/火焰色、邊緣毛躁的細胞問名稱；答 flame cell（漿細胞的一型），傳統上與 IgA myeloma 相關。
Flame cell 的紅色來自富含醣化的 immunoglobulin 堆積，屬非特異性形態，reactive plasmacytosis 也可見；惡性判斷靠比例、clonality 與臨床。
IgA myeloma 臨床：IgA 易形成聚合體，較 IgG 易造成 hyperviscosity；SPEP 上 M-spike 可不明顯（落在 beta 區），需 immunofixation 與 serum free light chain。
Myeloma 常規遺傳檢查以 CD138-sorted FISH：high-risk 包括 t(4;14)、t(14;16)、del(17p)/TP53、1q gain/amplification。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 flame cell 誤認為 promyelocyte 或嗜酸性前驅細胞：flame cell 仍有偏心核、粗塊染色質與 perinuclear hof，紅色是胞質均質染色而非顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質邊緣呈洋紅色、邊界毛躁的漿細胞叫什麼？傳統上與哪一種 heavy chain 的 myeloma 相關？
quiz.a: Flame cell；IgA myeloma。

64037.recognize_zh: 這是一張 G 帶染色的核型圖（karyogram），男性（XY），第 20 號染色體其中一條的長臂明顯變短（紅色箭頭），代表 del(20q)，是 MDS 常見的細胞遺傳異常。
features: G-banded karyogram with 22 autosome pairs plus X and Y (male, 46 chromosomes)
One chromosome 20 homolog with a visibly shortened long arm (red arrow), consistent with del(20)(q11.2)
No other numerical or obvious structural abnormalities in the displayed metaphase
Banding resolution is modest; breakpoint assignment relies on the reported karyotype rather than this image alone
64037.describe_en: Conventional cytogenetic analysis of the bone marrow shows a G-banded male karyogram with an interstitial/terminal deletion of the long arm of one chromosome 20 (arrow). The remaining autosomes and sex chromosomes appear numerically and structurally normal at this resolution. Per the report, the abnormality was present in all 20 metaphases analyzed: 46,XY,del(20)(q11.2)[20]. Isolated del(20q) is a recurrent abnormality in MDS and other myeloid neoplasms but is not by itself MDS-defining in the absence of morphologic dysplasia.

ddx.vs: A true del(20q) is reproducible across multiple metaphases and confirmable by interphase FISH (e.g., D20S108 probe), whereas contraction artifact is inconsistent.

ddx.dx: Isolated del(20q) in CCUS or non-neoplastic setting
ddx.vs: Karyotype cannot separate these; del(20q) without diagnostic dysplasia does not establish MDS, so marrow morphology is required.
Monosomy shows a single chromosome 20 and ring 20 shows a circular chromosome, whereas here two chromosome 20s are present with one having a shortened q arm.

63973.recognize_zh: 抹片中紅血球大多缺乏中央淡染區、呈高密度的圓形或不規則收縮狀（irregularly contracted cells），間雜標靶細胞（target cells）與少數摺疊細胞，這種組合提示血紅素 C 病。
features: Numerous dense red cells lacking central pallor, including irregularly contracted and spherocytic-appearing cells
Scattered target cells with central hemoglobin condensation
Occasional folded or boat-shaped cells and small red cell fragments
Mild anisocytosis with smaller cells; microcytosis is difficult to quantify in this image
No definite intraerythrocytic HbC crystals are identifiable at this magnification
63973.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a red cell population with mild anisopoikilocytosis dominated by dense, hyperchromic cells lacking central pallor, many of which have irregular contracted contours. Target cells are scattered throughout, along with occasional folded cells and small fragments. Distinct intraerythrocytic hemoglobin C crystals are not clearly identified at this magnification, and red cell size is difficult to judge without a reference lymphocyte. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin C disease; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is recommended.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes are round with smooth contours and target cells are not a feature, whereas irregularly contracted cells and targets here favor HbC.
HbSC shows characteristic angular crystals with protruding knobs (Washington monument/glove shapes) and occasional sickle-like forms, requiring electrophoresis for confirmation.
G6PD crises show bite and blister cells with Heinz bodies on supravital stain rather than prominent target cells.

ddx.dx: Beta-thalassemia or liver disease with targeting
ddx.vs: Thalassemia shows marked microcytosis with basophilic stippling and liver disease shows macrocytic targets, without numerous irregularly contracted dense cells.

exam.answer_en: Hemoglobin C disease — dense contracted RBCs lacking central pallor with numerous target cells
pearls_zh: 考法：抹片問「什麼血紅素病」；看到大量 target cells 加高密度收縮紅血球，應想到 HbC；若出現六角柱狀 HbC crystal（bar of gold）更具特異性，脾切除後較常見。
分子：β-globin 第 6 位 glutamate→lysine（HbC）；HbS 為 glutamate→valine。HbCC 通常只有輕度溶血與脾腫大，HbSC 則有鐮刀型併發症。
確認檢查：HPLC 或電泳；鹼性電泳中 HbC 與 HbA2、HbE、HbO 同位置遷移，需以 HPLC 或酸性電泳區分。
HbC 使紅血球脫水、MCHC 上升，易與球形紅血球混淆；紅血球滲透脆性反而降低。
exam.pitfall_zh: 高密度無中央淡染的紅血球易誤判為 spherocytes（HS）；HbC 同時伴大量 target cells 且可見晶體，HS 則以小球形紅血球與多染性為主、target cells 少。

quiz.q: 此抹片中大量標靶細胞與高密度收縮紅血球提示何種血紅素病？應以何檢查確認？
quiz.a: Hemoglobin C disease（HbCC）；hemoglobin HPLC/電泳

63909.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎全被片狀、大小一致的不成熟細胞取代：核圓至卵圓、染色質淡而細緻、細胞質少，只剩零星嗜伊紅性前驅細胞與少數分葉核細胞，脂肪幾乎消失，支持急性白血病浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with near-total effacement by sheets of immature mononuclear cells
Tumor cells medium-sized with round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei, fine pale chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Scattered residual eosinophilic granulocyte precursors and occasional segmented neutrophils
Markedly reduced fat; no megakaryocytes evident in this field
63909.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular, with near-complete replacement of the marrow space by diffuse sheets of immature mononuclear cells. The cells have round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm. Only scattered eosinophilic precursors and rare maturing granulocytes remain, and megakaryocytes are not evident in this field. Lineage cannot be determined on H&E alone and requires immunohistochemistry (e.g., CD34, MPO, CD117, TdT, CD123) and aspirate correlation. Findings are consistent with involvement by acute leukemia, in this context acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology on core overlaps; TdT, CD19/PAX5 or CD3 positivity with MPO negativity separates lymphoblastic leukemia.
BPDCN shows a similar monotonous infiltrate but is CD123/TCL1/CD4/CD56-positive and CD34/MPO-negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell or Burkitt lymphoma in marrow
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are usually larger with vesicular nuclei or a starry-sky pattern and express CD20/PAX5, lacking CD34 and myeloid markers.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumors form cohesive nests with desmoplastic stroma and are CD45-negative with keratin, synaptophysin or other lineage markers.

63845.recognize_zh: 這是鹼性 pH 醋酸纖維膜血紅素電泳：箭頭所指的受檢者只在靠近點樣處的 C/E/O/A2 位置有一條粗帶，完全沒有 HbA 帶；對照其他泳道（A+S、A+C/E、單純 A），這種只見 E 區帶的型態符合 HbE 同型合子或 HbE/β0 地中海貧血。
features: Alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis strip with marked point of application and labeled C/E/O/A2, S/D/G/Q/L and A positions
Arrowed lane: single dense band in the C/E/O/A2 region with no HbA band
Top two lanes: bands in both S/D/G region and A position (heterozygous pattern)
Third lane: bands in both C/E/O/A2 region and A position (heterozygous C/E-type pattern)
Bottom lane: dominant HbA band with faint A2 band (normal pattern)
63845.describe_en: Hemoglobin electrophoresis at alkaline pH shows, in the arrowed patient lane, a prominent slow-moving band in the C/E/O/A2 region with absence of a normal HbA band. Comparison lanes show heterozygous A plus S/D/G patterns, a heterozygous A plus C/E/O/A2 pattern, and a normal HbA pattern. Because HbE, HbC, HbO-Arab and HbA2 co-migrate at alkaline pH, the band requires identification by HPLC, acid electrophoresis or DNA analysis. In the context of an HbA2-window variant of about 87% on HPLC, the findings are consistent with homozygous HbE or HbE/beta0-thalassemia.

ddx.vs: HbC co-migrates with HbE at alkaline pH but separates from it on acid (citrate agar) electrophoresis and elutes in a distinct C-window on HPLC, with target cells and HbC crystals on smear.
HbO-Arab also runs in the C/E/O region at alkaline pH but moves differently on acid electrophoresis and elutes later than HbE on HPLC.
Electrophoresis cannot separate these; E/beta0-thalassemia has markedly higher HbF, more severe anemia and a beta-thalassemia mutation on parental or DNA studies.

63781.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 骨髓切片中，骨小樑明顯增厚、彎曲不規則（骨硬化），小樑間的骨髓腔被淡粉紅、呈流線狀排列的纖維性基質取代，造血細胞稀少、夾雜少量脂肪與擴張血管；這種纖維化合併骨硬化是纖維化期骨髓纖維化的表現。
features: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy with markedly thickened, irregular and tortuous bone trabeculae (osteosclerosis)
Intertrabecular spaces replaced by pale fibrous stroma with streaming spindle cells
Markedly reduced hematopoietic cellularity with only scattered small cells at this magnification
Scattered fat vacuoles and prominent small blood vessels/dilated sinusoids within the fibrotic stroma
Megakaryocyte morphology and residual trilineage hematopoiesis cannot be reliably assessed at this power
63781.describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows thickened, irregular and tortuous bone trabeculae consistent with osteosclerosis. The intertrabecular marrow is largely replaced by loose to dense fibrous stroma with streaming spindle cells, scattered adipocytes and prominent vessels, and hematopoietic cellularity is markedly reduced; residual hematopoietic elements and megakaryocyte atypia require higher-power review. Reticulin and trichrome stains are needed to grade fibrosis and collagen. In a patient with prior polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in the fibrotic, osteosclerotic stage.

ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma shows cohesive epithelial nests or single atypical cells within the fibrosis that are cytokeratin positive, which are not apparent here.

Hyperparathyroid bone disease shows peritrabecular fibrosis with numerous osteoclasts and scalloped resorption bays around trabeculae rather than diffuse intertrabecular fibrosis replacing hematopoiesis.
Mastocytosis forms paratrabecular or perivascular aggregates of spindled CD117+ tryptase+ CD25+ mast cells with eosinophils, while MPN fibrosis lacks mast cell aggregates.
HCL causes reticulin fibrosis with a diffuse infiltrate of evenly spaced fried-egg lymphoid cells positive for CD20, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E, without osteosclerosis.

exam.answer_en: Post-polycythemic myelofibrosis, fibrotic stage — marrow replaced by fibrosis with osteosclerotic thickened trabeculae
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍 H&E 要認出兩件事：骨小樑增厚彎曲（osteosclerosis）與髓腔被流線狀纖維基質取代、造血細胞稀少。
下一步加做 reticulin 與 trichrome 分級；骨硬化常伴隨 MF-3 級纖維化。
高倍應找群聚、核深染呈雲朵狀的非典型巨核細胞與竇內造血，支持 MPN 相關纖維化。
對應臨床：血片淚滴狀紅血球與 leukoerythroblastosis、骨髓抽吸 dry tap、髓外造血致脾腫大。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為轉移癌造成的纖維化：應以 cytokeratin 排除上皮細胞巢；腎性骨病則以小樑旁纖維化與大量蝕骨細胞為主。

quiz.q: 低倍下骨小樑的變化稱為什麼？下一步應加做哪些染色？
quiz.a: Osteosclerosis；reticulin 與 trichrome 染色

63653.recognize_zh: 兩張圖箭頭處都是巨噬細胞，細胞質內塞滿大量藍灰至藍黑色、大小不一的顆粒狀色素；右圖巨噬細胞中央還有一團黃褐偏綠的色素，周圍圍著紅血球母細胞，符合含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin）。
features: Macrophages with cytoplasm packed with coarse, variably sized blue-gray to blue-black granular pigment
Left panel: pigment extends into irregular cytoplasmic processes; eccentric nucleus
Right panel: central golden-brown to greenish pigment aggregate with peripheral blue-gray granules
Right panel: macrophage in contact with surrounding erythroblasts (erythroblastic island)
Background neutrophils and red cells; two-panel composite
63653.describe_en: Two-panel bone marrow smear composite (May-Grünwald-Giemsa). Macrophages (arrows) contain abundant coarse, blue-gray to blue-black granular cytoplasmic pigment; in the right panel the pigment includes a central golden-brown to greenish aggregate and the macrophage is surrounded by erythroblasts. This appearance on a Romanowsky stain is characteristic of hemosiderin. Findings are consistent with hemosiderin-laden marrow macrophages indicating storage iron; iron stores should be graded on a Prussian blue stain of marrow particles.

ddx.vs: Sea-blue histiocytes contain more uniform blue-green ceroid granules and are Prussian blue negative.
Melanin is brown-black, Prussian blue negative, and Fontana-Masson positive.
Mast cells are smaller cells with dense purple metachromatic granules around a round central nucleus rather than blue-gray pigment clumps.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and background rather than being confined to macrophage cytoplasm.

63589.recognize_zh: 稀疏區域中幾顆早期前驅細胞胞質邊緣各有數個圓形透明小空泡，包括帶淡藍胞質的骨髓系前驅細胞，是 VEXAS 症候群「前驅細胞空泡化」的高倍示範。
features: Isolated early precursor cells with multiple small round clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, often at the periphery or adjacent to the nucleus
Vacuolated cells have moderate blue-grey cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and round to reniform nuclei with fine chromatin
One cell with more basophilic cytoplasm and round nucleus, possibly an early erythroid or myeloid precursor
Adjacent promyelocyte/myelocyte with granular cytoplasm lacking obvious vacuoles
Thin area of smear with scattered red cells and platelets
63589.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa), thin area, shows several isolated early precursor cells. Four cells with blue-grey, finely granular cytoplasm and round to reniform nuclei contain multiple small, sharply punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles. Exact lineage assignment of each vacuolated cell is limited in this isolated field. No Auer rods or dysplastic nuclear features are evident. In the appropriate clinical context, vacuolization of myeloid and erythroid precursors is suggestive of VEXAS syndrome, pending UBA1 mutation testing.

ddx.vs: Copper deficiency produces similar precursor vacuoles with ring sideroblasts and is separated by low serum copper/ceruloplasmin and absent UBA1 mutation.
Similar vacuoles resolve after withdrawal of the offending agent and lack UBA1 mutation.

ddx.dx: Blasts with vacuoles (e.g. monoblasts, Burkitt-like leukemia)
ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts have high N:C ratio, fine blastic chromatin with prominent nucleoli and occur in increased numbers, whereas VEXAS precursors mature normally.

63525.recognize_zh: 三格薄層血片中大量未增大的紅血球含細小、大小一致的環狀體，常見雙染色質點與貼附紅血球邊緣的 accolé 形式、單顆紅血球多重感染；A 與 C 格箭頭指出香蕉形（crescent）配子體，確認為惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）而非巴貝西蟲。
features: Composite of three thin-film fields (A-C) with high parasitemia
Small, delicate, uniform ring forms, many with double chromatin dots
Marginal appliqué (accolé) forms along the red cell membrane
Multiply infected red cells that are not enlarged; no Schüffner dots
Crescent (banana)-shaped gametocytes with central pigment/chromatin (arrows in A and C)
No trophozoite/schizont stages, no extracellular rings, and no tetrad (Maltese cross) forms
63525.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood films (panels A-C) show a high parasitemia with numerous intraerythrocytic ring forms. The rings are small, delicate, and relatively uniform, frequently with double chromatin dots and marginal appliqué (accolé) positioning, and several red cells contain multiple rings; infected red cells are not enlarged and lack stippling. Crescent-shaped gametocytes are identified in panels A and C (arrows), while mature trophozoites, schizonts, extracellular rings, and tetrad forms are not seen. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria; parasitemia should be quantified because hyperparasitemia defines severe disease.

ddx.vs: Babesia shows pleomorphic rings, extracellular forms, and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without hemozoin pigment or gametocytes, whereas crescent gametocytes here establish P. falciparum.
P. vivax and P. ovale infect enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots and show amoeboid trophozoites and schizonts, unlike the non-enlarged cells with only rings and crescents here.
P. knowlesi and P. malariae show band-form trophozoites and schizonts in the peripheral blood and round gametocytes rather than crescents.

ddx.dx: Platelets overlying red cells or stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets lie in a different focal plane and lack a ring of cytoplasm with a discrete chromatin dot.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum malaria — small multiple/accolé rings in non-enlarged RBCs with crescent gametocytes (excludes Babesia)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官常指箭頭處的新月形配子體問「這是哪一種瘧原蟲？憑什麼不是 Babesia？」答案是香蕉形配子體為 P. falciparum 專屬。
P. falciparum 周邊血通常只見環狀體與配子體：成熟滋養體與裂殖體因 PfEMP1 介導黏附微血管而隱匿（sequestration），出現裂殖體反提示重症。
需以薄片計算寄生蟲血症（%感染紅血球）；WHO 將寄生蟲血症 >10% 列為重症瘧疾標準之一，重症首選靜脈 artesunate。
Babesia 與 P. falciparum 均為未增大紅血球內的小環狀體；鑑別需看旅遊/蜱咬暴露史、有無瘧色素與配子體，不確定時送 PCR。
快篩 HRP2 抗原偵測 P. falciparum，但已有 hrp2/hrp3 基因缺失造成偽陰性的報告，血片鏡檢仍是金標準。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把高寄生蟲血症的小環狀體誤判為 Babesia；關鍵看有無新月形配子體與瘧色素，Babesia 兩者皆無且可見四聯體。

quiz.q: 圖中箭頭所指的新月形結構是什麼？它如何幫助區分 P. falciparum 與 Babesia？
quiz.a: P. falciparum gametocyte（crescent/banana-shaped）；Babesia 不形成配子體

63333.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個細胞核偏向一側、呈圓形深染，胞質豐富且呈特殊的洋紅色／粉紫色，邊緣像燭火般外展，這是火焰細胞（flame cell）——胞質含大量糖化免疫球蛋白的漿細胞。
features: Plasma cell with eccentric round dense nucleus
Abundant cytoplasm with intense magenta-pink (flaming) staining, fading to blue near the nucleus
Irregular, flared cytoplasmic outline resembling a candle flame
Background small round cells with dense nuclei and scattered neutrophils
Thin feathered-edge aspirate area with drying artifact and poorly preserved red cells
63333.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, at a thin feathered edge with drying artifact, shows a plasma cell with an eccentric round dense nucleus and abundant cytoplasm that stains intensely magenta-pink with a flared, flame-like outline. The background contains neutrophils and small round cells with dense nuclei, which are difficult to characterize in this field. Findings are consistent with a flame cell (plasma cell with glycoprotein-rich cytoplasm); flame cells are classically associated with IgA myeloma but are not specific.

ddx.dx: Mott cell / Russell body plasma cell
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple discrete round pale-blue or clear Russell bodies rather than diffuse magenta cytoplasm.
Reactive flame-like plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda staining, whereas myeloma cells are clonal and increased.
Megakaryocytic cytoplasm is granular with platelet budding and lacks the eccentric plasma cell nucleus with perinuclear hof.
Gaucher cells have crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm with small nuclei and are much larger.

exam.answer_en: Flame cell — plasma cell with intensely magenta, flame-like glycoprotein-rich cytoplasm; classically associated with IgA myeloma
pearls_zh: 考法：指洋紅色胞質、邊緣火焰狀的細胞問名稱、最常聯想哪型骨髓瘤（IgA），以及是否具特異性（否，反應性漿細胞也可見）。
洋紅色來自內質網中富含糖基化的免疫球蛋白；與 Mott cell（Russell bodies）、Dutcher body（核內假包涵體）同屬免疫球蛋白堆積的形態。
確認漿細胞腫瘤：骨髓 clonal plasma cell 比例（≥10% 為 myeloma 門檻之一）、flow 或 IHC kappa/lambda 輕鏈限制、SPEP/IFE 與 serum free light chain。
IgA M-protein 易形成聚合體，可造成高黏滯；電泳上 IgA 常在 β 區而非 γ 區遷移，容易被漏看。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為巨核細胞碎片或 Gaucher 細胞；flame cell 有單一偏心圓核與核旁淡染區，胞質均勻洋紅，而非顆粒狀或皺紙樣。

quiz.q: 圖中央胞質呈洋紅色、邊緣火焰狀的細胞稱為什麼？典型關聯哪一型骨髓瘤？
quiz.a: Flame cell；IgA myeloma

63077.recognize_zh: OCT2 染色中，散在的大型細胞核呈濃厚棕色強陽性，明顯比周圍淡染的背景小 B 細胞更強，其中左下一顆為多葉核的爆米花樣（popcorn）細胞；大細胞強表現 OCT2 支持 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞，可與 OCT2 常消失的典型何杰金細胞區分。
features: Immunohistochemical stain for OCT2 at high power
Scattered large cells with strong, dense nuclear OCT2 staining
Large positive cell with multilobated popcorn-like nucleus (lower left)
Background small lymphocytes show weak to moderate nuclear OCT2 staining, weaker than the large cells
Some small cells are OCT2-negative (T cells)
63077.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for OCT2 shows scattered large cells with strong nuclear positivity, including a cell with a multilobated popcorn-like nucleus, set in a background of small lymphocytes with weaker, variable OCT2 staining. The intensity of OCT2 in the large cells exceeds that of the background B cells. Preserved strong expression of the B-cell transcription factor OCT2 in these large cells supports their identity as LP cells. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HRS cells characteristically lose or show only weak OCT2 and BOB1 expression, together with CD30/CD15 positivity, unlike the strongly OCT2-positive large cells here.
Large cells are also OCT2-positive, so the distinction relies on diffuse architecture lacking small B-cell-rich nodules.
Reactive large B cells are OCT2-positive but lie within polarized germinal centers rather than as isolated popcorn cells within small lymphocyte nodules.

63269.recognize_zh: 8 週後的低倍血液抹片中，大片紅血球間只剩零星白血球，箭頭指向一顆單核球與一顆小淋巴球，看不到先前大量藍色細胞質的芽細胞；白血球數量明顯下降、芽細胞消失，代表 TAM 已自行緩解。
features: Low-power peripheral blood smear with markedly fewer nucleated cells than at presentation
Scattered small round lymphocytes with dense nuclei
Arrows indicate a monocyte (larger, irregular) and an adjacent lymphocyte
No clusters of basophilic blast-like cells identified at this magnification
Evenly distributed normocytic red cells; cellular detail limited by low power
63269.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low magnification shows a reduced number of leukocytes compared with the presentation smear, consisting of scattered lymphocytes and monocytes (arrows indicate a monocyte and a lymphocyte). No blasts are identified in this field, although cytologic detail is limited at this power and confirmation on high power and by flow cytometry is appropriate. Red cells are evenly distributed. Findings are consistent with spontaneous resolution of transient abnormal myelopoiesis at 8 weeks.

ddx.dx: Persistent TAM or early myeloid leukemia of Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Would show continued circulating blasts with basophilic blebbed cytoplasm or cytopenias, not seen at this power but requiring high-power and flow confirmation.
Reduced counts with neutropenia and thrombocytopenia would suggest marrow failure or evolving ML-DS rather than simple regression; correlate with the CBC.

63205.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 中，多顆大型組織細胞的胞質淡染、呈細網狀泡沫樣，細胞膜清楚、細胞核小而圓位於中央，夾雜在造血細胞之間；胞質內偶見細小黃褐色點狀色素。
features: Clusters and single large polygonal histiocytes with well-defined cell borders
Abundant pale, finely vacuolated to reticulated foamy cytoplasm
Small round to oval, centrally placed nuclei with bland chromatin
Occasional fine brown-green cytoplasmic specks, possibly ceroid pigment
Intervening hematopoietic cells including erythroid precursors and myeloid cells
63205.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E, high power) shows numerous large polygonal histiocytes with well-defined cell borders, abundant pale, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm and small, round, centrally placed bland nuclei. Occasional fine brown-green cytoplasmic specks, possibly ceroid pigment, are present. The foamy cells are interspersed among residual erythroid and myeloid precursors. No nuclear atypia or striated fibrillary cytoplasm is seen. Findings are consistent with infiltration by foamy storage macrophages, as seen in Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have eosinophilic, fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm with eccentric nuclei rather than bubbly clear vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Metastatic clear cell or signet ring carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells have atypical, often hyperchromatic nuclei, form cohesive nests and are cytokeratin positive, unlike CD68-positive bland histiocytes.
Infected histiocytes are often striated, form granulomatous clusters and contain acid-fast bacilli.
Lipogranulomas are small aggregates of lipid vacuoles with lymphocytes and occasional giant cells rather than sheets of uniformly foamy cells.

exam.answer_en: Marrow infiltration by foamy storage macrophages (Niemann-Pick cells) — sheets of histiocytes with finely vacuolated cytoplasm and small central bland nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：切片上看到成片淡染大細胞，先回答「是組織球還是上皮腫瘤」：CD68/CD163 陽性、cytokeratin 陰性即可確認為組織球。
核位置是考點：Niemann-Pick 細胞核小而居中、胞質泡泡狀；Gaucher 細胞核偏心、胞質嗜伊紅纖維條紋狀。
胞質內黃褐色細點可能是 ceroid 色素，代表脂質氧化堆積，與抹片上的 sea-blue histiocyte 屬同一變化。
切片形態只能報 storage histiocytosis，確診仍需 acid sphingomyelinase 活性與 SMPD1 或 NPC1/NPC2 基因檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為轉移性 clear cell 或 signet ring carcinoma；癌細胞核有異型、成巢且 cytokeratin 陽性，此處核溫和、散在造血細胞間且為 CD68 陽性組織球。

quiz.q: 要證明這些淡染大細胞是組織球而非轉移癌，最基本的兩個 IHC 為何、預期結果？
quiz.a: CD68（或 CD163）陽性、cytokeratin（如 AE1/AE3）陰性

63141.recognize_zh: CD3 圈選的 T 細胞中，CD4 陽性（綠）族群絕大部分落在 CD7 陰性區，只剩少量 CD4+CD7+ 正常細胞；CD4 陰性（紅，多為 CD8）T 細胞則保留 CD7。這種擴張的 CD4+CD7− 族群支持 Sézary 細胞。
features: Dot plot gated on CD3+ T cells: CD4-FITC (x) versus CD7-APC700 (y)
Dominant CD4+ population (green) with loss of CD7 expression
Small residual CD4+CD7+ subset (normal helper T cells) above the main cluster
CD4-negative T cells (red, presumably CD8+) retain normal CD7 expression
Marked predominance of CD4+ over CD4-negative T cells
63141.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on CD3-positive T cells shows a markedly expanded CD4-positive population, the majority of which lacks CD7 expression. A small subset of CD4-positive T cells retains CD7, and the CD4-negative T cells show normal CD7 expression, serving as internal controls. Findings indicate an aberrant CD4+CD7− T-cell population, consistent with involvement by Sézary syndrome in the appropriate clinical context (erythroderma, lymphadenopathy).

ddx.dx: Reactive CD4+CD7− T cells (e.g., benign erythrodermic dermatitis, aging)
ddx.vs: Small CD4+CD7− subsets occur in reactive states, but Sézary syndrome requires a large clonal population (e.g., CD4+CD7− ≥40% or CD4+CD26− ≥30%, CD4:CD8 ≥10) with TCR clonality.
T-PLL usually retains strong CD7 and shows TCL1 overexpression with inv(14)/t(14;14), whereas Sézary cells characteristically lose CD7 and CD26.
ATLL is also CD4+CD7− but is typically CD25 bright, HTLV-1 positive, with flower cells in blood.

exam.answer_en: Flow cytometry of Sézary syndrome — CD3-gated T cells show an expanded aberrant CD4+CD7− population with CD4− T cells retaining CD7
pearls_zh: 判讀法：先確認已 gate 在 CD3+ T 細胞，再看 CD4（x 軸）對 CD7（y 軸）；右下象限大群 CD4+CD7− 即異常族群，CD4− 細胞保留 CD7 作為內部對照。
ISCL/EORTC B2 的 flow 指標：CD4+CD7− ≥40%、CD4+CD26− ≥30% 或 CD4/CD8 ≥10，需加上與皮膚一致的 TCR 克隆才成立。
CD26 缺失比 CD7 缺失更具特異性；標準 panel 應同時包含 CD26，並可加 KIR3DL2（CD158k）提高敏感度。
鑑別：ATLL 同為 CD4+CD7−，但 CD25 常強陽性、HTLV-1 陽性；T-PLL 通常保留強 CD7 並有 TCL1 過度表現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 少量 CD4+CD7− T 細胞在老化與良性發炎性皮膚病也會出現，不能單憑存在此族群就診斷；需達門檻比例且有克隆性證據。

quiz.q: 這張 CD4 對 CD7 散佈圖中，綠色主族群的表型為何？支持哪個診斷？
quiz.a: CD4+CD7−（CD7 缺失）T 細胞擴增；支持 Sézary syndrome

63013.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見中型異常淋巴球，胞質淡藍、周邊有空泡且透亮，核呈分葉或腦回狀；流式在 CD4+ T 細胞中找到一群 CD10+（35.5%）的濾泡輔助 T 細胞表型，淋巴結切片則為多形性浸潤伴高內皮小靜脈，支持血管免疫母細胞性 T 細胞淋巴瘤（AITL）的周邊血侵犯。
features: Medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with moderate pale-blue cytoplasm containing peripheral vacuoles and clear zones (A-D, G)
Irregular, lobulated to cerebriform nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Occasional large basophilic immunoblast-like/plasmacytoid cells (E, F arrow)
Flow cytometry gated on CD4+ lymphocytes shows a distinct CD10+ subset (35.5%) with variable CD200 (H)
Lymph node H&E with polymorphous infiltrate of small-medium lymphocytes, clear cells, eosinophils and vessels (I)
63013.describe_en: Composite figure. Peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm containing vacuoles and perinuclear clearing, and irregular lobulated to cerebriform nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin (panels A-D; cytospin cluster in G). Scattered large basophilic immunoblast-like cells are also present (E, F). Flow cytometry gated on CD4+ lymphocytes demonstrates an aberrant CD10+ T-cell population comprising about 35% of CD4+ events (H), and the lymph node shows a polymorphous infiltrate with prominent vasculature and clear cells (I). Findings are consistent with circulating angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type).

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform nuclei but lack clear vacuolated cytoplasm and are CD4+CD7-CD26- without CD10 or other TFH markers (PD1, ICOS, CXCL13).
ATLL shows polylobated 'flower cells' with more condensed chromatin, CD25 strong expression, and HTLV-1 serology, rather than a CD10+ TFH phenotype.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells and do not form a phenotypically aberrant CD4+CD10+ population or clonal TCR rearrangement.
PTCL-NOS lacks expression of two or more TFH markers (CD10, PD1, ICOS, CXCL13, BCL6) and the node lacks the FDC meshwork expansion and HEV proliferation of AITL.

62949.recognize_zh: CD3 染色中只有散在的小型反應性 T 細胞呈棕色膜/質染色，背景大片中型腫瘤細胞為藍色陰性，說明腫瘤不是 T 細胞來源，是判讀被套細胞淋巴瘤時的內部對照。
features: Scattered small CD3-positive T cells with membranous/cytoplasmic staining
Sheets of intermediate-sized neoplastic cells negative for CD3
Positive T cells are small and dispersed, not forming sheets
Some granular extracellular/dot-like background staining
62949.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 highlights scattered small reactive T cells, while the diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized neoplastic lymphoid cells are negative. There is mild granular background staining. The CD3-negative tumor population supports a B-cell neoplasm; in this case the tumor cells express CD5 and cyclin D1, consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: In PTCL the neoplastic sheets themselves are CD3+, whereas here CD3 marks only scattered small background T cells.
T-LBL shows diffuse CD3 (cytoplasmic) and TdT positivity of the blastic population, unlike the CD3-negative tumor here.
THRLBCL has an overwhelming CD3+ T-cell background with only rare large B cells, rather than CD3-negative monotonous sheets.

62821.recognize_zh: CD138 染色呈異質性：中央一大片細胞為中等強度膜狀陽性、外圍許多細胞為陰性，另有散在單個或小群、染色極深的細胞（殘存正常漿細胞）；腫瘤細胞染色強弱不一，提醒 CD138 並非漿細胞專一標記，癌細胞也會陽性。
features: IHC for CD138 on a cellular marrow core with scattered fat spaces
Central sheet of cells with moderate membranous and cytoplasmic staining
Adjacent large areas of tumor cells negative for CD138
Scattered single cells and small clusters with strong, dark staining, consistent with residual plasma cells
Heterogeneous staining intensity (absent, moderate, strong) across the field
62821.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD138 on the bone marrow core shows heterogeneous staining of the neoplastic infiltrate, with a central sheet of cells showing moderate membranous and cytoplasmic positivity and surrounding areas that are negative. Scattered single cells and small clusters with strong, crisp staining are also present and likely represent residual reactive plasma cells. CD138 (syndecan-1) is expressed by many carcinomas, so positivity does not establish plasma cell lineage. Correlation with cytokeratin, GATA3 and kappa/lambda stains supported metastatic carcinoma with plasmacytoid morphology.

ddx.vs: Myeloma typically shows uniform strong CD138 positivity with kappa or lambda restriction, whereas this infiltrate stains variably and is light chain negative.
Reactive plasma cells are strongly positive but scattered and polytypic, like the dark-staining residual cells here, not forming variably stained sheets.
Carcinoma cells may be CD138 positive but are distinguished by cytokeratin, GATA3 and ER expression.

62757.recognize_zh: 周邊血液出現單核、細胞質帶紫色顆粒且有尾狀突起的不典型肥大細胞；骨髓切片被瀰漫陽性的肥大細胞免疫染色取代；抹片另見吞噬血球的巨噬細胞，符合肥大細胞白血病合併噬血現象。
features: Circulating atypical mononuclear cells with basophilic cytoplasm, sparse purple granules and cytoplasmic tail-like projections; neutrophil for comparison (A)
Bone marrow biopsy diffusely replaced by cells with strong cytoplasmic immunostaining (B; mast cell marker, not labeled)
Atypical mast cell with oval nucleus, hypogranular vacuolated cytoplasm and a unipolar cytoplasmic process (C)
Macrophage containing engulfed nucleated cell/red cells, indicating hemophagocytosis (D)
Rouleaux-like red cell stacking in background (C, D)
62757.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating atypical mononuclear cells with basophilic, partially hypogranular cytoplasm containing scattered purple metachromatic granules and tail-like cytoplasmic projections. The bone marrow biopsy is diffusely effaced by cells showing strong cytoplasmic immunoreactivity for a mast cell marker (antibody not labeled). Aspirate smears show atypical hypogranular mast cells with vacuolated cytoplasm and a macrophage containing phagocytosed hematopoietic cells. Findings are consistent with mast cell leukemia accompanied by hemophagocytosis, arising in a patient with myelodysplastic syndrome; quantitation of mast cells (≥20% on aspirate) and tryptase, CD117, CD25 and KIT D816V studies are required.

ddx.dx: Basophilic leukemia / chronic myeloid leukemia with basophilia
ddx.vs: Basophils have lobulated nuclei with coarse granules obscuring the nucleus, are tryptase-negative or weak and CD117-negative, and CML is BCR-ABL1 positive.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts lack metachromatic granules and tryptase/CD117 co-expression and are CD14/CD64 positive.
Myelomastocytic leukemia has increased myeloblasts with metachromatic cells but does not meet criteria for systemic mastocytosis (no CD25 aberrancy, no KIT D816V, no compact aggregates).
HLH shows hemophagocytic macrophages without an infiltrate of neoplastic tryptase/CD117-positive mast cells.

62693.recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD3 對 CD2 流式圖：綠色 CD3 陰性 NK 細胞 CD2 陽性（約 10^1），呈水平延伸的大族群；藍色 T 細胞 CD2、CD3 皆陽性，紫色族群 CD2、CD3 皆陰性（B 細胞）。
features: Dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD3-PC5.5 (x) versus CD2-PC7 (y)
Large green CD3-negative population with CD2 expression (~10^1), extending horizontally
Blue CD3-positive T cells with slightly brighter CD2
Magenta CD2-negative, CD3-negative population near origin (B cells)
NK population retains CD2, without loss
62693.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD3 versus CD2. A large surface CD3-negative, CD2-positive population consistent with NK cells is present alongside CD2-positive, CD3-positive T cells and a small CD2/CD3 double-negative B-cell population. The NK cells retain CD2 expression at slightly lower intensity than T cells. Together with CD7, CD56 and CD57 expression on other tubes, findings support the expanded NK-cell population of the reported chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells express surface CD3, whereas the expanded CD2-positive population here is surface CD3 negative.
Reactive NK cells have the same CD2+CD3- phenotype, so persistence over 6 months and KIR restriction are needed to support clonality.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma with blood involvement
ddx.vs: ENKTL cells are EBV positive, cytoplasmic CD3 epsilon positive and CD56 bright, and present with a destructive extranodal mass.

62629.recognize_zh: 體液細胞塊中大型腫瘤細胞核呈強烈且帶斑點顆粒狀的 LANA 陽性，而較小的淋巴球核為藍色陰性；大型細胞 LANA 核染色是確立 PEL 的關鍵。
features: Effusion cell block with aggregates of large tumor cells and small lymphocytes
Strong nuclear LANA (HHV8) staining in large cells, with coarse speckled/granular pattern in many
Small admixed lymphocytes are negative (blue nuclei)
Positive cells have enlarged nuclei with occasional visible nucleoli
Clean background
