62629.describe_en: LANA-1 (HHV8) immunohistochemistry on an effusion cell block shows strong nuclear staining, frequently with a speckled granular pattern, in the large neoplastic cells, whereas admixed small reactive lymphocytes are negative. Nuclear LANA positivity in the tumor cells confirms HHV8 latent infection and is the defining diagnostic feature. In a lymphomatous effusion lacking B-cell antigens and immunoglobulin, findings are diagnostic of primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Fluid overload-associated large B-cell lymphoma (HHV8-negative effusion lymphoma)
ddx.vs: This entity is morphologically similar but LANA-negative and usually CD20-positive.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shares CD20 loss and MUM1 positivity but is LANA-negative.

ddx.dx: Pyothorax-associated DLBCL (DLBCL associated with chronic inflammation)
ddx.vs: It forms a pleural mass after long-standing pyothorax, is EBV-positive, CD20-positive and HHV8-negative.
Carcinoma is keratin-positive and LANA-negative.

exam.answer_en: Primary effusion lymphoma — strong speckled nuclear LANA-1 (HHV8) staining of large neoplastic cells in effusion cell block
pearls_zh: 考法：體液細胞塊中考官指棕色核陽性大細胞問染色意義（HHV8 潛伏感染），並指出小淋巴球為陰性內對照。
PEL 定義性特徵：腫瘤細胞 HHV8/KSHV 陽性；典型發生於體腔積液（胸、腹、心包膜）而無腫塊，常 EBV 共感染。
體液 flow 常見 CD45+ 但缺 CD19/CD20/CD79a 與表面 Ig，並表現 CD38/CD138，容易被誤認為非淋巴瘤。
WHO 5th 新增 fluid overload-associated large B-cell lymphoma：HHV8 陰性、常 CD20 陽性、多見於心衰竭或肝硬化積液，預後較 PEL 好。
exam.pitfall_zh: 體液中的大型 CD20 陰性細胞易被誤判為轉移癌或間皮細胞；癌 keratin+、間皮 calretinin+，LANA-1 核陽性才支持 PEL。

quiz.q: 積液細胞塊中大細胞 LANA-1 核陽性，最可能診斷？與 fluid overload-associated LBCL 的關鍵差異？
quiz.a: Primary effusion lymphoma；後者 HHV8 陰性（常 CD20+）

62565.recognize_zh: 這是次世代定序（Archer FusionPlex RNA 融合檢測）的 JBrowse 截圖：大量讀序（reads）連續跨越 TRAF1 外顯子與 ALK 外顯子 20 的交界，代表 TRAF1-ALK 融合，是 NPM1 以外的變異型 ALK 夥伴基因。
features: Genome browser (JBrowse) view of an RNA-based fusion panel (Archer FusionPlex) contig
Annotation tracks show TRAF1 exon sequence (red arrow) juxtaposed to ALK exon 20 (black arrow) within one contig
High read coverage (about 3,000 reads) spanning the junction, supporting a true fusion transcript
Stacked aligned reads in the lower panel with only sporadic mismatches
62565.describe_en: The figure is a genome browser screenshot from an RNA-based targeted next-generation sequencing fusion assay. The assembled contig contains TRAF1 exon sequence (red arrow) contiguous with ALK exon 20 (black arrow), and the junction is supported by deep read coverage of approximately 3,000 reads, indicating an in-frame TRAF1-ALK fusion transcript that retains the ALK kinase domain. TRAF1 is a rare, non-NPM1 ALK partner; because the fusion protein lacks the NPM1 nuclear localization domain, ALK immunostaining is expected to be cytoplasmic without nuclear staining. The result supports a diagnosis of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context.

62501.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中淋巴球明顯增加，多為小型成熟淋巴球，核圓、染色質呈塊狀、細胞質極少；畫面中有數個破碎的塗抹細胞（smudge cells），另可見一個中性球，這是 CLL 的典型血液表現。
features: Absolute increase in small mature lymphocytes
Round nuclei with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant pale blue cytoplasm
Numerous smudge cells (disrupted lymphocyte nuclei)
Occasional lymphocytes with slightly more cytoplasm or mildly irregular nuclei
Normochromic, normocytic red cells and a single neutrophil
62501.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, dense clumped chromatin, and scant cytoplasm. Numerous smudge cells are present, and a few lymphocytes show slightly more abundant cytoplasm or mildly irregular nuclei. Red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic, and a single neutrophil is seen. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry showing a monoclonal B-cell count of at least 5 x 10^9/L with a CD5/CD23-positive phenotype.

ddx.vs: MCL cells are more pleomorphic with irregular or cleaved nuclei and are CD23-negative and cyclin D1-positive.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, and smudge cells are not prominent.
SMZL cells show polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are CD5- and CD23-negative.
Pertussis produces small lymphocytes with cleaved nuclei in children, and they are polyclonal T cells.

exam.answer_en: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia — absolute lymphocytosis of small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and numerous smudge cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指著破碎的核殘骸問「這是什麼細胞」（smudge cell），並問診斷門檻：周邊血單株 B 細胞需 ≥5×10⁹/L 才診斷 CLL，未達者為 MBL。
確診靠 flow：CD19+、CD5+、CD23+、CD200+，表面輕鏈與 CD20、CD79b 弱表現、FMC7 陰性。
預後檢測：del(17p)/TP53 突變與 IGHV 未突變者預後較差，會影響標靶藥物選擇；FISH 常見 del(13q) 為單獨異常時預後較好。
併發症：自體免疫溶血性貧血、ITP、低丙種球蛋白血症與感染，以及轉化為大細胞淋巴瘤（Richter transformation）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 mantle cell lymphoma 白血病期：MCL 細胞核較不規則、CD23 陰性且 cyclin D1/SOX11 陽性、t(11;14)；CLL 核圓、染色質塊狀、CD23 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中被壓碎的淋巴球殘骸叫什麼？用什麼方法可減少其形成？
quiz.a: Smudge cell；製片前加入白蛋白（albumin）

62437.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見一大團緊密黏聚、呈合胞體樣排列的小圓藍細胞，核圓且大小相近、核質比很高，細胞之間夾有淡藍紫色細絲狀物質；造血細胞在抹片上不會這樣成團黏聚，這種細胞團（伴有類似玫瑰花環排列）指向轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Large cohesive, syncytial-appearing cluster of small round blue cells
High N:C ratio with round to oval nuclei, relatively uniform size and occasional nuclear molding
Fine to slightly granular chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Scant pale-blue cytoplasm merging with faint fibrillary intercellular material (neuropil-like)
Possible vague rosette-like arrangement around central fibrillary material, not sharply defined in this photograph
Background grey-tinted red cells; camera photo with limited sharpness
62437.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a large cohesive cluster of small round blue cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to oval nuclei with focal molding, and fine chromatin without prominent nucleoli. The cells are embedded in scant pale cytoplasm and faint fibrillary material, with a vague rosette-like arrangement, although a well-formed Homer Wright rosette is not sharply resolved in this photograph. Cohesive clusters of this type are not a feature of hematopoietic cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the marrow.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts do not form cohesive clusters with molding or neuropil, and they express CD45 and TdT.
Ewing sarcoma may cluster but typically lacks neuropil and true Homer Wright rosettes, and is CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 fusion.
Rhabdomyosarcoma clusters can mimic this but show cytoplasmic vacuoles and occasional multinucleation and are desmin/myogenin-positive.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte clusters or aspirate clumps of normal precursors
ddx.vs: Normal marrow clumps contain a mixture of maturing lineages with granules and varied cell sizes, rather than a monotonous molded population.

62373.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見數個核圓、不分葉或僅雙葉的小型巨核細胞，旁邊有核染色質較開放的母細胞與紅血球前驅細胞，小型低分葉巨核細胞提示 inv(3)/t(3;3) AML。
features: Several megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or bilobed nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Intermixed immature cells with oval nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Clusters of erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei
Hypercellular marrow spaces between fat vacuoles
Black granular pigment deposits, most likely fixative artifact or hemosiderin
62373.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a cellular marrow containing numerous immature mononuclear cells with open chromatin, admixed with erythroid precursors. Megakaryocytes are conspicuous and dysplastic, with small size and round monolobated or bilobed nuclei. Black granular deposits consistent with fixative pigment are present. Findings are suggestive of AML with inv(3)(q21q26.2)/t(3;3)(q21;q26.2), GATA2::MECOM, pending blast enumeration and cytogenetic correlation.

ddx.vs: del(5q) has similar hypolobated megakaryocytes but low blast counts and a del(5q) karyotype.
MPN megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated (staghorn) or hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei rather than small monolobated forms, and blasts are not increased.
Multilineage dysplasia is shared, and only cytogenetic demonstration of 3q26 MECOM rearrangement assigns the specific entity.

exam.answer_en: AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) (GATA2::MECOM) — small monolobated/bilobed megakaryocytes among blasts and erythroid precursors on marrow biopsy
pearls_zh: 考法：切片上比較巨核細胞大小與核葉數，問「這些巨核細胞正常嗎」：小型、單/雙葉為發育不良，不同於 MPN 的大型多葉巨核細胞。
切片上母細胞計數受限，可用 CD34（部分 AML 為 CD34−）與 CD61/CD42b IHC 分別凸顯母細胞與小型巨核細胞。
inv(3)/t(3;3) 中 GATA2 的 enhancer 被移位到 MECOM 旁，使 MECOM（EVI1）過度表現、同時 GATA2 一個 allele 功能下降。
臨床與治療：血小板常不低，預後差，第一次緩解考慮 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 MPN（如 ET）巨核細胞增加混淆：MPN 巨核細胞大且多葉（staghorn）或雲狀深染核、母細胞不增加；本圖為小型低分葉巨核細胞並伴母細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中巨核細胞的大小與核葉有何異常？與 MPN 的巨核細胞如何區分？
quiz.a: 小型、單葉或雙葉（hypolobated）；MPN 為大型、多葉或深染雲狀核

62309.recognize_zh: 這是分子檢查圖：A 為 IGV 定序讀段，所有讀段在同一位置都顯示變異鹼基（綠色 A）；B 為 Sanger 定序圖，標示位置只有單一峰而無雙峰，表示同型合子（homozygous）變異，支持 ABCG5/ABCG8 相關的地中海型口形紅血球症（sitosterolemia）。
features: Panel A: Integrative Genomics Viewer display with every aligned read carrying the same alternate base (green A) at one position
Near-100% variant allele fraction in panel A indicates a homozygous variant
Gene track label at the bottom reads ABCG8 at this resolution (ABCG5 and ABCG8 are adjacent, bidirectionally transcribed genes)
Panel B: Sanger chromatogram with a single clean peak at the highlighted position and no superimposed wild-type peak, confirming homozygosity
62309.describe_en: The figure shows molecular confirmation of the variant rather than morphology. Panel A is an Integrative Genomics Viewer screenshot in which all aligned next-generation sequencing reads show the same single-nucleotide substitution at the highlighted position, indicating a homozygous change; the gene annotation track appears to read ABCG8 at this resolution, whereas the description reports ABCG5 c.727C>T (p.Arg243Ter), and the two genes lie head-to-head on chromosome 2p21. Panel B is a Sanger sequencing chromatogram showing a single substituted peak at the highlighted base without a residual wild-type peak, confirming homozygosity in the index case. A homozygous nonsense variant in ABCG5/ABCG8 supports a diagnosis of sitosterolemia presenting as Mediterranean stomatocytosis/macrothrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: A carrier would show roughly 50% variant reads in IGV and overlapping double peaks on the Sanger trace, unlike the uniform variant calls here.
Overhydrated or dehydrated hereditary stomatocytosis lacks macrothrombocytopenia and phytosterolemia and is caused by PIEZO1/RHAG rather than ABCG5/ABCG8 variants.

ddx.dx: Allele dropout or deletion in trans
ddx.vs: An apparent homozygous call may reflect a deletion on the other allele or primer-site dropout, excluded by parental testing or copy-number analysis.

62245.recognize_zh: CD3 免疫染色中，胸腺小葉內的小淋巴球大片呈棕色膜狀陽性，而旁邊的甲狀腺濾泡與左下方一小區淋巴球為陰性，顯示此淋巴組織以 T 細胞（胸腺細胞, thymocytes）為主。
features: Diffuse strong membranous CD3 staining of densely packed small lymphocytes filling the thymic lobules
Sharply demarcated CD3-negative lymphoid area at the lower left of the lobule (B-cell compartment)
Scattered CD3-positive T cells extending between adjacent thyroid follicles
Thyroid follicular epithelium and colloid are negative
Linear dark artifacts represent section folds/knife lines
62245.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry on the cervical nodule highlights the great majority of the lymphoid cells within the thymic lobules with strong membranous staining, consistent with a T-cell (thymocyte) population. A discrete CD3-negative lymphoid zone at the periphery corresponds to a B-cell region, and occasional T cells infiltrate between the adjacent CD3-negative thyroid follicles. The organized distribution and preserved lobular architecture support a benign process. Findings are consistent with a cervical thymic remnant with intermixed ectopic thyroid tissue.

ddx.vs: Both are CD3/TdT-positive T cells, but lymphoblastic lymphoma effaces architecture and lacks the preserved CK5/6/p63-positive epithelial meshwork and normal cortex-medulla TdT compartmentalization seen in thymic tissue.
A nodal paracortex is CD3-positive but is TdT-negative and lies beneath a capsule with sinuses and CD20-positive follicles, without a cytokeratin-positive epithelial network.

62117.recognize_zh: 這是一張 3D 示意圖：紅色、雙凹圓盤狀（biconcave disc）、中央凹陷而邊緣較厚的無核細胞，即正常紅血球的立體外形，對應抹片上中央淡染區（central pallor）的由來。
features: Three-dimensional rendered illustration, not a photomicrograph
Biconcave disc shape with a thick rounded rim and thin central depression
No nucleus or organelles depicted
Central depression corresponds to central pallor (about one-third of diameter) on smears
62117.describe_en: This is a schematic three-dimensional illustration of a normal erythrocyte rather than a microscopic image. It depicts an anucleate biconcave disc with a thickened peripheral rim and a thin central depression. On a Wright-stained peripheral smear this geometry produces a round cell of roughly 7-8 micrometers with central pallor occupying about one-third of the diameter. The depiction is consistent with normal red cell morphology.

62053.recognize_zh: 紅色膜染色標示出許多散在、部分成小群的大型陽性細胞，細胞邊界清楚呈環狀，而周圍絕大多數小淋巴球為陰性；大型 B 細胞散佈在以非 B 細胞為主的背景中，符合 NLPHL 變異型態的 LP 細胞分佈。
features: Numerous scattered large cells with crisp circumferential membranous red staining
Positive large cells occur singly and in small loose clusters
Background small lymphocytes largely negative, with only rare small positive cells
Positive cells distributed diffusely across the field without a compact B-cell nodule
Occasional positive cellular fragments/dendritic-like profiles
62053.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen; antigen not labeled, membranous pattern suggests a B-cell marker such as CD20) shows numerous large positive cells distributed singly and in small loose clusters within a background of predominantly negative small lymphocytes. Compact nodules of small positive B cells are not evident in this field. The pattern of scattered large B cells in a small-lymphocyte background lacking small B cells is consistent with a T-cell-rich variant pattern of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, which should be distinguished from T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma by architectural stains.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL lacks residual small B cells and CD21+ FDC meshworks throughout the specimen; any preserved B-cell-rich nodule favors NLPHL.
HRS cells are typically CD20 weak or negative and CD30/CD15 positive, unlike these strongly membranous-positive large cells.
Reactive immunoblasts show a range of sizes, plasmacytoid maturation, and polytypic light chains rather than monotonous LP-cell atypia.

61989.recognize_zh: 數位影像拼圖（標示 Lymphocyte, variant form）中的淋巴球體積大，細胞質豐富、淡藍到灰藍色，邊緣較深藍並貼合周圍紅血球（scalloping），部分含少量嗜天青顆粒，核形不規則；形態各異的活化淋巴球是傳染性單核球增多症的典型血片表現。
features: Large lymphocytes, 2-3 times the diameter of a red cell, with low to moderate N:C ratio
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with deeper basophilia at the periphery, scalloping around adjacent red cells
Round, oval, indented or kidney-shaped nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Some cells contain scattered azurophilic granules
Occasional plasmacytoid cell with dense chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Heterogeneous morphology across cells, favoring a reactive rather than monotonous population
61989.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear gallery (automated digital morphology, 'Lymphocyte, variant form') shows numerous large activated lymphocytes with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm that shows peripheral basophilia and indents around adjacent red cells. Nuclei are round to irregular or indented with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli; several cells contain sparse azurophilic granules, and occasional plasmacytoid forms are present. The cells are heterogeneous in size and shape, and no blasts are identified. Findings are consistent with reactive (variant) lymphocytosis, as seen in infectious mononucleosis; correlation with heterophile antibody or EBV serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: LGL leukemia shows a monotonous population of medium-sized cells with round nuclei and discrete coarse azurophilic granules, without the heterogeneous, scalloping basophilic cytoplasm of reactive lymphocytes, and requires clonal T-cell studies.
Blasts have fine open chromatin, visible nucleoli and a high N:C ratio, whereas these cells have condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm.
Lymphoma cells are monotonous with similar nuclear irregularity across cells and show light-chain restriction by flow cytometry, unlike the spectrum of reactive forms.

exam.answer_en: Reactive (variant) lymphocytes of infectious mononucleosis — heterogeneous large cells with basophilic cytoplasm scalloping around RBCs
pearls_zh: 考法：指細胞質貼附紅血球的淋巴球問名稱（reactive/Downey lymphocyte），並問與 blast、淋巴瘤細胞的差別：形態多樣性。
這些反應性淋巴球大多是被活化的 CD8+ T 細胞，而不是被 EBV 感染的 B 細胞本身。
檢查：heterophile antibody（Monospot），幼兒可偽陰性，需加驗 EBV VCA IgM 與 EBNA 抗體。
其他原因：CMV、急性 HIV、toxoplasmosis、病毒性肝炎、藥物反應；年輕人要考慮急性 HIV。
臨床：急性期避免接觸性運動以防脾破裂；誤用 ampicillin/amoxicillin 常出現皮疹。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 LGL leukemia 或淋巴瘤細胞；反應性淋巴球大小形態多樣、細胞質邊緣深藍貼附紅血球，腫瘤細胞則單一一致。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質豐富、邊緣深藍且貼附紅血球的細胞為何？主要是哪類淋巴球？
quiz.a: Reactive（Downey）lymphocyte；多為活化 CD8+ T 細胞

61925.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小相當一致，但散在幾個淚滴狀／梨形紅血球、少數標靶細胞（中央有一圈色素環），蒼白區輕度擴大而不像缺鐵那樣明顯大小不一，屬於地中海型貧血帶因者常見的輕度異形紅血球表現。
features: Red cells of relatively uniform size with mild hypochromia (slightly enlarged central pallor)
Mild poikilocytosis with scattered teardrop/pear-shaped cells and occasional elliptocytes
Occasional target cells, including one with a distinct ring of hemoglobin within the pallor
A few stomatocyte-like cells with slit-like central pallor
No basophilic stippling, nucleated red cells or fragments seen; white cells not present in this field, limiting size assessment
61925.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells of fairly uniform size with mild hypochromia and mild poikilocytosis, including scattered teardrop and pear-shaped cells, occasional target cells and a few stomatocyte-like forms. Basophilic stippling, nucleated red cells and schistocytes are not seen. No leukocyte is present in the field to gauge red cell size, so microcytosis must be confirmed by the MCV. The findings are nonspecific but compatible with thalassemia trait; beta-thalassemia trait is supported by a high RBC count with low MCV and increased HbA2 on HPLC.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows marked anisocytosis, conspicuous hypochromia and pencil cells with a low ferritin, rather than uniform cells with target and teardrop forms.
Smear morphology overlaps completely; alpha-thalassemia trait has a normal HbA2 and is confirmed by alpha-globin gene analysis.
HbE and HbC traits also show target cells and microcytosis but are distinguished by a variant hemoglobin peak on HPLC or electrophoresis.
Myelophthisic processes show more numerous teardrop cells with nucleated red cells and immature granulocytes (leukoerythroblastosis), absent here.

61797.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中一條遠大於紅血球、彎曲成環狀的細長蟲體，體內充滿排列成柱的深紫色體細胞核，周圍有淡色鞘狀輪廓，這是微絲蚴（microfilaria）。
features: Large, elongated, gently coiled worm many times the length of a red cell lying among erythrocytes
Body filled with a column of densely packed dark purple somatic nuclei
Faint pale outline around the body suggestive of a sheath, and a smooth curving body contour
A magenta-staining elongated internal area in the mid-body, possibly the inner body
One end tapering to a thin tail; whether nuclei extend to the tail tip cannot be judged reliably at this resolution
Background of crowded red cells in a thick area of the smear; no other parasites seen
61797.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large, sheathed-appearing microfilaria coiled among red cells. The larva has a smooth curving body filled with a column of dark-staining somatic nuclei and tapers toward one end; the cephalic space and the distribution of nuclei at the tail tip cannot be assessed with confidence at this resolution. No other parasites or leukocyte abnormalities are evaluable in this field. The findings are consistent with microfilaremia; in an endemic Indian setting with nocturnal sampling, Wuchereria bancrofti is most likely, but species confirmation requires evaluation of tail nuclei and sheath staining, or antigen/PCR testing.

ddx.vs: Also sheathed but has a kinky body with two distinct terminal nuclei at the tail tip, whereas W. bancrofti has graceful curves and no nuclei at the tail tip.
Sheathed with nuclei extending continuously to the tail tip, diurnal periodicity and a West/Central African travel history.
Smaller, unsheathed larva with a blunt tail containing nuclei to the tip.
Cotton fibers or debris lack an organized column of stained nuclei and an internal body structure.

exam.answer_en: Microfilaremia (likely Wuchereria bancrofti, nocturnal) — large sheathed microfilaria with a column of somatic nuclei on blood smear
pearls_zh: 考法：指這條遠大於紅血球的線狀蟲體問「是什麼？如何鑑定種別？」答 microfilaria；鑑定看有無 sheath、頭端空隙（cephalic space）與尾端核的分布。
尾端核：W. bancrofti 尾端無核；Brugia malayi 尾端有兩顆分離的末端核；Loa loa 核延伸到尾尖；Mansonella perstans 無鞘。
週期性：W. bancrofti 與 B. malayi 多為夜間週期性，需在晚上約 22 時至凌晨 2 時採血；Loa loa 為白天週期性。可用厚片、Knott 濃縮法或 membrane filtration 提高檢出。
治療：diethylcarbamazine（DEC）等；Loa loa 高蟲量時 DEC 可能誘發腦病變，onchocerciasis 共感染時亦需避免 DEC，是常考安全性重點。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為纖維、棉絮等抹片雜質：microfilaria 體內有整齊排列的深染體細胞核柱並有頭尾之分；雜質無核且粗細不規則。

quiz.q: 這條血中蟲體是什麼？若懷疑 Wuchereria bancrofti，應在什麼時間採血？其尾端是否有核？
quiz.a: Microfilaria；夜間（約 22 時至凌晨 2 時）；W. bancrofti 尾端無核。

61733.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 TCF4（E2-2）免疫染色：大多數腫瘤細胞呈強而均勻的核染色，陽性核密集成片，背景少數細胞為陰性（藍色核），核陽性的 TCF4 是漿細胞樣樹突細胞譜系的特異標記。
features: Strong, diffuse nuclear TCF4 staining in the majority of intermediate-sized tumor cells
Positive nuclei round to slightly irregular, packed in sheets
Interspersed TCF4-negative background cells with blue hematoxylin-stained nuclei
Faint granular cytoplasmic background staining without membranous pattern
Adipocytes present, indicating residual marrow architecture
61733.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for TCF4 on a bone marrow biopsy shows strong nuclear positivity in the majority of intermediate-sized neoplastic cells, which form confluent sheets between adipocytes. Scattered residual hematopoietic cells are negative. TCF4 (E2-2) is a transcription factor of plasmacytoid dendritic cell lineage, and strong nuclear co-expression with CD123 is highly supportive of plasmacytoid dendritic cell differentiation. Findings are consistent with involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm in conjunction with CD4, CD56 and CD123 expression.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: These pDC nodules are also TCF4+/CD123+ but are usually CD56-negative, composed of mature-appearing cells, and accompany an underlying CMML/AML clone.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts are TCF4-negative or only weak/focal, and express lysozyme and CD14/CD163.

ddx.dx: Burkitt lymphoma or other B-cell neoplasm with TCF3/TCF4 expression
ddx.vs: B-cell lymphomas may show nuclear TCF4 but express PAX5/CD20/CD19 and lack CD123 and CD4.

61669.recognize_zh: GMS 銀染下，綠色背景的組織球內可見成簇、被染成黑色的小型卵圓形酵母菌，大小約 2–5 μm，部分可見窄基出芽（narrow-based budding），這是組織胞漿菌在 GMS 上的典型樣貌。
features: Clusters of black GMS-positive small oval yeast forms about 2-5 um within histiocyte cytoplasm and vacuoles
Occasional narrow-based budding and teardrop-shaped forms
Organisms relatively uniform in size, without hyphae or pseudohyphae
Light green counterstain highlighting histiocytes with oval nuclei and adjacent adipocyte spaces
Scattered single extracellular organisms between cells
61669.describe_en: Grocott methenamine silver stain shows numerous black-staining, small, oval yeast forms measuring approximately 2-5 um, arranged in clusters within histiocyte cytoplasm and vacuoles against a light green background. Several organisms show narrow-based budding, and no hyphae, pseudohyphae or large broad-based budding forms are present. Combined with a negative mucicarmine stain, findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum infection.

ddx.vs: Cryptococcus yeasts are larger and more pleomorphic with a clear capsule halo that is mucicarmine positive, whereas these small uniform yeasts are mucicarmine negative.

Candida glabrata yeasts are of similar size and also bud narrowly, so separation often requires culture, antigen testing or molecular identification, although they are less often packed within histiocytes.
Pneumocystis cysts are GMS positive but are cup- or helmet-shaped with central dot-like thickenings, lie in extracellular foamy exudate and do not bud.
Leishmania amastigotes do not stain with GMS, whereas these organisms are strongly silver positive.

exam.answer_en: Histoplasma capsulatum in bone marrow (GMS) — clusters of black small oval 2–5 µm intracellular yeasts with narrow-based budding
pearls_zh: 判讀：GMS 將真菌細胞壁染成黑色、背景淡綠；看大小（小而一致）、位置（組織球內）、出芽方式（窄基）三件事來鑑別。
鑑別大小與出芽：Cryptococcus 大小不一、窄基出芽且 mucicarmine/Fontana-Masson 莢膜陽性；Blastomyces 較大、寬基出芽；Candida glabrata 大小相近，需靠培養或分子區分。
Pneumocystis 在 GMS 呈杯狀/壓扁乒乓球狀囊體、位於肺泡泡沫團內、不出芽；Leishmania 在 GMS 不染色。
臨床連結：播散型 histoplasmosis 見於免疫低下者，可繼發 HLH；以 urine/serum antigen、培養輔助，先用 liposomal amphotericin B 再轉 itraconazole。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 Cryptococcus：Cryptococcus 大小差異大（約 4–10 µm 以上）、有厚莢膜且 mucicarmine 陽性、常在細胞外；Histoplasma 小而均一、群聚於組織球內。

quiz.q: 這張 GMS 染色中組織球內成群的黑色小型卵圓酵母、帶窄基出芽，最可能是什麼？哪個特殊染色陰性可排除 Cryptococcus？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum；mucicarmine（Cryptococcus 莢膜陽性）。

61605.recognize_zh: 整片單一形態的大型細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質呈泡狀、多有中央核仁，細胞質量中等偏雙嗜色，其間散在含凋亡碎屑的巨噬細胞（starry-sky）；這種免疫母細胞/漿母細胞樣外觀需配合 CD20 陰性、MUM1 與 EBER 陽性才能確診漿母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous large cells, roughly 2-3 times a small lymphocyte
Round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and single central or several small nucleoli (immunoblastic/plasmablastic)
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders; perinuclear hof not conspicuous at this magnification
Scattered tingible-body macrophages with apoptotic debris imparting a starry-sky pattern
Frequent apoptotic bodies and occasional mitoses; no admixed small mature plasma cells or background small lymphocytes
61605.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, effacing proliferation of large monotonous neoplastic cells arranged in sheets. The cells have round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin, central or multiple small nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, resembling immunoblasts/plasmablasts. Numerous tingible-body macrophages and apoptotic bodies produce a starry-sky pattern, indicating a high proliferation rate. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD20/CD45 negative, MUM1 positive, EBER positive), the findings are consistent with EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are medium-sized with squared-off borders, multiple small nucleoli and basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, and are CD20/CD10 positive with Ki-67 near 100% rather than CD20-negative/MUM1-positive.
Immunoblastic DLBCL can look identical on H&E but expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks the plasmacytic program (CD138, PRDM1) of plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology
ddx.vs: Myeloma usually presents with a marrow-based lesion, serum M-protein and CRAB features, retains some mature plasma cell differentiation and is typically EBER negative.

ddx.dx: ALK-positive large B-cell lymphoma / primary effusion lymphoma (extracavitary)
ddx.vs: These share the plasmablastic immunophenotype but are distinguished by ALK expression or HHV8 (LANA) positivity, respectively.

exam.answer_en: Plasmablastic lymphoma (EBV+) — diffuse sheets of large immunoblast/plasmablast-like cells with starry-sky pattern; requires CD20−, MUM1/CD138+, EBER+
pearls_zh: H&E 單看只能說「高惡性度大細胞淋巴瘤、starry-sky」；考法是接著問要做哪些 IHC 才能與 DLBCL、Burkitt 區分。
典型表型：CD20 陰性、PAX5 陰性或弱、CD45 常弱或陰性，CD138、CD38、MUM1/IRF4 陽性，Ki-67 極高；EBER 多數陽性，並常見 MYC rearrangement。
臨床背景：好發於 HIV 或其他免疫低下者（含移植後、老年），經典部位為口腔；預後差。
鑑別重點：plasmablastic myeloma（有 M-protein、CRAB、骨髓漿細胞增生，EBER 多陰性）、ALK-positive LBCL（ALK+）、primary effusion lymphoma（HHV-8/LANA+）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 容易直接判為 DLBCL 或 Burkitt lymphoma；關鍵是 B 細胞標記 CD20/PAX5 消失而漿細胞標記 CD138/MUM1 陽性，形態上無法單靠 H&E 區分。

quiz.q: 這種 starry-sky 大細胞淋巴瘤若 CD20 陰性、CD138 陽性，還需要哪兩項檢查分別排除 PEL 與支持 EBV 相關？
quiz.a: HHV-8（LANA）IHC 排除 PEL；EBER ISH

61541.recognize_zh: 真皮內小圓藍細胞呈實性片狀與巢狀排列，被纖維血管隔間分隔，細胞質極少、染色質細顆粒狀、核仁不明顯；外觀像淋巴瘤或母細胞，但需靠 CK20 核旁點狀與 synaptophysin 陽性、CD45 陰性確立 Merkel 細胞癌。
features: Sheets and nests of small-to-intermediate round blue cells separated by fibrous bands
High N:C ratio with scant cytoplasm and closely packed, molded nuclei
Finely granular (salt-and-pepper) chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Loosely cohesive trabecular pattern with retraction spaces at the periphery of nests
Scattered apoptotic bodies; no glandular or keratinizing differentiation
61541.describe_en: Section of a dermal mass shows a diffuse proliferation of small-to-intermediate round blue cells arranged in sheets, nests and trabeculae separated by fibrous septa. The cells have scant cytoplasm, nuclear molding, finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, with scattered apoptotic bodies. There is no glandular, squamous or melanocytic differentiation. The morphology raises a small round blue cell differential including lymphoma and lymphoblastic leukemia; with CD45 negativity and positivity for keratin (CK20 perinuclear dot-like) and synaptophysin, findings are consistent with Merkel cell carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are discohesive without nested architecture and are TdT+, CD45+, CD19/CD79a+ and keratin-negative; note Merkel cell carcinoma can be PAX5+ and TdT+, a pitfall.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or other cutaneous lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells lack nuclear molding and neuroendocrine chromatin and are CD45+ and CD20+, whereas Merkel cells are CD45− and CK20+.
Morphology is nearly identical, but small cell carcinoma is typically TTF-1+ and CK20−, whereas Merkel cell carcinoma is CK20+ (dot-like) and TTF-1−.
Myeloid sarcoma cells have finer chromatin with more cytoplasm and are MPO, CD33 or lysozyme positive and keratin-negative.

61477.recognize_zh: 觸片中央有一顆特大的多核／多葉細胞，數個大型核擠在一起、染色質淡、可見核仁，大小遠超過周圍的小淋巴球，符合 Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 變異型（lacunar）細胞；圖中未見原描述的箭頭標記。
features: Very large multinucleated/multilobated cell (center top) with several overlapping nuclei, pale chromatin and visible nucleoli
Additional medium-to-large mononuclear cells with oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, some loosely aggregated in strands
Background small lymphocytes with round dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Several small crenated red cells scattered in the background
Clumped cell groups and crush artifact (stringy nuclear material, upper left) typical of touch preparations; arrow cited in the description is not present
61477.describe_en: Touch imprint of a lymph node shows a mixed population of small lymphocytes and larger mononuclear cells. A very large multinucleated or multilobated cell in the center contains several overlapping nuclei with relatively pale chromatin and nucleoli, far exceeding the size of the surrounding lymphocytes, consistent with a Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg variant cell. Loose aggregates of larger cells and crush artifact are present, which could mimic cohesive epithelial groups, and the arrow referenced in the description is not visible on this image. In context, findings are suggestive of classical Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation requires histologic sections with CD30, CD15, PAX5 (weak) and CD45 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form truly cohesive three-dimensional clusters with sharp cell borders and are keratin positive, whereas HRS cells are isolated in a lymphoid background and CD30/CD15 positive.
ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe-shaped nuclei in sheets and are CD30+ with T-cell markers or ALK, lacking the PAX5-weak, CD45-negative HRS phenotype.
Large cells are CD20 and CD45 strongly positive and CD15/CD30 negative, unlike HRS cells.
Immunoblasts are mononuclear with basophilic cytoplasm and a single nucleolus and are CD45+ and CD15-, lacking multilobated nuclei with inclusion-like nucleoli.

61413.recognize_zh: H&E 40x 低倍可見淋巴結被大型、淡染且彼此相鄰的結節取代，結節間以細纖維帶與深染小淋巴球帶分隔，呈明顯的濾泡/結節性生長，是 IRF4 重組大B細胞淋巴瘤常見的架構。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by large, pale, back-to-back nodules
Nodules separated by thin fibrous septa with small vessels and darker bands of small lymphocytes
Nodules appear homogeneous without visible polarization at this magnification
Cytologic detail not assessable at 40x
61413.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows architectural effacement by large, closely packed, pale-staining nodules separated by thin fibrovascular septa and rims of darker small lymphocytes. The nodules are homogeneous without apparent polarization. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. The nodular/follicular growth pattern, with large cell cytology and strong MUM1 expression demonstrated elsewhere, is consistent with large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: FL shows back-to-back follicles of predominantly centrocytes with BCL2 expression and t(14;18), usually without strong MUM1.
Reactive follicles vary in size and shape with polarized germinal centers and preserved sinuses and mantle zones.
NLPBL nodules are composed mainly of small lymphocytes with scattered LP cells, rather than sheets of large cells.

61349.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被寬厚粉紅色膠原帶分隔成多個細胞結節（nodular sclerosis）；右下插圖中大型 Hodgkin/RS 細胞核的 PAX5 染色明顯比周圍強陽性的小 B 細胞弱，是古典型霍奇金淋巴瘤的特徵。
features: Low power: lymph node architecture replaced by cellular nodules
Broad bands of pink, birefringent-appearing collagen separating the nodules (nodular sclerosis pattern)
Individual cell detail not resolvable at this magnification in the main panel
Inset IHC: large multilobated Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-type cell with weak to barely detectable nuclear PAX5
Inset background small lymphocytes with strong nuclear PAX5 serving as internal control
61349.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows effacement of architecture by cellular nodules separated by broad collagen bands. Individual large atypical cells cannot be assessed at this magnification. The inset PAX5 immunostain highlights a large lobulated neoplastic cell with weak nuclear staining in contrast to strongly positive background small B cells. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype, supported by CD30 and usually CD15 positivity of the Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells.

ddx.vs: LP cells have strong PAX5/CD20 and OCT2 expression, are CD30/CD15 negative and sit in expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks without broad birefringent collagen bands.
Shows fine compartmentalizing fibrosis around sheets of large cells with strong CD20/PAX5 rather than broad bands around nodules containing rare weakly PAX5+ cells.
Tumor cells are CD30 strong but PAX5 negative with T-cell markers or cytotoxic proteins, and hallmark cells often form sinusoidal sheets.
Scattered large cells are strongly CD20/PAX5 positive and CD15/CD30 negative in a diffuse T-cell and histiocyte background.

exam.answer_en: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis — cellular nodules separated by broad collagen bands; HRS cell with weak PAX5
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指寬厚膠原帶與插圖中 PAX5 弱陽性大細胞，問「亞型？為什麼 PAX5 比背景小 B 細胞弱？」答：NSCHL；HRS 細胞 B 細胞程式喪失，PAX5 dim 為其特徵。
HRS 細胞 IHC：CD30+、CD15+（多數）、PAX5 弱陽性；CD20 多陰性或弱且不均、CD45 陰性、OCT2/BOB1 常缺失。
NSCHL 為最常見 CHL 亞型，好發青少年與年輕成人，常見前縱膈腔侵犯；特徵細胞為 lacunar cell。
EBV（EBER）在 NSCHL 陽性比例較 mixed cellularity 低。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 NLPHL 混淆（同為結節狀）；NLPHL 之 LP 細胞 PAX5/CD20 強陽性、CD30/CD15 陰性且無寬膠原帶，NSCHL 則有寬厚纖維帶、HRS 細胞 PAX5 弱、CD30+/CD15+。

quiz.q: 插圖大細胞的 PAX5 染色比背景小 B 細胞弱，這支持何種診斷？此細胞還應呈現哪兩個陽性標記？
quiz.a: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma（nodular sclerosis）；CD30 與 CD15

61285.recognize_zh: 這張是血球計數報表而非抹片：紅血球數偏高（6.47×10^6/uL）但血紅素偏低，MCV 57.1 fL、MCH 17.6 pg 明顯降低，Mentzer index（MCV/RBC）約 8.8（<13），指向地中海型貧血帶因者（thalassemia trait）的小球性型態。
features: Non-morphologic CBC printout, not a smear image
RBC 6.47 x10^6/uL (high) with HGB 11.4 g/dL (low) and HCT 36.9% (normal)
Marked microcytosis and hypochromia: MCV 57.1 fL, MCH 17.6 pg, MCHC 30.9 g/dL
RDW-CV 15.3% (mildly high) with RDW-SD 33.5 fL (low, reflecting small cell volume)
Mentzer index (MCV/RBC) approximately 8.8, below 13
61285.describe_en: This figure is a complete blood count report rather than a morphologic image. It shows mild anemia (hemoglobin 11.4 g/dL) with an elevated red cell count (6.47 x10^6/uL) and marked microcytic hypochromic indices (MCV 57.1 fL, MCH 17.6 pg, MCHC 30.9 g/dL). The RDW-CV is only mildly increased, and the calculated Mentzer index is approximately 8.8. A disproportionately low MCV relative to the degree of anemia with erythrocytosis favors thalassemia trait over iron deficiency, although the indices are not diagnostic and iron studies with hemoglobin analysis are required.

ddx.vs: Usually has a low or normal red cell count, a Mentzer index above 13 and a clearly elevated RDW, with low ferritin.
Supported by erythrocytosis and a Mentzer index below 13; confirmed by elevated HbA2 on hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC.
Has similar indices but normal HbA2, requiring alpha-globin gene deletion analysis.
Also gives microcytosis with a high red cell count and is identified by an HbE peak on HPLC or electrophoresis.

61157.recognize_zh: 中央一顆中性球的細胞質被一團均質、無結構、紫紅色的圓形包涵體（hematoxylin body，變性核物質）佔滿，把分葉核擠壓成新月形貼在邊緣，這是 LE 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Single neutrophil containing a large, round, homogeneous magenta-purple inclusion filling most of the cytoplasm
Inclusion is smooth and glassy with no chromatin texture (phagocytosed denatured nuclear material, hematoxylin body)
Neutrophil nuclear lobes compressed and displaced to the periphery as crescentic fragments
Thin rim of pale cytoplasm around the ingested mass
Background of densely packed, overlapping red cells consistent with a buffy coat/thick preparation
61157.describe_en: Buffy coat preparation of whole blood shows a neutrophil whose cytoplasm is occupied by a large, round, homogeneous, glassy purple inclusion lacking chromatin structure. The neutrophil's own nuclear lobes are pushed to the periphery and wrap around the ingested material. The background consists of crowded red cells. Findings are consistent with an LE cell (neutrophil that has phagocytosed antibody-opsonized denatured nuclear material), supportive of systemic lupus erythematosus in the appropriate serologic context (ANA and anti-dsDNA positive).

ddx.vs: A tart cell contains an ingested intact nucleus that retains chromatin pattern and often a rim of cytoplasm, whereas the LE body is structureless and homogeneous.
Apoptotic bodies are usually smaller, dense and pyknotic or fragmented rather than a single large, pale-to-magenta homogeneous mass.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with ingested red cell or cryoglobulin
ddx.vs: Ingested red cells are pink-orange like surrounding erythrocytes and cryoglobulin inclusions are pale blue and often multiple, unlike the purple hematoxylin body.

exam.answer_en: LE cell — neutrophil engulfing a homogeneous structureless hematoxylin body that pushes its nucleus to the periphery
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中性球內均質、無染色質紋理的紫紅圓團，問細胞名稱與包涵體本質 → LE cell；包涵體為被抗核抗體調理而變性的細胞核物質（LE body/hematoxylin body）。
形成機轉：需 anti-nuclear antibody（主要針對 DNA-histone 複合體）作用於受損細胞核，再由中性球吞噬；通常是體外現象，需檢體放置或處理（如 buffy coat）後才出現。
臨床地位：LE cell test 是早期 SLE 檢查，已被 ANA、anti-dsDNA、anti-Sm 取代；但偶可在體液（胸水、心包液、關節液）或周邊血抹片意外發現，仍具提示意義。
LE cell 也可見於 drug-induced lupus（如 procainamide、hydralazine），此類病人常有 anti-histone antibody。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 tart cell：tart cell 吞入的是保留染色質紋理的完整細胞核（常被單核球／組織球吞噬），可見核結構；LE body 則均質、玻璃樣、無染色質結構。

quiz.q: 圖中這顆中性球被稱為什麼細胞？其吞入物與 tart cell 的吞入物有何不同？
quiz.a: LE cell；LE body 是均質無結構的變性核物質，tart cell 吞入的是仍保留染色質紋理的完整細胞核

61093.recognize_zh: 嗜中性球核呈單一圓形或不分葉、染色質粗塊狀（假性 Pelger-Huët 樣），部分細胞核呈團塊狀、形狀怪異或碎裂樣，與秋水仙鹼造成的有絲分裂停滯相符；這些變化在停止暴露後可恢復。
features: Neutrophils with hypolobated, round to oval nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-like)
Cells with dense, irregular, clumped nuclear masses suggestive of arrested/abnormal mitoses (panels B–C)
Bizarre, irregularly fragmented or multilobed nuclear configurations in some granulocytes (panel D)
Cytoplasm retains fine neutrophilic granulation
Background red cells without notable abnormality
61093.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows granulocytes with striking nuclear abnormalities, including hypolobated round nuclei with coarse chromatin resembling pseudo-Pelger-Huet cells, cells with dense clumped chromatin masses suggestive of metaphase arrest, and bizarre irregularly segmented nuclei. Cytoplasmic granulation is preserved. Red cells are unremarkable. In the setting of Colchicum autumnale (colchicine) ingestion, findings are consistent with transient, toxin-induced antimitotic granulocyte abnormalities rather than a primary myelodysplastic process.

ddx.vs: MDS dysplasia persists and is accompanied by cytopenias, hypogranulation and clonal cytogenetics, whereas toxin-related changes resolve after exposure ends.
Inherited PHA affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with bilobed pince-nez nuclei and lacks the bizarre mitotic-arrest forms.
Morphology overlaps; drug history distinguishes them, while colchicine characteristically adds metaphase-arrested cells.
Apoptotic cells show shrinkage with multiple round smooth homogeneous nuclear spheres rather than clumped chromosome-like masses.

61029.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片有大型、核呈單一圓形不分葉的巨核細胞（monolobated megakaryocyte），切片也可見低分葉巨核細胞增加，紅血球系有核間橋接（紅箭頭）；核型第 5 號染色體長臂缺失（紅箭頭），符合 MDS 合併單獨 del(5q)。
features: Aspirate: large megakaryocyte with a single round non-lobated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm
Aspirate: dysplastic erythroid precursors including internuclear bridging (red arrow) and nuclear budding
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis
Biopsy (H&E): normocellular to hypercellular marrow with increased small monolobated/hypolobated megakaryocytes
Karyotype with interstitial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 5 (red arrow)
61029.describe_en: Composite figure. The bone marrow aspirate shows megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated (monolobated) nuclei, and dysplastic erythroid precursors including an internuclear chromatin bridge. The core biopsy shows increased hypolobated and monolobated megakaryocytes without erythroid hypoplasia. Karyotype demonstrates an interstitial deletion of 5q (46,XX,del(5)(q15q35)[9]/46,XX[1]). Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), with erythroid dysplasia including internuclear bridging.

ddx.dx: MDS with multilineage dysplasia with del(5q) plus -7/del(7q)
ddx.vs: Presence of -7/del(7q) or more than one additional abnormality excludes the del(5q) category, which requires karyotype rather than morphology.
MPN megakaryocytes are large and hyperlobated (staghorn) with no erythroid dysplasia, whereas these are monolobated.
CDA shows internuclear bridging but lacks monolobated megakaryocytes and del(5q).

exam.answer_en: MDS with isolated del(5q) — monolobated megakaryocytes with an interstitial 5q deletion on karyotype
pearls_zh: 考法：指圓形不分葉核的大巨核細胞問名稱（monolobated megakaryocyte），再指核型上第 5 號染色體長臂缺失。
定義：del(5q) 單獨存在，或另加一個非 -7/del(7q) 的異常；骨髓 blasts <5%、周邊 blasts <2%（WHO 5th 稱 MDS-5q）。
臨床：好發年長女性，大球性貧血，血小板正常或升高。
治療：lenalidomide 對輸血依賴者效果佳（RPS14 單倍不足、CK1α 降解）；TP53 突變者反應較差、預後差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 ET/MPN 的巨核細胞增生；MPN 巨核細胞大而多分葉（staghorn），MDS-5q 則為單葉圓核，且需核型證實 del(5q)。

quiz.q: 圖中圓形不分葉核的巨核細胞加上核型 5q 缺失，診斷為何？首選藥物？
quiz.a: MDS with isolated del(5q)；lenalidomide

60901.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 觸片中，有核細胞以大型、細胞質豐富粉紅色的細胞為主，細胞核卵圓或腎形偏心、染色質細緻，混有較小的淋巴球與帶雙葉核的嗜酸性球，背景大量紅血球，符合蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症。
features: Predominance of large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and well-defined borders
Oval to reniform, often eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; occasional nuclear folds
Admixed smaller lymphocytes with dark round nuclei, occasional neutrophils and bilobed eosinophils
Abundant background red blood cells
60901.describe_en: H&E-stained touch preparation of the lymph node shows numerous large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei with fine chromatin, some showing folds, predominating among the nucleated cells. Smaller lymphocytes, occasional neutrophils and eosinophils with bilobed nuclei are admixed in a background of abundant red blood cells. There is no significant nuclear pleomorphism or mitotic activity evident. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis in conjunction with the tissue section and CD1a/langerin immunostains.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with clock-face chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof, rather than grooved nuclei in pink cytoplasm with eosinophils.
RDD histiocytes are much larger with emperipolesis and are CD1a negative.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism and prominent nucleoli and is keratin positive.

60837.recognize_zh: 數顆紅血球的血紅素集中於細胞一側、另一側只剩透明的囊泡狀薄膜（像水泡），就是 blister cell（半影細胞，hemighost）；多見於氧化性溶血如 G6PD 缺乏或鐮刀細胞疾病。
features: Several red cells with hemoglobin concentrated eccentrically into a dense segment with a sharp straight or curved border
Opposite portion of each cell is a clear, hemoglobin-free vesicle outlined by a thin membrane (blister/hemighost)
One cell at left with hemoglobin compressed toward an angular pointed contour
Background red cells normocytic with central pallor; a few slightly dense cells
Adequate platelets; no leukocytes in field
60837.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mostly normocytic, normochromic red cells with several blister cells, in which hemoglobin is condensed to one side of the cell and the remainder forms a clear, membrane-bound vesicle. A few adjacent red cells appear dense without central pallor. No bite cells with discrete notches or spherocytes predominate in this field. Findings are consistent with blister cells (hemighosts), which are seen in oxidative hemolysis (e.g., G6PD deficiency) and may also occur in sickling disorders; clinical correlation, G6PD assay and hemoglobin analysis are recommended.

ddx.vs: Bite cells have a notch-like peripheral defect where Heinz bodies were removed, rather than a retained empty membrane vesicle.
HbC crystals form rectangular bar-like hemoglobin condensations with parallel edges rather than a half-filled cell with a curved blister.
Stomatocytes have a slit-like central pallor within a uniformly hemoglobinized cell, and drying artifact produces refractile crenations rather than a hemoglobin-free membrane pocket.

exam.answer_en: Blister cells (hemighosts) — hemoglobin retracted to one side leaving a clear membrane vesicle, indicating oxidative hemolysis such as G6PD deficiency
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指血紅素偏一側、另一半透明囊泡的紅血球，問「這叫什麼？代表哪一類溶血？」→ blister cell / hemighost，氧化性溶血，最常考 G6PD deficiency。
G6PD deficiency：X-linked，台灣新生兒篩檢項目；誘發因子包括蠶豆、感染、primaquine、dapsone、rasburicase、methylene blue 等氧化性藥物。
Heinz body 需以 supravital 染色（如 crystal violet、new methylene blue）才看得到，Wright 染色看不到；脾臟移除 Heinz body 後形成 bite cell。
急性溶血期網狀紅血球富含 G6PD，酵素活性可能假性正常；懷疑時應於溶血緩解後數週重測，或以家族/基因檢測輔助。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 bite cell 混淆：bite cell 邊緣是被咬掉的缺口，沒有殘留膜；blister cell 則保留一個透明、有膜包覆的空泡。兩者常同時出現，都指向氧化性溶血。

quiz.q: 圖中血紅素偏向一側、另一側只剩透明薄膜的紅血球叫什麼？急性溶血期測 G6PD 活性可能出現什麼問題？
quiz.a: Blister cell（hemighost）；網狀紅血球增加使 G6PD 活性假性正常，需緩解後重測

60773.recognize_zh: IgG4 免疫染色在一個反應性淋巴濾泡的生發中心內顯示大量棕色陽性漿細胞（尤其沿生發中心邊緣聚集），而外圍被套層幾乎陰性、濾泡間只有散在陽性細胞，屬於「濾泡內型」IgG4 漿細胞增加的淋巴結表現。
features: Well-circumscribed reactive secondary follicle with a negative mantle zone
Numerous strongly IgG4-positive plasma cells concentrated within the germinal center, accentuated at its periphery
Positive cells show membranous/cytoplasmic staining with round eccentric nuclei
Only scattered IgG4-positive cells in the interfollicular areas and outside the mantle
Counts per high-power field appear well above 50 within the germinal center, but IgG4/IgG ratio cannot be assessed without a companion IgG stain
60773.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for IgG4 shows a reactive secondary follicle with numerous IgG4-positive plasma cells clustered within the germinal center, particularly along its periphery, while the mantle zone is negative and interfollicular positive cells are sparse. A companion IgG stain is required to calculate the IgG4/IgG ratio. Findings are consistent with reactive follicular hyperplasia with increased intrafollicular IgG4-positive plasma cells (progressive transformation or follicular hyperplasia pattern of IgG4-related lymphadenopathy), which requires correlation with serum IgG4 and extranodal disease before diagnosing IgG4-related disease.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific reactive lymphadenopathy with IgG4-positive plasma cells
ddx.vs: Increased IgG4+ cells occur in many reactive nodes, so diagnosis of IgG4-related disease requires an elevated IgG4/IgG ratio above 40% plus clinical, serologic or extranodal evidence.
Plasma cells are predominantly interfollicular in sheets with regressed follicles and systemic inflammation (high IL-6, CRP), often with high IgG4 counts but a low IgG4/IgG ratio.
Follicles are back-to-back without polarization, lack tingible body macrophages and are BCL2 positive in germinal centers, unrelated to IgG4 plasma cell counts.
Also can show increased IgG4+ plasma cells, but has sinusoidal S100+/OCT2+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.

60581.recognize_zh: 周邊血液紅血球中可見明顯粗大嗜鹼性點彩（basophilic stippling），插圖鐵染色顯示幼紅血球有鐵顆粒圍繞核（環狀鐵粒母細胞），合併臨床人格改變，指向鉛中毒。
features: Coarse basophilic stippling in several red cells and polychromatophilic cells
Largely normocytic red cells with occasional target cells and mild anisopoikilocytosis
Neutrophils and platelets unremarkable
Inset iron stain: erythroid precursors with coarse iron granules around the nucleus (ring sideroblasts) and siderotic granules in a macrophage/cytoplasm
60581.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mildly anisopoikilocytic red cells with prominent coarse basophilic stippling in scattered erythrocytes and polychromatophilic cells; leukocytes and platelets appear morphologically unremarkable. An iron-stained preparation (inset) demonstrates erythroid precursors with coarse perinuclear siderotic granules consistent with ring sideroblasts. In a patient with anemia and neuropsychiatric change, findings are suggestive of acquired sideroblastic anemia due to lead poisoning; confirmation requires blood lead level measurement.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia shows microcytosis and target cells with fine stippling but no ring sideroblasts and a normal blood lead level.
Produces identical coarse basophilic stippling from impaired RNA degradation, but is hereditary with low enzyme activity and normal lead levels.
MDS-RS shows dysplastic erythroid/granulocytic lineages and SF3B1 mutation, whereas lead toxicity is reversible and accompanied by elevated lead and zinc protoporphyrin.

ddx.dx: Alcohol- or copper deficiency-related sideroblastic anemia
ddx.vs: Vacuolated early erythroid and myeloid precursors are typical of these, and stippling is less prominent; history, copper/zinc and lead levels discriminate.

exam.answer_en: Lead poisoning — coarse basophilic stippling of red cells, with ring sideroblasts on iron stain (acquired sideroblastic anemia)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指紅血球內粗大藍點問名稱（coarse basophilic stippling），再指鐵染色插圖問 ring sideroblast；結合「人格改變」要答出 lead poisoning。
機轉：鉛抑制 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase，核糖體 RNA 無法分解而聚集成點彩；並抑制 δ-ALA dehydratase 與 ferrochelatase，造成 heme 合成受阻。
必考檢驗：血鉛濃度確診；zinc protoporphyrin（ZPP）與尿 δ-ALA 升高；X 光可見長骨 lead lines，牙齦可見 Burton line。
臨床與治療：腹痛（lead colic）、周邊運動神經病變（wrist drop）、兒童/重症腦病變；首要是脫離暴露，依嚴重度使用 chelation（succimer；腦病變用 dimercaprol 合併 CaNa2EDTA）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 thalassemia trait 混淆：兩者都可見點彩與小球性表現，但地中海型貧血的點彩較細、無 ring sideroblasts、血鉛正常；鉛中毒點彩粗大，並有 ZPP 升高與暴露史。

quiz.q: 紅血球內的粗大嗜鹼性點彩，在鉛中毒中是因為鉛抑制了哪一個酵素？
quiz.a: Pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase（RNA 分解受阻而聚集）。

60645.recognize_zh: A 圖為顆粒豐富、核折疊的異常前骨髓細胞並含 Auer 小體（箭頭）；B–D 圖可見大量吞噬顆粒狀碎屑、細胞質粉紅泡沫狀的組織球，顯示治療後組織球清除 APL 腫瘤細胞。
features: Panel A: sheet of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with folded/bilobed nuclei and dense azurophilic granules; Auer rods indicated by arrows
Panel B: low-power aspirate with numerous large pink-staining histiocytes scattered among hematopoietic cells
Panel C: large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with phagocytosed pink-purple granular debris and cellular fragments
Panel D: marrow biopsy (H&E) with sheets of histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic granular cytoplasm replacing the paratrabecular marrow space
Background of residual myeloid and erythroid precursors in panels C and D
60645.describe_en: Composite figure. The initial aspirate shows sheets of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with folded nuclei and occasional Auer rods. Subsequent aspirate smears show numerous large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm engorged with phagocytosed granular debris, and the corresponding trephine biopsy shows sheets of histiocytes with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm. The ingested material likely represents the azurophilic granules and remnants of neoplastic promyelocytes. Findings are consistent with histiocytic clearance of neoplastic cells in acute promyelocytic leukemia, likely following differentiation/apoptosis-inducing therapy.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm without discrete ingested granular debris and occur in CML or myeloma rather than after APL therapy.
HLH histiocytes engulf intact erythrocytes, platelets and nucleated cells, whereas these contain mainly granular leukemic debris in the setting of APL.
Sea-blue histiocytes have blue-green ceroid granules on Wright-Giemsa rather than the pink-purple azurophilic debris seen here.
Residual disease shows intact abnormal promyelocytes with Auer rods, whereas the histiocytes here contain only phagocytosed fragments.

60709.recognize_zh: A 可見核質發育不同步的巨大紅血球前驅細胞 (megaloblasts)，B 可見巨大帶狀/後骨髓細胞；鐵染色 (C–E) 中多顆有核紅血球周圍出現環狀排列的藍色鐵顆粒，即環形鐵粒母細胞 (ring sideroblasts)，符合維生素 B12 缺乏合併環形鐵粒母細胞。
features: Panel A: enlarged erythroid precursors with open, finely stippled chromatin and relatively mature basophilic-to-polychromatic cytoplasm (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Panel B: giant band/metamyelocyte with large horseshoe nucleus and a hypersegmented-appearing neutrophil nucleus
Panels C-E: iron stain with red counterstain showing erythroblasts with blue siderotic granules
Panels C-D: several erythroblasts with granules arranged in a perinuclear partial ring (ring sideroblasts)
Background red cells show anisocytosis with macrocytes
60709.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows megaloblastic erythroid maturation with enlarged precursors displaying nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, together with giant granulocytic precursors. Iron stain demonstrates erythroblasts with coarse siderotic granules, including forms with granules arranged around the nucleus consistent with ring sideroblasts. In the setting of pancytopenia and documented vitamin B12 deficiency, findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia with ring sideroblasts, which is expected to resolve with replacement; a myelodysplastic neoplasm should not be diagnosed until deficiency is corrected.

ddx.vs: MDS persists after vitamin replacement and shows SF3B1 mutation, whereas megaloblastic changes with ring sideroblasts from B12 deficiency reverse with therapy.
Copper deficiency causes cytoplasmic vacuolization of erythroid and myeloid precursors with ring sideroblasts but normal B12 levels.

ddx.dx: Alcohol- or drug-induced sideroblastic anemia (isoniazid, linezolid)
ddx.vs: Distinguished by exposure history and vacuolated pronormoblasts, without giant metamyelocytes and megaloblastic asynchrony.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows ≥30% proerythroblasts with deep basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and TP53 mutation, not reversible megaloblastic maturation.

exam.answer_en: Vitamin B12 deficiency megaloblastic anemia with ring sideroblasts — nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant myeloid precursors, perinuclear iron granules
pearls_zh: 考法：兩格組合，先指核質不同步的大型紅系前驅細胞（megaloblast），再指鐵染色環繞核的藍色顆粒，問「是什麼？會誤導成什麼診斷？」→ ring sideroblast，勿診斷 MDS。
Ring sideroblast 定義：≥5 顆鐵顆粒、環繞至少 1/3 核周；需在 Prussian blue 染色下計數。
營養缺乏矯正前不應診斷 MDS；copper deficiency（含 zinc 過量）、酒精、isoniazid、linezolid 等也可造成 ring sideroblasts。
B12 缺乏實驗室：MCV 上升、hypersegmented neutrophils、LDH 與間接膽紅素上升；methylmalonic acid 與 homocysteine 皆升高（folate 缺乏只有 homocysteine 升高）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤診為 MDS with ring sideroblasts（SF3B1 突變）：megaloblastic 變化與 ring sideroblasts 在補充 B12 後會消失；MDS 則持續存在且可測得 SF3B1 等突變。

quiz.q: 鐵染色中核周環狀排列的藍色顆粒細胞稱為什麼？其定義為何？
quiz.a: Ring sideroblast；≥5 顆鐵顆粒環繞 ≥1/3 核周

60517.recognize_zh: 視野中許多紅血球邊緣呈鋸齒狀，其中數個細胞較小、較緻密，帶有長短不一、分布不規則的尖刺（棘狀紅血球 acanthocytes）；但也有不少細胞為規則的短突起並保留淡染區，較像棘皮紅血球（echinocytes），判讀時需區分。
features: Several small dense red cells with irregular, unevenly spaced spicules of varying length (acanthocytes)
Many other red cells show regular, short, evenly spaced crenations with retained central pallor (echinocyte-like)
Occasional red cell fragments and irregular forms
Mild anisocytosis; some overlapping cells
No leukocytes or nucleated red cells in this field
60517.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis. Several small, dense red cells lacking central pallor carry irregular, unevenly distributed spicules of varying length, consistent with acanthocytes (spur cells). Numerous additional red cells show regular, short, evenly spaced crenations with preserved central pallor, resembling echinocytes; these may be partly artifactual (thick area/slow drying) and should be assessed in a well-spread area. Findings are consistent with acanthocytosis, as seen in liver disease, with admixed echinocyte-like forms.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes carry many short uniform projections evenly around the cell with central pallor, whereas acanthocytes have few irregular spicules and no pallor.
Storage or drying artifact crenates red cells uniformly across the smear, while true acanthocytes are a subpopulation of dense cells seen in well-spread areas.
Schistocytes are true fragments with sharp straight edges rather than intact cells with multiple spicules.
PK deficiency produces dense echinocytic cells mainly after splenectomy, requiring enzyme assay rather than morphology to separate from liver-disease spur cells.

exam.answer_en: Acanthocytes (spur cells) with admixed echinocyte-like crenated cells — dense RBCs with irregular spicules of varying length
pearls_zh: 考法：同一視野兩種帶刺紅血球並存，考官會要求指出哪顆是 acanthocyte、哪顆是 echinocyte，並說明判準。
判準：acanthocyte 緻密無中央淡染、2–20 個長短不一且不規則分布的突起；echinocyte 保有中央淡染、突起短而等距規則。
Echinocyte 常為人為假影（抹片過厚、乾燥慢、EDTA 久置），也見於尿毒、PK 缺乏與輸血後；應到薄而單層區域再判讀。
Acanthocyte 真實增加時應追查肝病、abetalipoproteinemia、neuroacanthocytosis 等；家族性神經症狀要想到 McLeod syndrome。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易把大量 crenation 假影全部報成 acanthocytosis：假影 echinocyte 突起規則、保有中央淡染且集中於厚片區；真正 acanthocyte 在單層區仍可見且突起不規則。

quiz.q: 圖中突起規則均勻、保有中央淡染的紅血球與緻密帶不規則刺的紅血球各稱為什麼？
quiz.a: 前者 echinocyte（burr cell），後者 acanthocyte（spur cell）

60453.recognize_zh: 抹片中以成熟分葉嗜中性球為主，其中多顆的核葉呈圓形、彼此分開，只以細染色質絲相連（如中央下方與右側數顆），部分細胞質略帶空泡；前驅細胞相對少，呈右移，符合骨髓滯留症（myelokathexis）。
features: Granulocytic predominance with right shift: abundant segmented neutrophils, fewer myelocytes/metamyelocytes
Several neutrophils with 3-5 rounded, condensed nuclear lobes that appear separated and joined by thin chromatin threads
Some neutrophils with faint cytoplasmic vacuolation; granulation otherwise normal
Scattered promyelocyte/myelocyte-stage cells and a few erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
No increase in blasts
60453.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of granulocytic cells with a right-shifted maturation pattern. Many mature neutrophils have hyperlobated nuclei in which rounded, condensed lobes are separated and connected only by thin filamentous chromatin strands, and some show cytoplasmic vacuolation. Earlier granulocytic precursors, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are present in smaller numbers, and blasts are not increased. In a patient with peripheral neutropenia, warts and hypogammaglobulinemia, these features are consistent with myelokathexis of WHIM syndrome.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic neutrophils are enlarged with lobes joined by conventional chromatin bridges and accompanied by giant metamyelocytes and megaloblastic erythroid precursors, which are absent here.
Pelger-Huet cells are hypolobated (bilobed or non-lobed) with clumped chromatin, the opposite of the multiple separated lobes in myelokathexis.
Storage-related degeneration produces round unconnected pyknotic fragments in otherwise old specimens, whereas myelokathexis lobes remain filament-connected in a fresh marrow with neutropenia.

60133.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片左上方是充滿亮紅色顆粒嗜酸性球的高細胞性區域，右下方則是一片紡錘狀細胞呈流線狀、疏鬆排列的聚集，這些拉長、胞質淡嗜酸性的細胞就是紡錘形肥大細胞，合併大量嗜酸性球是PDGFRA重排腫瘤的典型骨髓表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a markedly eosinophil-rich area (bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm) at upper left
Loose, streaming aggregate of spindle-shaped cells with oval to elongated nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm at lower right, consistent with spindled mast cells
Intermixed eosinophils and lymphocytes within the spindle cell aggregate
Associated fine fibrillary stroma/fibrosis within the spindle cell area
A megakaryocyte at left edge; mast cell nature requires tryptase/CD117/CD25 confirmation
60133.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypercellular marrow with a marked increase in eosinophils and eosinophil precursors. Adjacent to this, there is a loose, streaming infiltrate of spindle-shaped cells with oval to elongated nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with eosinophils and associated with fine stromal fibrosis; these are morphologically consistent with spindled mast cells. The aggregate is loose rather than forming compact dense clusters. Tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains and molecular testing for FIP1L1::PDGFRA and KIT D816V are recommended. The findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement.

ddx.vs: SM usually shows compact, well-circumscribed mast cell aggregates of ≥15 cells, often paratrabecular or perivascular with lymphoid cuffs, and KIT D816V, while PDGFRA neoplasms show looser infiltrates and marked eosinophilia without KIT D816V.
PMF shows streaming fibrosis with clusters of atypical megakaryocytes rather than spindled tryptase-positive mast cells with eosinophilia.
Reactive states lack clonal spindled CD25-positive mast cells and PDGFRA rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin or peripheral T-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: Lymphoma infiltrates contain Reed-Sternberg cells or atypical T cells (CD30/CD15 or aberrant T-cell phenotype) in a mixed background, not tryptase-positive spindle cells.

exam.answer_en: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement — eosinophil-rich marrow with loose streaming aggregate of spindled mast cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官先指嗜酸性球密集區，再指鬆散流線狀的紡錘形細胞問是什麼——答 spindled mast cells，接著問必做 IHC（tryptase、CD117、CD25）。
分子：最常見為 FIP1L1::PDGFRA，由 4q12 的 cryptic deletion（含 CHIC2）形成，常規核型看不到，需 FISH（CHIC2 deletion）或 RT-PCR 檢測。
臨床：男性為主，血清 tryptase 常升高、mast cells 常表現 CD25，但 KIT D816V 陰性；嗜酸性球浸潤可造成心內膜心肌纖維化。
治療：對低劑量 imatinib 反應極佳；有心臟侵犯（troponin 升高）時開始 imatinib 前後常合併類固醇以預防急性心肌炎惡化。WHO 5th 歸入 M/LN-eo with tyrosine kinase gene fusions。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 systemic mastocytosis；SM 的 mast cells 形成緻密叢集（≥15 顆）且帶 KIT D816V，PDGFRA 腫瘤的 mast cells 較鬆散散在、KIT D816V 陰性，靠 FIP1L1::PDGFRA FISH/RT-PCR 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜酸性球增多合併紡錘形 mast cells，最可能的融合基因是什麼？為何常規核型常看不到？首選治療為何？
quiz.a: FIP1L1::PDGFRA；由 4q12 cryptic deletion（CHIC2）形成，需 FISH/RT-PCR；imatinib（低劑量即有效）。

60069.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑之間的髓腔幾乎完全被造血細胞填滿、脂肪細胞近乎消失，細胞中可見許多深染小圓核成群分布（提示紅血球系聚落）；這是明顯高細胞性骨髓合併紅血球系增生，在此病例為先天性鐵粒母細胞性貧血的無效造血所致。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with near-complete loss of fat spaces
Numerous clusters of small dark round nuclei suggestive of expanded erythroid colonies
Megakaryocytes present and scattered, without clustering
Intact bony trabeculae without osteosclerosis
Low power limits cytologic assessment; lineage proportions and ring sideroblasts require aspirate and iron stain
60069.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete effacement of fat spaces between intact bony trabeculae. The hematopoietic tissue contains numerous clusters of small cells with dark round nuclei, suggestive of expanded erythroid colonies, together with scattered megakaryocytes; there is no fibrosis or focal lesion at this magnification. Cytologic detail is limited at this power, so lineage proportions should be confirmed on the aspirate or with immunostains (e.g. E-cadherin, glycophorin). Findings are consistent with a hypercellular marrow with erythroid hyperplasia, which in conjunction with ring sideroblasts on iron stain supports congenital sideroblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Also produces a hypercellular erythroid-hyperplastic marrow; iron stain lacking ring sideroblasts and hemoglobin analysis or hemolysis workup distinguish them.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic, loosely clustered megakaryocytes and JAK2 mutation, rather than isolated erythroid expansion with anemia.
Morphologically similar hypercellular marrow but in older adults with multilineage dysplasia and SF3B1 mutation.
Would show sheets of monotonous blasts replacing marrow rather than maturing erythroid clusters with megakaryocytes.

29477.recognize_zh: 脾臟切面瀰漫性暗紅、無結節（A），顯微鏡下紅髓竇與索被中型淋巴瘤細胞填滿、白髓消失（B），免疫染色呈竇狀分布陽性（C），肝臟竇狀隙（D，箭頭）與骨髓竇（E，箭頭）也出現竇內浸潤；肝脾骨髓三處皆為竇內（sinusoidal）分布是肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤的特徵。
features: Panel A: enlarged spleen with homogeneous beefy dark red cut surface and no discrete nodules
Panel B: red pulp expanded by monotonous medium-sized cells with round nuclei and pale cytoplasm in cords and sinusoids, white pulp not evident
Panel C: immunostain highlighting tumor cells in a sinusoidal/cord pattern throughout the red pulp (antigen not labeled)
Panel D: liver with clusters of atypical lymphoid cells within hepatic sinusoids (arrow) without portal-based mass
Panel E: bone marrow biopsy with subtle intrasinusoidal lymphoid infiltrates (arrows) in a fatty marrow
29477.describe_en: Composite figure. The spleen (A) is enlarged with a homogeneous dark red cut surface lacking nodules, and histology (B, H&E) shows diffuse red pulp expansion by monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with loss of white pulp; immunohistochemistry (C) highlights the neoplastic cells in a sinusoidal/red pulp pattern. The liver (D) and bone marrow (E) show subtle intrasinusoidal infiltrates (arrows). Findings are consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma, which typically expresses CD3, CD56 and TCR gamma-delta with CD4/CD5/CD8 negativity and isochromosome 7q. Note that the record category (subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma) does not match the title or images.

ddx.vs: T-LGL shows intrasinusoidal CD8+/CD57+ cytotoxic cells with granular cytoplasm but an indolent course, preserved white pulp and usually TCR alpha-beta.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma / hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These B-cell neoplasms also fill red pulp but express CD20 (and CD103/annexin A1 in HCL) rather than T-cell markers.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is EBV (EBER) positive with surface CD3 negativity and often hemophagocytosis, whereas HSTCL is EBV negative.
Congestion expands red pulp with red cells and fibrosis but lacks a monotonous atypical lymphoid infiltrate.

exam.answer_en: Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma — diffuse red pulp expansion by monotonous medium lymphoid cells with sinusoidal infiltration of spleen, liver and marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：多格合成圖，考官問「三個器官共同的浸潤模式」；答 sinusoidal（竇內）分布，脾臟紅髓擴張、白髓消失，無淋巴結腫大的肝脾腫大是線索。
表型：CD3+、CD56+（常見）、CD4−、CD5−、CD8−（多數），多為 TCR γδ（少數 αβ）；cytotoxic 標記 TIA-1 陽性但 granzyme B/perforin 常陰性（non-activated）。
遺傳：isochromosome 7q［i(7q)］最具特徵，常合併 trisomy 8；分子常見 SETD2、STAT5B、STAT3 突變。
臨床：年輕男性、實體器官移植或 IBD 接受 thiopurine 合併 anti-TNF 治療者風險增加；B 症狀與血球減少明顯，預後差，CHOP 效果不佳，緩解後應考慮 allo-HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 T-LGL leukemia 混淆：T-LGL 病程慢、多為 CD8+/CD57+ αβ T 細胞、骨髓呈間質或竇內小群但臨床溫和；HSTCL 為中型異型細胞、CD4/CD8 雙陰性 γδ、i(7q) 且病程侵襲。注意本紀錄分類標為 SPTCL，與影像不符。

quiz.q: 此病在脾、肝、骨髓皆呈竇內浸潤，最具特徵的細胞遺傳異常為何？腫瘤細胞通常表現哪一型 T 細胞受體？
quiz.a: Isochromosome 7q［i(7q)］；TCR γδ。

29029.recognize_zh: 紅箭頭指的是與血小板差不多大的微小紅血球或碎片，顏色與一般紅血球相同（粉紅橙色、無顆粒），部分呈鋸齒狀；藍箭頭則是含紫色顆粒的真正血小板，兩者容易被血球計數儀混淆。
features: Tiny red cells/red cell fragments of platelet size (red arrows) with homogeneous pink-orange hemoglobin staining and no granules
Some of the small red cells are crenated (spiculated), elongated or teardrop-shaped, mimicking platelet outlines
True platelets (blue arrows) are similar in size but show purple granular (granulomere) centers
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis, including echinocytes/crenated cells and occasional elliptocytes
29029.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous crenated red cells and occasional elliptocytic forms. Scattered very small red cells and red cell fragments, comparable in size to platelets, are present; these are distinguished from adjacent true platelets by their homogeneous pink-orange hemoglobinized staining and lack of purple granules, whereas the platelets show granular purple centers. Such microcytic red cells and fragments can be counted as platelets by impedance analyzers, falsely elevating the automated platelet count; smear review or optical/immunologic platelet counting is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelets contain purple azurophilic granules with a pale hyalomere, whereas microcytic red cells stain uniformly the color of hemoglobin.
Schistocytes are sharply angulated helmet or triangular fragments in the setting of thrombocytopenia and hemolysis, whereas many of these are small round-to-crenated microcytes.
Microspherocytes are dense round cells without spicules, and pyropoikilocytosis additionally shows budding and bizarre fragments with very low MCV.
These are dark purple dots within red cells or on the background rather than free-lying hemoglobinized cells.

26405.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個遠大於周圍骨髓細胞的巨大細胞，有多個分葉核，胞質充滿粗大紫紅色異染性顆粒並向外散落；免疫組化 CD117、CD25 與 tryptase 皆陽性，證實為異常多核肥大細胞（promastocyte）。
features: Giant cell many times the size of adjacent myeloid cells with multiple or multilobated nuclei
Abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse purple-red metachromatic granules, with granules spilling into the background
Background of myeloid precursors, including granulated cells and occasional blasts
IHC: strong CD117 membranous/cytoplasmic positivity (panel B)
IHC: aberrant CD25 expression (panel C) and tryptase positivity (panel D)
26405.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a giant multinucleated cell with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse metachromatic granules, set among myeloid precursors. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates that the giant cells express CD117 and tryptase, with aberrant CD25 expression. Findings are consistent with atypical multilobated mast cells (promastocytes); in the setting of refractory AML with myelodysplasia-related changes, the possibility of an associated systemic mastocytosis should be evaluated by marrow biopsy mast cell aggregates, serum tryptase and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have fine pink granules and a single multilobated nucleus and are CD61/CD42b positive but tryptase and CD117 negative.
Basophils are small with water-soluble granules obscuring a segmented nucleus and are CD25 and KIT-strong negative; tryptase is at most weak.
Osteoclasts have many separate uniform round nuclei and fine or agranular cytoplasm without metachromatic granules and are tryptase negative.
Macrophages contain heterogeneous ingested material rather than uniform metachromatic granules and are CD68/CD163 positive, CD117 negative.

23525.recognize_zh: A 圖抹片可見數顆大型不典型淋巴球（深藍細胞質、核大）與一顆碎裂細胞，紅血球有聚集成團的傾向；B 圖骨髓切片細胞密度高、被大片瀰漫性單核細胞浸潤取代，符合 DLBCL 侵犯骨髓，並可解釋伴隨的冷凝集素溶血。
features: Smear: large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, high N:C ratio and irregular nuclei (panel A)
Occasional smudged/degenerating cell and small lymphocytes
Red cells in irregular small clumps suggestive of agglutination, with polychromasia
Biopsy: markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheet-like infiltrate replacing normal hematopoiesis (panel B)
Residual fat spaces and a bony trabecula; cytologic detail of the infiltrate limited at this magnification
23525.describe_en: Smear shows several large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and irregular nuclei, admixed with small lymphocytes and a smudged cell. Red cells show irregular clumping suggestive of agglutination. The bone marrow trephine biopsy is markedly hypercellular with a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate that largely replaces normal hematopoiesis; high-power cytology and immunophenotype are not shown. In an HIV-positive patient with cold agglutinin hemolysis and a monoclonal gammopathy, findings are consistent with marrow and blood involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, pending immunohistochemical confirmation.

ddx.dx: Reactive viral lymphocytosis (e.g. EBV, acute HIV)
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous and polyclonal and do not produce diffuse marrow replacement, which requires B-cell marker and clonality studies to confirm lymphoma.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with vacuolated deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a starry-sky biopsy pattern and MYC rearrangement with Ki-67 near 100%.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Plasmablastic cells have eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof and are CD20-negative, CD138/MUM1-positive, often EBER-positive in HIV.
Blasts have fine chromatin with scant cytoplasm and express CD34/TdT or myeloid markers, unlike mature B-cell lymphoma cells.

15141.recognize_zh: A 圖上背部在紅斑背景上散布多顆紅色丘疹與結節，屬皮膚浸潤；B 圖雙眼結膜充血、眼瞼周圍輕度浮腫（conjunctival suffusion / periorbital edema），兩者都是 T 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）常見的臨床表現。
features: A: diffuse erythematous background on the upper back with numerous discrete red papules and dome-shaped nodules of varying size
A: lesions widely distributed and partly confluent, without ulceration
B: bilateral conjunctival injection with mild periorbital/eyelid swelling
Clinical photographs only; no histology shown
15141.describe_en: Composite clinical photographs. Panel A shows the upper back with a diffuse erythematous background studded with numerous discrete red papules and dome-shaped nodules of varying size, without ulceration, consistent with cutaneous leukemic infiltration. Panel B shows bilateral conjunctival injection with mild periorbital swelling. Skin involvement (in roughly a quarter to a third of patients) and conjunctival suffusion/periorbital edema are characteristic extranodal manifestations of T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation depends on peripheral blood morphology, T-cell immunophenotype and TCL1A rearrangement.

ddx.vs: MF evolves through patches and plaques and Sezary syndrome produces generalized erythroderma with CD7/CD26 loss, while T-PLL causes infiltrative papulonodules with a high lymphocyte count and TCL1A rearrangement.
ATLL skin lesions look similar but occur with HTLV-1 positivity, hypercalcemia and CD25+ flower cells.
Myeloid leukemia cutis shows MPO/lysozyme/CD68-positive infiltrates and a blast population in blood, not mature CD4+/CD7+ T cells.
Inflammatory eruptions are usually pruritic macules/papules that resolve and show a non-clonal mixed infiltrate on biopsy.

captions: A: Erythematous papulonodular skin infiltration of the upper back
B: Conjunctival suffusion with periorbital swelling

12645.recognize_zh: 早產新生兒周邊血中出現大量有核紅血球，部分紅母細胞染色質粗塊狀、呈分裂期樣（mitotic figure）排列，背景還有紅血球碎片與多染性紅血球；這是胎兒水腫時骨髓外造血與紅母細胞增多的表現，CMV 病因本身無法由形態判定。
features: Numerous circulating nucleated red cells, from basophilic/polychromatophilic erythroblasts to pyknotic orthochromatic forms
Several large erythroid precursors with coarsely clumped, segmented chromatin suggestive of mitotic figures (main field and insets)
Inset shows a large granulated myeloid cell with purple-red cytoplasmic granules adjacent to an erythroblast
Red cell fragments and irregular crenated forms, with occasional polychromatic macrocytes
No intracellular viral inclusions or organisms are visible
12645.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a premature neonate shows marked erythroblastemia, with nucleated red cells at all stages of maturation, including several large precursors with coarsely condensed, segmented chromatin consistent with circulating mitotic erythroblasts. Red cell fragments and polychromasia are present in the background. An immature granulated myeloid cell is seen in an inset. No viral inclusions are identified; peripheral blood morphology cannot establish the infectious etiology. Findings are consistent with the erythroblastemia of hydrops fetalis, with CMV infection requiring confirmation by PCR or culture.

ddx.dx: Alloimmune hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar with erythroblastemia and polychromasia, but a positive direct antiglobulin test and maternal alloantibody distinguish it from infection-related hydrops.
TAM shows circulating megakaryoblast-like blasts with cytoplasmic blebs and GATA1 mutation rather than mitotic erythroblasts.
Parvovirus causes red cell aplasia with reticulocytopenia and giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions in the marrow, not florid circulating erythroblasts.
Hb Bart hydrops shows hypochromic microcytic red cells with target cells and nucleated RBCs, confirmed by hemoglobin electrophoresis showing Hb Bart.

13093.recognize_zh: 兩個視野中可見明顯大於周圍細胞的大型異型細胞，細胞質深藍、帶空泡與顆粒，核圓或不規則、部分呈雙葉或馬蹄形，成群出現於抹片中，符合間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）侵犯骨髓；需以 CD30、ALK 確認。
features: Large atypical cells, several times the size of red cells, occurring singly and in small clusters
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles and scattered coarse granules
Round to irregular nuclei, including a bilobed/horseshoe-like form, with moderately fine chromatin
Some cells show a perinuclear clear zone and cytoplasmic blebbing
Background of red cells with anisocytosis and occasional small lymphocytes; normal hematopoietic precursors are sparse in these fields
13093.describe_en: Smear (Wright-Giemsa) from the bone marrow shows scattered and loosely clustered large atypical cells in a red-cell-rich background. The cells have abundant, deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm with coarse granules and round to irregular nuclei, including bilobed or horseshoe-shaped forms. Normal trilineage hematopoietic precursors are not well represented in these fields, which may reflect a hemodilute aspirate. Findings are consistent with involvement by a large cell lymphoma, and in the given context are compatible with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry and CD30/ALK immunohistochemistry on the biopsy is required.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts have folded delicate nuclei, grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and are MPO/NSE/CD14-positive rather than CD30/ALK-positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor or carcinoma
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells form cohesive clumps with moulding and are keratin or neuroendocrine marker positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and uniform with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and are CD20/CD10-positive with MYC rearrangement.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1-positive rather than ALK/CD30-driven T-cell phenotype.

3749.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆嗜中性球胞質內布滿粗大、深紫紅色的中毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），核分葉較少（約三葉、葉間較粗），在使用 G-CSF 的病人即為典型的藥物刺激效應。
features: Single neutrophil with cytoplasm densely filled with coarse dark purple-red (toxic) granules
Nucleus with two to three lobes connected by relatively broad bridges (hyposegmented appearance)
Clumped mature chromatin without nucleoli
