No distinct Dohle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles identified in this cell
Background red cells normocytic with some elliptical forms
3749.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with prominent coarse, dark azurophilic cytoplasmic granulation and a nucleus with few lobes joined by broad chromatin bridges. Dohle bodies and cytoplasmic vacuolization are not evident in this cell. Red cells are normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. In a patient receiving granulocyte colony-stimulating factor, findings are consistent with G-CSF effect; infection or sepsis can produce identical toxic granulation and should be clinically excluded.

ddx.dx: Toxic granulation due to sepsis or inflammation
ddx.vs: Sepsis produces morphologically identical granulation, often with vacuolization and Dohle bodies; distinction depends on clinical history of G-CSF administration.
Alder-Reilly granules are large dark inclusions present in all leukocyte types including lymphocytes and monocytes, independent of infection or cytokine therapy.
Chediak-Higashi cells contain a few giant, irregular fused granules rather than numerous uniformly coarse fine-to-medium granules.

exam.answer_en: G-CSF effect — mature neutrophil with coarse toxic-like granulation in a patient receiving G-CSF
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指胞質布滿粗大深紫顆粒的中性球，問「這是什麼變化、可能原因」；G-CSF 效應與敗血症在形態上無法區分，必須靠用藥史。
G-CSF 常見周邊血變化：toxic granulation、Döhle bodies、胞質空泡、明顯 left shift，甚至短暫出現少量 promyelocytes 或母細胞。
骨髓陷阱：化療後以 G-CSF 刺激恢復期，骨髓可出現前骨髓細胞為主的 maturation wave，易誤判為 APL 或復發；短期追蹤可見逐步成熟。
檢驗與副作用：LAP score 上升；臨床副作用以骨痛最常見，罕見但嚴重者為脾臟破裂，應留意左上腹痛。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Alder-Reilly anomaly 或 Chédiak-Higashi：Alder-Reilly 的粗顆粒見於所有白血球且與 mucopolysaccharidosis 相關；Chédiak-Higashi 為少數巨大融合顆粒；G-CSF/毒性顆粒則為均勻分布的粗嗜天青顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球胞質的粗大深紫顆粒叫什麼？除 G-CSF 外最重要需排除的原因為何？
quiz.a: Toxic granulation；感染/敗血症

2341.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一個圓形小體含許多紫色點狀染色質，附在一個淡染、幾近空影的紅血球輪廓上，外觀提示間日瘧（Plasmodium vivax）的分裂體或破裂寄生蟲；但解析度有限，看不到色素與薛夫納氏小點（Schüffner dots），分期無法確定。
features: Compact round parasite-like body smaller than a red cell, containing numerous punctate purple chromatin dots
Associated pale, poorly hemoglobinized ghost-like host cell outline extending from the body
Malarial pigment and Schüffner stippling not clearly resolved at this magnification
Surrounding red cells normocytic without other parasitized cells in the field
Occasional small platelets in background
2341.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a compact round body, smaller than an adjacent red cell, containing numerous punctate purple chromatin dots and associated with a pale, ghost-like host cell outline. The appearance is suggestive of a Plasmodium schizont with multiple merozoites or a parasite released from a lysed red cell. Malarial pigment, Schüffner stippling and host cell enlargement cannot be confidently assessed, and no other parasitized cells are present in this field. Findings are suggestive of, but not by themselves diagnostic of, Plasmodium vivax infection; species confirmation requires review of additional parasite stages on thick and thin films or PCR.

ddx.vs: P. ovale also enlarges red cells with Schüffner dots but produces oval, fimbriated host cells and schizonts with fewer (about 8) merozoites.
Falciparum schizonts are rarely seen in peripheral blood, and the smear typically shows multiple delicate ring forms and banana-shaped gametocytes in normal-sized cells.

ddx.dx: Platelet clump or giant platelet overlying a red cell
ddx.vs: Platelets show granular purple centers without discrete chromatin dots or pigment and lack a surrounding parasitized host cell.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings and tetrads (Maltese cross) without schizonts or pigment.

3109.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆大型細胞具有豐富、圓形、淡灰紫色的胞質，核被推向一側呈腎形或新月形，與周圍的顆粒球及淋巴球相比明顯大很多，符合增生的組織球（reactive histiocytosis）。
features: Several large histiocytes with abundant round, pale gray-lilac, finely granular cytoplasm
Eccentric reniform, crescentic or indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Low N:C ratio; no obvious phagocytosed cells or organisms in the cytoplasm
Background of granulocytic precursors, bands, small lymphocytes and erythroid cells
Linear fiber-like artifact crossing the field
3109.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several large histiocytes with abundant round, pale gray-lilac, finely granular cytoplasm and eccentric reniform to crescentic nuclei. The histiocytes do not contain identifiable phagocytosed hematopoietic cells, organisms or pigment at this magnification. The background contains maturing granulocytic cells, small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors without an increase in blasts, and a linear fiber artifact crosses the field. Findings are consistent with reactive histiocytosis; evaluation for hemophagocytosis, infection, storage disease and systemic inflammatory causes is suggested.

ddx.vs: HLH requires histiocytes containing ingested erythrocytes, platelets or nucleated cells together with clinical criteria, which are not evident here.
Gaucher-type cells have fibrillary 'wrinkled paper' blue-gray cytoplasm rather than homogeneous finely granular pale cytoplasm.
Monoblasts are smaller cells with fine immature chromatin, nucleoli and higher N:C ratio, present in increased numbers.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear atypia and high N:C ratio rather than dispersed bland histiocytes.

2917.recognize_zh: 化療後的組織中出現許多大型細胞，細胞質豐富偏嗜伊紅、核大而圓且有明顯單一核仁，屬於神經節細胞分化（ganglion cell differentiation），散在於梭形許旺細胞（Schwannian）樣纖維基質中，並伴隨含血鐵質巨噬細胞，符合神經母細胞瘤治療後成熟化。
features: Large ganglion-like cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Round, eccentric vesicular nuclei with a single prominent nucleolus
Background of fibrillary stroma with wavy spindle cells (Schwannian-type stroma)
Intermediate maturing neuroblasts with enlarging cytoplasm
Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages (golden-brown pigment) and small vessels, consistent with treatment effect
2917.describe_en: Section shows a fibrillary stroma with wavy spindle cells containing numerous large ganglion-like cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, eccentric vesicular nuclei and single prominent nucleoli, admixed with intermediate maturing neuroblasts. Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and small vessels are present, and undifferentiated small round blue cells and mitotic activity are not prominent in this field. These features represent post-therapy maturation of neuroblastoma with ganglion cell differentiation. Findings are consistent with treated metastatic neuroblastoma showing ganglion cell differentiation; residual viable tumor should still be quantified.

ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; the history of chemotherapy for neuroblastoma and the presence of residual neuroblastic foci distinguish treatment-induced maturation.
Carcinoma cells are cohesive and cytokeratin-positive, lacking Schwannian stroma and synaptophysin/PHOX2B expression.
Megakaryocytes have a lobulated hyperchromatic nucleus without a single prominent nucleolus and are CD61-positive rather than neural marker-positive.
Treated rhabdomyosarcoma shows eosinophilic rhabdomyoblasts with cross-striations and desmin/myogenin expression.

1317.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有數個巨核細胞，細胞核深染、形狀不規則或碎裂成多團，細胞質相對減少，旁邊還有深染、濃縮的核碎片，背景散在造血細胞與脂肪空泡，符合化療後巨核細胞的受損變化（chemotherapy effect）。
features: Several megakaryocytes clustered near fat spaces in a spicule-edge area
Nuclei are hyperchromatic, irregularly lobulated or separated into discrete fragments
Cytoplasm is reduced in some cells, with a naked or near-naked nuclear appearance
Background of mixed maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors with prominent fat vacuoles
Thick, dark-staining crenated red cells indicate a drying/thick-smear artifact
1317.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle edge with interspersed fat vacuoles and mixed hematopoietic precursors. Several megakaryocytes show hyperchromatic, irregular and fragmented nuclear lobes with reduced cytoplasm, a pattern of degenerative change. Interpretation is partly limited by thick areas with dark-staining red cells. In the appropriate clinical context, findings are consistent with cytotoxic chemotherapy effect on megakaryocytes.

ddx.vs: MDS megakaryocytes show separated round nuclear lobes or hypolobation with preserved cytoplasm rather than degenerative condensed, fragmented nuclei, and require no recent therapy history.
Emperipolesis shows intact hematopoietic cells within megakaryocyte cytoplasm, whereas the nuclear fragmentation here is intrinsic to the megakaryocyte.
Megaloblastic megakaryocytes are hypersegmented but accompanied by megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes.

1253.recognize_zh: 一團漿細胞具偏心核與深藍色細胞質，細胞質內滿是紫紅色、細長桿狀的包涵物，形似 Auer 小體；左上方的嗜酸性白血球顆粒是圓形橘紅色，可作為對照，這些是含 Auer rod-like 顆粒的骨髓瘤細胞。
features: Cohesive cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and clumped chromatin
Several nuclei show a small central nucleolus
Abundant deep blue cytoplasm with pale perinuclear zone
Numerous purple-red, slender rod- and needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Auer rods
Adjacent eosinophil with round orange granules and a crenated red cell for comparison
1253.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, small nucleoli and abundant basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasm contains numerous azurophilic, slender rod-shaped inclusions resembling Auer rods; these differ from the round orange granules of the adjacent eosinophil. The cells maintain a plasmacytic configuration without features of myeloblasts. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with Auer rod-like cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts show fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm without perinuclear hof and are MPO-positive, whereas these cells are CD138/light-chain-restricted plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies or Mott cells
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are round, homogeneous pink globules, not slender needle-shaped crystals.
Crystals in CSH accumulate within histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and bland nuclei rather than within plasma cells.

1189.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結可見多個濾泡，外套區小淋巴球呈同心圓排列（onion-skin），中央生發中心萎縮變淡，並有一條玻璃樣變的血管穿入（lollipop 樣），濾泡間血管增生，符合透明血管型 Castleman 病（hyaline-vascular type）。
features: Lymph node with numerous follicles distributed throughout the cortex and medulla
Expanded mantle zones with small lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin layers
Small, regressed (atrophic) pale germinal centers
Hyalinized vessel penetrating a germinal center radially (lollipop appearance)
Increased interfollicular vascularity with hyalinized small vessels
1189.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows numerous follicles with expanded mantle zones in which small lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers around small, regressed germinal centers. A hyalinized vessel penetrates one germinal center, producing a lollipop appearance, and the interfollicular areas are hypervascular. Sinuses are not prominent. Findings are consistent with hyaline-vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have large germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and thin, polarized mantle zones, not regressed centers with onion-skin mantles and penetrating hyalinized vessels.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL expands mantle zones with cyclin D1/SOX11-positive atypical cells without concentric layering or hyalinized penetrating vessels.
HIV lymphadenopathy can show follicle lysis and regressed follicles, but clinical serology and plasmacytosis help distinguish.
Plasma cell variant shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells and less hyalinized vasculature; HHV8 LANA staining identifies HHV8-associated cases.

exam.answer_en: Hyaline-vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease — regressed germinal centers with onion-skin mantle zones and penetrating hyalinized 'lollipop' vessels
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍考官會指著濾泡問「這種外套區排列叫什麼？」答 onion-skin；再指穿入生發中心的血管答 lollipop sign。
Unicentric Castleman disease 多為 hyaline-vascular 型、常見縱膈腔單一腫塊、多無全身症狀，手術切除通常可治癒。
Multicentric Castleman disease 分 HHV8 相關（常見於 HIV，可伴 Kaposi sarcoma）與 idiopathic MCD（iMCD，含 TAFRO 亞型）；IL-6 驅動全身發炎症狀，iMCD 可用 siltuximab。
UCD 可併發 follicular dendritic cell sarcoma，也可合併 paraneoplastic pemphigus；生發中心可出現「twinning」（一個外套區包兩個以上生發中心）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 reactive follicular hyperplasia 的退化期或 HIV 淋巴結病混淆；Castleman 為大量萎縮生發中心、同心圓外套區與玻璃樣穿入血管並存，且臨床常為單一腫塊。

quiz.q: 圖中玻璃樣血管穿入萎縮生發中心的外觀俗稱什麼？此型 Castleman 病最常見的治療是什麼？
quiz.a: Lollipop sign；單發病灶手術切除

1125.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎被單一形態的小到中型母細胞取代，核質比極高、染色質細緻、胞質稀少，正常造血細胞很少，符合復發的淋巴母細胞白血病（T-ALL）。
features: Hypercellular aspirate replaced by monotonous small-to-medium blasts
Very high N:C ratio with scant basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine to slightly condensed chromatin; nucleoli indistinct
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Marked reduction of maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements
1125.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and largely replaced by a monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm, and round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and indistinct nucleoli. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; in a patient with prior T-lymphoblastic leukemia this represents relapse, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (cCD3, TdT, CD7, CD1a) and MRD comparison with the original phenotype.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and require flow cytometry showing CD19, CD79a and CD22 instead of cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts may look similar but express CD13/CD33/CD117 without cCD3; MPO cytochemistry may be negative, so flow is required.
Hematogones show a spectrum of maturation by flow cytometry with no aberrant phenotype, whereas relapsed blasts are phenotypically aberrant.

1061.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有數顆大型細胞聚成一小群，細胞質豐富深藍、核偏心呈卵圓形，細胞質中有一塊離核較遠的淡染區（hof），外形像漿細胞但體積大得多，這是造骨細胞（osteoblasts）。
features: Small cluster of large cells, several times the size of plasma cells
Abundant deep blue cytoplasm with ill-defined, confluent cell borders
Eccentric oval nuclei with fine to reticular chromatin and small nucleoli
Pale cytoplasmic clear zone (Golgi) located away from the nucleus
Surrounding normal granulocytic and erythroid precursors
1061.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small cluster of large cells with abundant deep blue cytoplasm, eccentric oval nuclei with fine reticular chromatin and small nucleoli, and a pale cytoplasmic clear zone separated from the nucleus. Surrounding myeloid and erythroid precursors are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with osteoblasts, a normal marrow constituent that is more common in children and in conditions of active bone formation.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are much smaller with clumped clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof immediately adjacent to the nucleus.
Carcinoma cells show nuclear pleomorphism, molding, prominent nucleoli and cohesive three-dimensional clusters, and are keratin positive.
Plasmablasts have large nucleoli and high N:C ratio and appear as a monoclonal population, confirmed by CD138 and light chain restriction.

exam.answer_en: Osteoblasts — cluster of large plasma cell-like cells with eccentric nuclei and a pale Golgi zone separated from the nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：問「這群是 plasma cells 還是 osteoblasts？」答 osteoblasts：體積遠大於漿細胞、淡染區（Golgi）離核有一段距離、常成群出現。
Osteoblasts 屬正常骨髓成分，兒童、骨折癒合、hyperparathyroidism 或骨轉移等造骨活躍時較常見，常與 osteoclasts 同時出現在抽吸片。
不應計入漿細胞或分類計數；若把 osteoblasts 算成漿細胞會高估漿細胞比例，影響 myeloma 門檻判讀。
必要時可用 CD138 與 kappa/lambda 判斷漿細胞與其 clonality，並與轉移癌（keratin 陽性）區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為漿細胞（或 myeloma/轉移癌細胞團）：漿細胞小、clock-face 染色質、hof 緊貼核旁；轉移癌核多形、有明顯核仁並立體黏聚。

quiz.q: 這群大型、核偏心、有離核淡染區的細胞是什麼？與漿細胞的 hof 位置差在哪？
quiz.a: Osteoblasts；osteoblast 淡染區離核較遠，漿細胞 hof 緊貼核旁

4197.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的漿細胞在細胞核位置上有兩個淡藍色、邊界清楚的圓形包涵體，看起來像疊在核上（核內假包涵體），即 Dutcher body；其他漿細胞也有細胞質內小空泡。
features: Plasma cell (arrow) with eccentric nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm containing two small, round, pale, sharply demarcated inclusions superimposed on the nucleus (Dutcher bodies)
Additional plasma cells with round clear cytoplasmic globules (Russell body-like) and a nuclear pale inclusion in a cell on the right
Mixed background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils), an eosinophil and erythroid precursors
Scattered small lymphocytes; aspirate is cellular
4197.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements and scattered plasma cells. The indicated plasma cell contains two small, round, pale-staining inclusions overlying the nucleus, representing Dutcher bodies (intranuclear cytoplasmic invaginations of immunoglobulin). Other plasma cells show clear round cytoplasmic globules. Dutcher bodies indicate immunoglobulin accumulation and are more often associated with a clonal plasma cell or lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm; correlation with plasma cell quantitation, light-chain restriction and serum protein studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Russell bodies lie within the cytoplasm away from the nucleus, whereas Dutcher bodies project over the nucleus as apparent intranuclear inclusions.
Nucleoli are purple-blue and integral to chromatin, while Dutcher bodies are pale, glassy and sharply outlined.
Vacuoles overlying cytoplasm are clear and do not indent the nuclear outline, unlike the nuclear-superimposed Dutcher body.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell with Dutcher bodies (pale pseudo-intranuclear Ig inclusions) in marrow; favors a clonal plasma cell/lymphoplasmacytic process
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭漿細胞核上的兩個淡色圓形包涵體，要答出 Dutcher body，並與同片其他漿細胞細胞質內的 Russell body 樣小球做對比。
本質：Dutcher body 是含 immunoglobulin 的細胞質內陷入核（pseudo-inclusion），PAS 陽性；Russell body 是撐大的 rough ER 內的 Ig，位於細胞質。
Dutcher bodies 比 Russell bodies 更傾向 clonal 疾病；應安排骨髓漿細胞計數（CD138）、kappa/lambda restriction、SPEP/immunofixation 與 serum free light chain。
若為 IgM paraprotein 合併淋巴漿細胞浸潤，送 MYD88 L265P 支持 lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma；IgG/IgA 則循 myeloma 評估（CRAB/SLiM）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把同片細胞質內的圓形透明小球也叫成 Dutcher body：判斷關鍵在位置——覆蓋在核上的才是 Dutcher body，完全在核外細胞質中的是 Russell body。

quiz.q: 箭頭漿細胞核上的兩個淡色圓形包涵體稱為什麼？與細胞質中的 Russell body 如何區分？
quiz.a: Dutcher bodies；Dutcher body 疊在核上（假核內包涵體），Russell body 位於細胞質

4069.recognize_zh: H&E 組織中瀰漫小到中型淋巴球浸潤，核圓至略不規則、部分可見小核仁，細胞間夾雜大量紅血球，呈紅髓式（red pulp）分布型態，符合 T-PLL 侵犯脾臟或組織；確認需 TCL1 與 T 細胞標記。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; some cells with small visible nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm; high N:C ratio
Abundant interspersed erythrocytes suggesting infiltration of blood-rich (red pulp-like) tissue
No nodular or follicular architecture in this field
4069.describe_en: H&E section shows a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, admixed with abundant erythrocytes in a red pulp-like pattern. No follicular or nodular architecture is identified in the field. Findings are consistent with tissue involvement by a small-to-medium T-cell leukemia such as T-prolymphocytic leukemia; immunohistochemistry for CD3, CD4/CD8, CD7 and TCL1 is needed to confirm.

ddx.vs: HSTL shows sinusoidal/red pulp involvement by medium cells but is TCR gamma-delta, CD4/CD8-negative and TCL1-negative, with isochromosome 7q.
HCL infiltrates red pulp with blood lakes and fried-egg cells with abundant clear cytoplasm, and is a CD20+/annexin A1+ B-cell neoplasm.
CLL involves white pulp nodules with proliferation centers and is a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell neoplasm.

4133.recognize_zh: 脾臟白髓中圍繞一條小動脈的圓形淋巴結節呈棕色免疫染色陽性，周圍紅髓幾乎陰性；這是正常脾臟白髓淋巴球分區的免疫染色，標記名稱圖上未標示。
features: Well-circumscribed round white pulp nodule surrounding a small central arteriole
Dense brown staining in the majority of small lymphocytes within the nodule
Staining appears predominantly nuclear/cytoplasmic in small cells; exact antigen not identified
Staining intensity fades at the nodule periphery with a less-stained outer rim
Surrounding red pulp largely negative with only scattered positive cells
4133.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of spleen shows a well-circumscribed white pulp nodule centered on a small arteriole in which most small lymphocytes are positive, with fading positivity toward the periphery. The surrounding red pulp is largely negative apart from rare scattered positive cells. The antigen is not specified in the image, but the compartmentalized staining confined to the white pulp nodule without red pulp infiltration supports preserved normal splenic lymphoid architecture. Findings are consistent with normal spleen.

ddx.vs: Shows expanded, confluent B-cell nodules with a biphasic pattern and positive cells infiltrating the red pulp cords and sinuses.
Displays positive neoplastic T cells diffusely within red pulp sinuses with atrophic white pulp, the opposite of this distribution.
B-cell marker positive cells diffusely fill the red pulp rather than being restricted to a white pulp nodule.

4005.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量極高，以各成熟階段的顆粒球與核摺疊的單核球系細胞為主，夾雜紅血球系前驅細胞，未見大量母細胞；兒童骨髓骨髓單核球系增生而母細胞未達 20%，符合幼年型骨髓單核球性白血病（JMML）。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate smear with myelomonocytic predominance
Numerous monocytes and promonocyte-like cells with folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation, including myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
Blasts present but not dominant in this field
4005.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power is markedly cellular and shows a myelomonocytic proliferation. Granulocytic precursors are present at all stages of maturation, admixed with numerous monocytes and monocytic precursors with folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm, and scattered erythroid precursors. Blasts are present but do not predominate in this field. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative/myelodysplastic process with monocytic proliferation, supportive of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in a child; a formal differential count is needed to confirm blasts are below 20%.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML shows sheets of monoblasts and promonocytes accounting for at least 20% of cells, rather than maturing granulocytes with monocytes.
CML marrow is similarly hypercellular but shows a granulocytic predominance with basophils and dwarf megakaryocytes, and requires BCR::ABL1.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow granulocytic and monocytic hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia lacks dysplasia and the persistent peripheral monocytosis and genetic abnormalities of JMML; morphology alone may not separate them.

3941.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片在兩條骨小樑之間，箭頭圍出一塊顏色較淡、細胞較鬆散的粉紅區域，由成片的上皮樣組織球構成，和周圍深色的造血細胞明顯不同，這就是骨髓肉芽腫。
features: Well-circumscribed pale eosinophilic nodule between bony trabeculae (arrows)
Nodule composed of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm, admixed lymphocytes
Contrasts with the surrounding darker, cellular hematopoietic marrow and fat spaces
No obvious central necrosis at this magnification
Trabecular bone unremarkable
3941.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) at low power shows a pale, relatively well-circumscribed nodule (arrows) located between bony trabeculae, composed of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and admixed lymphocytes. The surrounding marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with interspersed fat. Central necrosis is not evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with an epithelioid granuloma in the bone marrow; special stains for mycobacteria and fungi plus clinical correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoid aggregates are dark-staining collections of small lymphocytes without pale epithelioid cytoplasm.
Gelatinous transformation shows acellular pale extracellular material with fat atrophy rather than a cellular nodule of histiocytes.
Mast cell lesions are often paratrabecular with spindle cells, eosinophils and fibrosis, and are tryptase/CD117/CD25-positive.

3621.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中病人頭皮下可見多處隆起的圓形腫塊，使頭顱輪廓凹凸不平，配合標題，這些是由顱骨延伸至軟組織的漿細胞瘤腫塊；照片本身無法提供組織學診斷。
features: Clinical photograph of the head in left lateral profile
Multiple rounded, skin-covered subcutaneous masses deforming the contour of the scalp/calvarium
Overlying skin intact without ulceration; sparse short hair (possibly treatment-related alopecia)
Linear scar on the temple
3621.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows the head of an adult patient in lateral profile with multiple rounded, skin-covered masses deforming the contour of the scalp and calvarium; the overlying skin is intact without ulceration. This is a clinical image and does not provide morphologic detail. In combination with the radiographic punched-out skull lesions, the masses are compatible with plasmacytomas extending from bone into soft tissue; tissue biopsy with CD138 and light-chain studies is needed for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Skull metastases can produce similar scalp masses; biopsy distinguishes keratin-positive carcinoma from CD138-positive monotypic plasma cells.
Myeloid sarcoma presents as soft tissue masses but biopsy shows MPO/CD34/CD117 positive myeloid blasts.
Benign scalp lesions are mobile, soft or cystic, and not associated with underlying lytic bone destruction.

3557.recognize_zh: 一群成熟外觀的淋巴球，染色質粗塊狀，但比典型 CLL 細胞大，細胞質較多、淡藍色，邊緣不規則（箭頭），部分核呈卵圓或有輕微凹陷；這種形態多樣的淋巴球提示非典型慢性淋巴球性白血病（atypical CLL）。
features: Clustered lymphocytes that are larger and more heterogeneous than typical small CLL cells
Round to oval nuclei, some slightly indented, with coarsely clumped chromatin; no prominent nucleoli
Moderate to abundant pale-blue cytoplasm with irregular, sometimes ragged borders (arrows)
Occasional cells with lymphoplasmacytoid or cleaved appearance
No smudge cells in this field; RBCs normochromic
3557.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased mature-appearing lymphocytes with morphologic heterogeneity. Many cells are larger than typical CLL cells, with round to oval or slightly indented nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, and moderate amounts of pale-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders (arrows). Prominent nucleoli are not seen, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are suggestive of atypical chronic lymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry (CD5, CD23, CD200, FMC7, light-chain intensity) and cyclin D1/t(11;14) testing are needed to exclude mantle cell and other B-cell lymphomas.

ddx.vs: Mantle cells often have notched nuclei and are CD5+ but CD23-/CD200- with cyclin D1 or SOX11 expression and t(11;14).
SMZL cells have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are usually CD5- and CD23-.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia or CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and moderately condensed chromatin.
Reactive lymphocytes are polyclonal with a mixed T- and B-cell population and abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent RBCs.

3685.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大量小型圓形、核深染、細胞質極少的成熟小淋巴球，數量明顯多於周圍的顆粒球與紅血球前驅細胞；細胞形態一致、成熟，未見芽細胞增加，符合淋巴球增生（lymphoid hyperplasia）的表現。
features: Numerous small round cells with dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, mostly mature small lymphocytes
Lymphoid cells are monomorphic and mature without nucleoli or blast features
Admixed granulocytic precursors at various stages and scattered erythroid precursors
Some small dark cells may represent late normoblasts, which can be difficult to separate at this power
Background red cells with drying artifact; no blasts or atypical large cells identified
3685.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with a conspicuous increase in small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round, dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm. These are admixed with maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors, and some small dark cells likely represent late normoblasts. No blasts, prolymphocytes, or atypical large lymphoid cells are identified. Findings are consistent with a marrow lymphocytosis/lymphoid hyperplasia; flow cytometry and biopsy review are needed to exclude a low-grade lymphoproliferative disorder such as CLL/SLL.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar; separation requires flow cytometry showing a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population.
Hematogones have smoothly homogeneous chromatin and a spectrum of maturation on flow (CD10/CD34/CD20), common in children and post-chemotherapy.
Normoblasts have pinker hemoglobinized cytoplasm and a jet-black pyknotic nucleus, often eccentric.
Lymphoblasts show fine chromatin, nucleoli, and higher N:C ratio rather than mature clumped chromatin.

3365.recognize_zh: 較高倍骨髓抹片中多顆大型組織球，細胞質內充滿大小一致的圓形透明空泡（肥皂泡樣），其中一顆另含棕褐色與藍綠色顆粒狀色素，核小而偏位，符合泡沫狀／含色素組織球的骨髓組織球增多。
features: Several large histiocytes with cytoplasm distended by uniform round clear vacuoles (soap-bubble foam cells)
Upper-left histiocyte with coarse golden-brown pigment and fine blue-green granules among the vacuoles
Small round eccentric nuclei with condensed chromatin
Adjacent erythroid precursors, myelocytes and small lymphocytes appear unremarkable
No engulfed intact blood cells or organisms identified
3365.describe_en: Higher-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows several large histiocytes whose cytoplasm is distended by uniform clear round vacuoles, with small eccentric nuclei. One histiocyte additionally contains coarse golden-brown pigment and fine blue-green granules, consistent with hemosiderin and ceroid. The surrounding erythroid, granulocytic and lymphoid cells appear unremarkable, and no hemophagocytosis or organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with marrow histiocytosis with foamy, lipid- and pigment-laden histiocytes; storage disorders (e.g., Niemann-Pick) and secondary causes should be evaluated clinically and biochemically.

ddx.vs: Niemann-Pick foam cells look identical, so diagnosis requires acid sphingomyelinase assay or NPC gene testing.
Sea-blue histiocytes are dominated by blue-green granular ceroid rather than clear lipid vacuoles.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled cytoplasm without discrete clear vacuoles.
Hemophagocytic histiocytes contain recognizable engulfed red cells, neutrophils or nucleated cells instead of vacuoles.

3429.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見數個中到大型淋巴樣細胞，染色質細緻呈網狀、部分可見核仁，其中一顆有明顯的核中央裂溝（nuclear cleft），細胞質淡藍而少；比一般成熟淋巴球大且不典型，是周邊化濾泡性淋巴瘤的非典型細胞。
features: Intermediate to large lymphoid cells, roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of a red cell
Moderate to high N:C ratio with round, oval or angulated nuclei
Distinct nuclear cleft/groove in at least one cell
Finely reticulated chromatin with small but visible nucleoli in several cells
Scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Background red cells largely normocytic with an occasional echinocyte
3429.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several circulating atypical lymphoid cells in a background of normochromic red cells. The cells are intermediate to large, with moderate to high N:C ratios, round to angulated nuclei, finely reticulated chromatin, small visible nucleoli, and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. One cell displays a distinct nuclear cleft. These cells are larger and have less condensed chromatin than typical small cleaved follicular lymphoma cells. Findings are consistent with peripheral blood involvement by follicular lymphoma with atypical morphology; flow cytometry is recommended to confirm a CD10+ clonal B-cell population and exclude transformation or a blastic process.

ddx.vs: MCL cells can also be irregular and nucleolated, but they are CD5+, CD10-, cyclin D1+, whereas FL cells are CD5-, CD10+.
Blasts have more homogeneous blast chromatin and express TdT/CD34, absent in FL.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and are polyclonal on flow cytometry.
Prolymphocytes have a single central prominent nucleolus and moderately condensed chromatin without clefts, with a CLL/B-PLL immunophenotype lacking CD10.

3237.recognize_zh: 低倍網狀纖維染色下，骨小樑旁的整個造血區域都布滿細密交錯的黑色網狀纖維，把每群細胞框成網格狀，纖維明顯瀰漫增加，符合骨髓纖維化。
features: Diffuse, dense increase in reticulin fibers throughout the intertrabecular space
Fibers form an extensive intersecting meshwork outlining small cell groups
Streaming fiber orientation parallel to the trabecula at the upper center
Residual scattered fat spaces and a dilated sinus
Bony trabecula at right and upper left; megakaryocyte clusters not resolvable at this power
3237.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy stained for reticulin shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections forming a meshwork throughout the intertrabecular marrow, with streaming along the trabecular surface. Scattered fat spaces and a dilated sinus remain. The pattern corresponds to at least MF-2 reticulin fibrosis; megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification or stain and requires the corresponding H&E. Findings are consistent with myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Normal or MF-1 marrow shows a loose network of fine fibers with few intersections, mainly perivascular, rather than a dense diffuse meshwork.
HCL also shows diffuse fine reticulin, but the H&E shows spaced fried-egg lymphoid cells that are CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive.
Metastatic carcinoma causes focal dense fibrosis around keratin-positive tumor nests rather than an even diffuse mesh.

3173.recognize_zh: 腹水細胞離心抹片中大量形態一致的大細胞，胞核偏位、胞質豐富，部分有大空泡擠壓胞核呈印戒樣，胞膜外緣有粉紅色絨毛狀邊，這些不屬於造血細胞，屬於外來（非造血）細胞。
features: Numerous large, discohesive to loosely clustered non-hematopoietic cells, larger than accompanying leukocytes
Round, eccentrically placed nuclei with moderately fine chromatin and a moderate N:C ratio
Abundant gray-purple cytoplasm, some cells with large clear vacuoles indenting the nucleus (signet-ring-like)
Pink fringe of fine surface projections around many cells
Scattered small lymphocytes and neutrophils among the large cells
3173.describe_en: Cytospin of peritoneal fluid shows a large population of monotonous large cells with eccentric round nuclei and abundant gray-purple cytoplasm, many showing large cytoplasmic vacuoles that indent the nucleus. A delicate pink fringe of surface projections is present around many cells. Scattered small lymphocytes and neutrophils are present in the background. These cells are not of hematopoietic origin; the differential includes metastatic adenocarcinoma and reactive mesothelial cells, and correlation with cell block immunohistochemistry (e.g. calretinin, WT1, MOC31, BerEP4, claudin-4) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells are usually fewer, form small groups with 'windows' between cells and are calretinin/WT1 positive and BerEP4/MOC31/claudin-4 negative.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells or plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Plasma cells are smaller with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, and lack large vacuoles and a microvillous fringe.
Histiocytes have kidney-shaped nuclei and foamy phagocytic cytoplasm with ingested debris and are CD68/CD163 positive and keratin negative.
Lymphoma cells are discohesive with scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and are CD45 positive, lacking epithelial markers.

2981.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見許多核呈卵圓或摺疊、染色質淡的大型細胞（組織球樣）夾雜紅血球母細胞、嗜酸性球與出血，偶見分裂相；巨大顆粒在 H&E 切片中無法確認。
features: Numerous large cells with oval to folded vesicular nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (histiocyte-like)
Admixed erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and scattered eosinophils
Occasional mitotic figures
Interstitial hemorrhage with extravasated red cells
Giant granules not discernible on H&E
2981.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow with a mixed infiltrate. Many large cells have oval, folded or indented vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, suggestive of histiocytes, admixed with erythroid precursors, eosinophils, lymphocytes and occasional mitoses in a hemorrhagic background. Cytoplasmic giant granules cannot be resolved on this section. In the context of Chediak-Higashi syndrome, the histiocyte-rich infiltrate raises concern for the accelerated (HLH-like) phase; CD163/CD68 IHC and aspirate correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; absence of giant granules on aspirate plus genetic testing (PRF1, UNC13D, STX11) favors familial HLH over CHS.
LCH cells have grooved coffee-bean nuclei with CD1a/langerin positivity and eosinophil-rich clusters.
Lymphoma cells are cytologically atypical and express B- or T-cell markers rather than CD163.

2853.recognize_zh: 整片單一形態、中大型淋巴樣細胞呈瀰漫性排列，核染色質細而分散、有小核仁，且可見多個核分裂象，符合母細胞樣（blastoid）套細胞淋巴瘤的高增生表現。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-to-large lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed, blast-like chromatin
Small but distinct nucleoli in many cells
Scant pale cytoplasm; high N:C ratio
Numerous mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Occasional small hyalinized vessels; no follicles or starry-sky pattern in this field
2853.describe_en: Sections show effacement by a diffuse, monotonous proliferation of medium-to-large lymphoid cells. The cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Mitotic figures are readily identified and apoptotic bodies are scattered, but a well-developed starry-sky pattern is not seen. Scattered small hyalinized vessels are present. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD5+, cyclin D1+/SOX11+), findings are consistent with blastoid variant of mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive and cyclin D1-negative, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative, surface Ig-positive and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
DLBCL usually has larger cells with vesicular chromatin and more prominent nucleoli and lacks cyclin D1 and t(11;14).
Burkitt shows a starry-sky pattern with squared-off cells and a near-100% Ki-67, and is CD10+/BCL6+, cyclin D1-negative with MYC rearrangement.
Myeloid sarcoma may show eosinophilic myelocytes and is MPO/CD33/CD117-positive and CD20/PAX5-negative.

2789.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間有一個邊界略疏鬆、非貼骨小樑（non-paratrabecular）的小淋巴球聚集，周圍仍保有三系造血與巨核細胞；需搭配免疫染色才能判定是 rituximab 後的 T 細胞增生。
features: Hypercellular-appearing marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis between bony trabeculae
Single non-paratrabecular (interstitial) aggregate of small lymphocytes with somewhat loose, infiltrative borders
Aggregate cells are small with round dark nuclei; no germinal center
Megakaryocytes present in normal numbers with normal-appearing morphology
Small dark cluster at upper right, likely an erythroid island or crush artifact
2789.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows trabecular bone and cellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes. A single interstitial, non-paratrabecular lymphoid aggregate composed of small lymphocytes with slightly ill-defined borders is present; no germinal center or paratrabecular extension is seen. H&E morphology alone cannot determine the lineage of the aggregate. In a patient treated with rituximab, immunostains showing a predominance of CD3+ T cells with absent CD20+ B cells would support rituximab-associated reactive T-cell aggregates rather than residual B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Rituximab can mask CD20, so PAX5, CD79a or CD19 staining is needed; residual lymphoma is B-cell rich and light-chain restricted, whereas reactive aggregates are T-cell predominant.
FL typically forms paratrabecular aggregates of CD10+/BCL2+ B cells.
Ordinary benign aggregates are small, well circumscribed, often contain vessels and have a mixed B/T population, without a rituximab history.
PTCL shows cytologic atypia, loss of pan-T antigens and clonal TCR rearrangement, unlike the small bland T cells of reactive hyperplasia.

2725.recognize_zh: 高倍下一顆母細胞，核大、染色質細緻，細胞質一側聚集數顆粗大的紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），但沒有 Auer 小體；看起來像骨髓母細胞，但若 MPO 陰性且表現 B 細胞標記，就是顆粒型 ALL。
features: Blast about twice the diameter of adjacent red cells, with angular cell outline
High N:C ratio with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin; nucleoli indistinct
Coarse azurophilic (red-purple) granules clustered in the cytoplasm at one pole
Pale blue cytoplasm without Auer rods
No cytoplasmic vacuolation of Burkitt type
2725.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, indistinct nucleoli and pale blue cytoplasm containing a polar cluster of coarse azurophilic granules. Auer rods are not identified. Although the granules raise the possibility of a myeloblast, azurophilic granules occur in a minority of lymphoblastic leukemias. Findings are consistent with granular acute lymphoblastic leukemia provided that the blasts are MPO-negative by cytochemistry and express lymphoid (e.g., B-lineage) antigens by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are MPO/Sudan black positive, may show Auer rods and express myeloid antigens, whereas granular lymphoblasts are MPO-negative.
APL promyelocytes have abundant dense granules, bilobed nuclei and bundles of Auer rods with strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA.
LGLs have mature condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm, not the fine blastic chromatin and high N:C ratio seen here.
BPDCN blasts may have small cytoplasmic vacuoles or pseudopods and are CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+, without B-cell markers.

2597.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片一群中大型母細胞，細胞質中等量偏藍，許多細胞在核旁有明顯淡染的核周空暈（perinuclear hof）並帶少量粉紅色顆粒，另見一顆嗜鹼/嗜酸性顆粒細胞，符合t(8;21)急性骨髓性白血病的母細胞型態。
features: Aggregate of medium to large myeloblasts with moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm
Prominent pale perinuclear hof (paranuclear clearing) indenting the nucleus in many blasts
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Some blasts contain fine pink-orange granules concentrated near the hof
Occasional coarse purple-granulated cell (granulocytic precursor with basophilic/eosinophilic granules) and a maturing neutrophil
Distinct Auer rods not clearly resolved at this resolution
2597.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of medium to large blasts with moderate basophilic cytoplasm, round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli. Many blasts have a conspicuous pale perinuclear hof, and some contain fine pink granules near this clearing. A coarse-granulated granulocytic precursor and a maturing neutrophil are present nearby. Auer rods cannot be confidently identified at this resolution. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation features characteristic of t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1 confirmation by FISH or RT-PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: APL cells have heavy granules obscuring bilobed or reniform nuclei and multiple Auer rods, whereas these blasts are only lightly granulated with a distinct hof.
Inv(16) shows myelomonocytic blasts with abnormal eosinophils bearing large purple-violet granules, while t(8;21) shows hof-bearing blasts with long slender Auer rods; cytogenetics separates them.
Plasma cells also have a perinuclear hof but show eccentric nuclei with clock-face coarse chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm without granules.
Reactive promyelocytes have more abundant azurophilic granules and progressive maturation without a monotonous blast population.

exam.answer_en: AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1 (t(8;21)) — myeloblasts with prominent perinuclear hof, salmon-pink granules and maturing granulocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指母細胞核旁的淡染 hof 與粉紅色顆粒，問最可能的 recurrent genetic abnormality → t(8;21)(q22;q22.1) RUNX1::RUNX1T1。
t(8;21) 母細胞常有細長單根 Auer rod；flow 常見異常表現 CD19、PAX5 與 CD56。
屬 core binding factor AML，整體預後較好；合併 KIT 突變可能較差。治療上 high-dose cytarabine 鞏固，gemtuzumab ozogamicin 對 CBF AML 有益。
WHO 5th 對 AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1 不設 blast 門檻；ICC 2022 要求 blasts ≥ 10%。
治療後以 RUNX1::RUNX1T1 transcript 定量 PCR 追蹤 MRD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 APL 混淆：APL 顆粒濃密遮核、核雙葉並有 faggot cells；t(8;21) 母細胞顆粒較少、有明顯核旁 hof 並伴隨成熟顆粒球。

quiz.q: 圖中母細胞有明顯 perinuclear hof 並伴顆粒球成熟，最可能的染色體異常與融合基因為何？

2533.recognize_zh: 抹片上布滿大小一致的小型成熟淋巴球，核圓深染、染色質粗塊狀、胞質只有一圈細邊，數量遠多於其他白血球，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）的淋巴球增多。
features: Marked increase in small, uniform mature lymphocytes
Round nuclei with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin
Very scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm
No nucleoli evident; occasional slightly larger cells
No other leukocyte lineages seen in this field
2533.describe_en: Smear shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small, uniform mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, dense clumped chromatin and a very scant rim of cytoplasm, set in a red cell background. Nucleoli are not conspicuous and large transformed cells are not increased. Smudge cells are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry demonstrating a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population of at least 5 x 10^9/L is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma shows more pleomorphic, notched nuclei and is CD23-negative, cyclin D1-positive.
Reactive lymphocytosis is polyclonal and transient, with more variable cell size and cytoplasm, and pertussis lymphocytes often have cleaved nuclei in children.
Circulating follicular lymphoma cells are small with deeply cleft (buttock) nuclei and are CD10-positive, CD5-negative.
MBL has an identical CLL phenotype but a clonal B-cell count below 5 x 10^9/L without tissue involvement, which morphology alone cannot distinguish.

exam.answer_en: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia — marked lymphocytosis of small uniform mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「還要什麼才能診斷 CLL」→ flow 證實單株 CD5+/CD23+ B 細胞，且 clonal B cells ≥ 5 × 10^9/L。
若單株 B 細胞 < 5 × 10^9/L 且無淋巴結、器官侵犯或血球減少，屬 monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis（MBL）；有淋巴結病灶則為 SLL。
Smudge cells（本圖不明顯）常見於 CLL；製片前加 albumin 可減少破碎以利計數。
Rai（0–IV）與 Binet（A–C）分期；治療前檢驗 del(17p)／TP53 與 IGHV 突變狀態，選擇 BTK inhibitor 或 venetoclax 為主的療程。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 reactive lymphocytosis 或 leukemic follicular lymphoma 混淆：反應性為多株、大小不一；FL 細胞有深裂縫核且 CD10+、CD5−。

quiz.q: 圖中小型成熟淋巴球增多，診斷 CLL 所需的單株 B 細胞絕對數門檻為何？
quiz.a: Clonal B cells ≥ 5 × 10^9/L（持續），flow 證實 CD5+/CD23+

2405.recognize_zh: 在正常成熟中的骨髓細胞背景裡，中央有一顆特別巨大的細胞，細胞質深藍、豐富，核圓而偏位、染色質較細，體積遠大於周圍骨髓細胞，這是多發性骨髓瘤中的大型（不成熟）漿細胞。
features: Single very large cell, several times the size of surrounding myelocytes
Round, slightly eccentric nucleus with relatively fine chromatin; nucleolus not clearly visible
Abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and faint paranuclear pale zone
Background of normal trilineage maturation: neutrophil precursors, band forms, erythroid precursors, eosinophils
Large fat vacuole adjacent to the cell
2405.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a background of maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors with a single conspicuous very large cell. This cell has abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a round, slightly eccentric nucleus with relatively fine chromatin, and a vague paranuclear clearing, consistent with a large atypical (immature) plasma cell. A single cell is insufficient for diagnosis; the plasma cell percentage, clonality by flow cytometry or kappa/lambda staining, and correlation with serum/urine M-protein are required. Findings are compatible with plasma cell myeloma with large atypical plasma cells in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts occur in clusters, have an eccentric nucleus with a hof located away from the nucleus, and are CD138-negative/CD56-variable without light chain restriction.
Immature megakaryocytes show cytoplasmic blebs, a higher N:C ratio and are CD61/CD42b positive rather than CD138 positive.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with vacuolated cytoplasm and are cytokeratin positive, lacking plasma cell features.
Plasmablastic lymphoma presents as sheets of immunoblastic cells, often EBER positive in HIV patients, without the osteolytic/M-protein myeloma context.

2149.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見大量成熟單核球與前單核球（promonocyte）：核呈折疊、腎形或分葉，染色質細緻，胞質灰藍並有細小顆粒與空泡，與骨髓細胞、帶狀嗜中性球混雜，是 CMML 單核球系增生的典型樣貌。
features: Numerous monocytes and promonocytes with folded, reniform, or lobulated nuclei
Fine to lacy chromatin with occasional indistinct nucleoli in promonocytes
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and scattered vacuoles
Admixed granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Occasional small lymphocyte; blasts not predominant
2149.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a mixed population dominated by monocytes and promonocytes with folded, reniform, or lobulated nuclei, fine chromatin, and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and occasional vacuoles. Granulocytic precursors including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and bands are admixed. Blasts are not predominant in this field. Findings are consistent with a myelomonocytic proliferation, supporting chronic myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and peripheral blood context; promonocytes must be counted as blast equivalents.

ddx.vs: Requires ≥20% blasts including promonocytes; mature-appearing monocytes with condensed, folded nuclei (as many here) are not counted as blast equivalents.
Reactive monocytes lack associated dysplasia and clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities.
aCML is dominated by dysplastic granulocytes with few monocytes, unlike this monocyte-rich field.
JMML is a pediatric disease with RAS-pathway mutations and elevated HbF, distinguished clinically rather than by marrow morphology.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia — marrow rich in monocytes and promonocytes admixed with maturing granulocytes, blasts not predominant
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核摺疊的單核球系細胞，問「哪些算 blast equivalent？」答 promonocytes（染色質細緻），成熟單核球不算；決定 CMML 與 AML 的界線。
WHO 5th/ICC 2022：持續 PB 單核球 ≥0.5×10⁹/L 且 ≥10% WBC、blasts（含 promonocytes）<20%、排除 BCR::ABL1 與其他 MPN。
分級：CMML-1 為 PB blasts <5% 且 BM <10%；CMML-2 為 PB 5–19% 或 BM 10–19%；WBC ≥13×10⁹/L 為 MP-CMML，否則 MD-CMML。
分子：TET2、SRSF2、ASXL1 常見（TET2 合併 SRSF2 高度提示）；flow 上 classical monocytes（CD14+CD16−）比例增加可支持診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把成熟但核摺疊的單核球誤算為 promonocyte，造成高估芽細胞而誤診為急性單核球性白血病；promonocyte 染色質細緻、核仁可見，成熟單核球染色質較濃縮。

quiz.q: 圖中單核球系細胞中，計算芽細胞比例時哪一種應被算入 blast equivalent？
quiz.a: Promonocytes（與 monoblasts）

1957.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內有數個邊界模糊、淡染的結節狀區域，周圍是較深染的淋巴球，中間穿插粉紅色纖維血管帶；結節輪廓不清、缺乏清楚的套膜區，與典型反應性濾泡不同，是 AITL 可見的模糊結節型態。
features: Vaguely nodular, ill-defined pale-staining areas separated by darker lymphocyte-rich zones
Nodules lack sharp borders and well-formed mantle zones
Branching eosinophilic fibrovascular bands traversing the center of the field
A dilated vascular space at left and a vessel at the right edge
Cytologic detail not resolvable at this magnification
1957.describe_en: Low-power lymph node section shows effacement of the normal architecture by vaguely nodular, ill-defined pale-staining areas alternating with darker lymphocyte-rich zones and traversed by branching eosinophilic fibrovascular bands. Well-formed follicles with distinct mantle zones are not identified. Cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context (PD-1, CXCL13, CD10 and expanded CD21-positive FDC meshworks), findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back, crowded, well-defined neoplastic follicles composed of centrocytes and centroblasts with BCL2-positive germinal centers.
NLPHL shows large expansile nodules containing scattered CD20-positive LP cells rimmed by PD-1-positive T cells, rather than diffuse TFH-derived neoplastic T cells.
Reactive nodes show well-demarcated follicles with polarized germinal centers and intact mantles and lack clonal TFH T cells.

1765.recognize_zh: 組織切片中成片的大型腫瘤細胞，細胞質豐富淡嗜酸性，多顆細胞核呈腎形或馬蹄形並有明顯核仁（hallmark cells），可見核分裂，是間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）的典型形態。
features: Sheets of large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Eccentric kidney-shaped, horseshoe, and reniform nuclei (hallmark cells)
Vesicular chromatin with one or more prominent eosinophilic to basophilic nucleoli
Multilobated and pleomorphic nuclei with a mitotic figure present
Cohesive growth pattern that can mimic carcinoma; no well-defined background small lymphocytes in this field
1765.describe_en: Tissue section shows sheets of large, cohesive-appearing neoplastic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders. Nuclei are pleomorphic, with many eccentric horseshoe- or kidney-shaped forms (hallmark cells), vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli; mitoses are present. The cohesive pattern may mimic carcinoma or melanoma. Findings are suggestive of anaplastic large cell lymphoma; confirmation with CD30, ALK, T-cell markers, EMA, and keratin immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma may look similarly cohesive but is keratin positive and CD30/ALK negative, and lacks horseshoe-shaped hallmark nuclei.
Hodgkin lymphoma has scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than sheets of hallmark cells, and is PAX5 weakly positive and ALK negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: Anaplastic DLBCL can be morphologically identical and is separated by expression of CD20 and PAX5 with ALK negativity.
Melanoma shows macronucleoli and may have pigment, and is SOX10 and S100 positive rather than CD30 and ALK positive.

exam.answer_en: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma — cohesive sheets of large pleomorphic cells with horseshoe/kidney-shaped hallmark nuclei and prominent nucleoli
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指馬蹄形或腎形偏位核的大細胞問「這叫什麼細胞？」答 hallmark cell，核旁常有嗜伊紅 Golgi 區，是 ALCL 的診斷線索。
IHC 組合：CD30 強而均一（膜 + Golgi）、ALK（區分 ALK+/ALK−）、EMA 常陽性、cytotoxic markers（TIA-1、granzyme B、perforin）陽性，常失去多個 T 細胞抗原（CD3 常陰性）；keratin 陰性。
ALK+ ALCL 多為 t(2;5)(p23;q35) NPM1::ALK，好發年輕人，預後優於 ALK− ALCL；ALK− ALCL 中 DUSP22 重組者預後較好、TP63 重組者較差。
治療：CD30 為標靶，brentuximab vedotin（anti-CD30 ADC）合併 CHP 為一線選項之一。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤診為轉移性低分化癌或黑色素瘤（黏聚生長、竇內浸潤）；需以 keratin、S100/SOX10 與 CD30、ALK、CD45 IHC 區分，ALCL 甚至可 CD45 弱或陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中馬蹄形偏位核的大細胞叫什麼？確診 ALCL 最關鍵的兩個 IHC 是哪些？
quiz.a: Hallmark cell；CD30（強而均一）與 ALK。

1701.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全為中至大型母細胞，核圓或卵圓、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質少量淡藍無顆粒；箭頭指一顆較大、細胞質稍多的母細胞，型態無法分辨系別。
features: Sheet of medium-to-large blasts replacing normal marrow elements
High N:C ratio with round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Arrow highlights a larger blast with slightly more abundant cytoplasm
Background with rare red cells and few mature cells
1701.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a near-total replacement by a population of medium-to-large blasts. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli, and scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm; one larger blast (arrow) has more abundant cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not identified, and residual maturing hematopoiesis is scant. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia; lineage assignment, including mixed-phenotype acute leukemia, requires flow cytometry and cytochemistry.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; it lacks MPO and monocytic markers by flow cytometry.
Also agranular without Auer rods; blasts express CD13/CD33/CD117 without B- or T-lineage-defining antigens and have MPO below 3% by cytochemistry.
Monoblasts have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and nonspecific esterase positivity, unlike the scant cytoplasm here.

1637.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 脾臟：紅髓背景中有數個白髓，每個白髓中央有小動脈（central arteriole）橫切面，周圍是深藍色的動脈周圍淋巴鞘（PALS）/濾泡，外層再圍一圈較淡的邊緣區（marginal zone）；右上角為被膜/小樑。
features: Splenic parenchyma with congested red pulp forming the background
Several white pulp nodules each centered on a central arteriole
Dark periarteriolar lymphoid sheath/follicle immediately around the arterioles
Paler, broader marginal zone surrounding the dark inner white pulp
Fibrous trabecula/capsule at the upper right; a trabecular fragment within one nodule
1637.describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows red pulp surrounding several white pulp nodules. Each nodule contains a central arteriole encircled by a dark-staining periarteriolar lymphoid sheath or follicle, which is in turn surrounded by a paler marginal zone. A fibrous trabecula and capsule are present at the upper right. The white pulp is not expanded or confluent, and the red pulp shows no nodular infiltrate at this magnification. Findings are consistent with normal splenic architecture.

ddx.vs: Shows enlarged, confluent white pulp nodules with a biphasic pattern and expanded marginal zones of monocytoid B cells infiltrating the red pulp.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia of the spleen
ddx.vs: Shows enlarged white pulp with prominent germinal centers, still with preserved compartments.
Diffusely infiltrates and expands the red pulp with blood lakes while atrophying the white pulp, unlike the preserved architecture here.

1573.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中數個紅血球胞質內布滿粗大、均勻分散的藍紫色顆粒，即嗜鹼性點彩（basophilic stippling），背景並有橢圓形及淚滴狀紅血球；在溶血性貧血脈絡下需想到 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase 缺乏症或鉛中毒。
features: Several red cells with coarse, evenly distributed basophilic punctate granules (basophilic stippling)
Stippled cells are normal-sized to slightly large with retained central pallor in some
Background poikilocytosis with ovalocytes/elliptocytes and occasional teardrop cells
A red cell fragment and scattered platelets present
No nucleated red cells or leukocytes in this field
1573.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several red cells with coarse, diffusely distributed basophilic stippling. The background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes, occasional teardrop forms and a small fragment. Platelets are present and no nucleated red cells are seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of a hemolytic process with prominent basophilic stippling, such as pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency, lead poisoning or a thalassemic disorder; correlation with enzyme assay, blood lead level and hemoglobin studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are few, clustered at the cell periphery and Prussian blue-positive, whereas basophilic stippling is diffuse, numerous and iron-negative ribosomal RNA.
Morphology is similar and requires blood lead level and clinical history, though lead poisoning is often microcytic with ring sideroblasts in the marrow.
Thalassemia shows marked microcytosis, target cells and hypochromia with elevated HbA2 on hemoglobin analysis.
Schuffner dots accompany an intracellular parasite in enlarged cells, and a ring or trophozoite should be identifiable.

exam.answer_en: Basophilic stippling in hemolytic anemia — coarse blue-purple granules evenly dispersed in RBCs (consider P5'N deficiency or lead)
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球內均勻分布的藍點問名稱與成分；basophilic stippling 為聚集的 ribosome（RNA），Prussian blue 陰性。
粗大 stippling 常見三大原因：lead poisoning、pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase 缺乏（NT5C3A，隱性遺傳溶血）、thalassemia；也見於 megaloblastic anemia。
鉛中毒：抑制 ALA dehydratase 與 P5'N，zinc protoporphyrin 上升，骨髓可見 ring sideroblasts；臨床有腹痛、神經病變，應驗血鉛。
P5'N 缺乏時紅血球內 pyrimidine nucleotides 堆積而無法分解 RNA，可測紅血球 P5'N 活性確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Pappenheimer bodies；後者數量少、成簇偏在細胞邊緣且含鐵（Prussian blue 陽性），stippling 則均勻分布且鐵染色陰性。

quiz.q: 紅血球內這些均勻藍紫點是什麼？其成分為何？
quiz.a: Basophilic stippling；聚集的 ribosomes（RNA）

101.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中許多紅血球的中央淡染區呈狹長裂縫狀（口形紅血球，stomatocyte），並混有少數緻密小紅血球；網狀紅血球染色可見網狀紅血球增加；NGS 顯示 ABCG8 同合子變異，符合地中海型口形紅血球症／巨血小板症（sitosterolemia）。
features: Numerous stomatocytes with slit-like (mouth-shaped) central pallor
Occasional small dense, spherocyte-like red cells and mild anisocytosis, including a large oval red cell
Platelets appear reduced; true platelet size is difficult to judge at this magnification
Supravital stain shows increased reticulocytes with granular-reticular RNA precipitate
NGS read alignment (IGV) and Sanger chromatogram show a homozygous C>A substitution in ABCG8, converting a serine codon (TCA) to a stop codon (TAA)
101.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate anisocytosis with numerous stomatocytes showing slit-like central pallor, occasional small dense spherocyte-like cells, and a scattered large oval red cell; no schistocytes or target-cell predominance is seen. Platelets are few in the fields shown. A supravital reticulocyte preparation shows increased reticulocytes, consistent with ongoing hemolysis. Next-generation sequencing reads and confirmatory Sanger sequencing show a homozygous C>A variant in ABCG8 predicted to create a premature stop codon (serine to termination). Findings are consistent with Mediterranean stomatocytosis/macrothrombocytopenia, the hematologic manifestation of sitosterolemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology can be similar, but OHSt shows high MCV with low MCHC, increased osmotic fragility and a normal platelet count, and is confirmed by RHAG rather than ABCG5/ABCG8 variants.
Xerocytosis has few stomatocytes, target and desiccated cells with raised MCHC and decreased osmotic fragility on ektacytometry, without macrothrombocytopenia, and carries PIEZO1 or KCNN4 variants.
HS shows round spherocytes lacking any central pallor rather than slit-like pallor, and an abnormal EMA binding test, which was normal here.
Artifactual stomatocytes are confined to thick smear areas and acquired forms follow alcohol or liver disease, without lifelong hemolysis, thrombocytopenia or a biallelic ABCG8 variant.

captions: Peripheral blood smears (A, B) showing stomatocytes with slit-like central pallor and a few dense cells; supravital stain (C) showing increased reticulocytes
IGV view of NGS reads (A) and Sanger chromatogram (B) showing a homozygous C>A nonsense variant in ABCG8

37.recognize_zh: 周邊血液白血球大增，從骨髓細胞（myelocyte）到分節嗜中性球各階段都有，並夾雜嗜鹼性球；骨髓抹片極度富細胞、以顆粒球系為主，可見 pseudo-Gaucher 組織球；染色體有 t(9;22) 箭頭，FISH 出現 BCR::ABL1 融合訊號，符合慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）；後幾張出現成群芽細胞，代表芽細胞期（blast phase）。
features: Peripheral blood leukocytosis with a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) and a myelocyte/segmented neutrophil 'bimodal' predominance
Absolute basophilia with scattered eosinophils; blasts are not increased in the chronic-phase fields
Markedly hypercellular marrow aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors with left-shifted but orderly maturation and few erythroid precursors
Pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes with abundant pale blue, finely fibrillar cytoplasm and a small eccentric round nucleus

G-banded karyotype with arrows on chromosomes 9 and 22 marking t(9;22)(q34;q11.2); dual-color dual-fusion FISH shows 1 red, 1 green and 2 yellow fusion signals in abnormal nuclei versus 2 red/2 green in normal nuclei
Separate blood and marrow fields show sheets and clusters of large blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with basophils, consistent with blast phase
37.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation, predominantly myelocytes and segmented neutrophils, accompanied by basophilia and occasional eosinophils; blasts are not increased in these fields. The bone marrow aspirate is markedly hypercellular with granulocytic predominance and orderly maturation, and contains scattered pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes with fibrillar blue cytoplasm. G-banded karyotype demonstrates t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) (Philadelphia chromosome), and interphase FISH with a BCR/ABL1 dual-color dual-fusion probe shows the typical 1R1G2F positive pattern. Additional blood and marrow images show clusters and sheets of large blasts with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm among basophils, indicating blast transformation; whether these represent the same time point as the chronic-phase smears cannot be determined from the images. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, including images of blast phase.

ddx.vs: A leukemoid reaction shows mostly bands and segmented neutrophils with toxic granulation, few myelocytes and no basophilia, and is BCR::ABL1 negative.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis without significant basophilia and lacks t(9;22)/BCR::ABL1.
CNL consists of mature segmented neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes, no basophilia and a CSF3R mutation rather than BCR::ABL1.

For the blast-phase images, de novo Ph+ AML/ALL lacks a preceding chronic phase, marked basophilia and splenomegaly, and often carries the p190 (minor bcr) transcript; morphology alone cannot separate them.

Bone marrow aspirate: granulocytic precursors with orderly maturation, basophil and myelocytes

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive — granulocytic leukocytosis with basophilia, t(9;22) and BCR::ABL1 dual-fusion FISH; blast phase fields
pearls_zh: 考法：血片問 myelocyte 與 segmented neutrophil 雙峰及嗜鹼性球增多；核型圖問箭頭 t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)；FISH 讀出異常核 1R1G2F。
確診需 BCR::ABL1（核型、FISH 或 RT-PCR）；治療反應以 RQ-PCR International Scale 追蹤，MMR 為 ≤0.1% IS。
Pseudo-Gaucher 細胞與 sea-blue histiocyte 反映高細胞週轉，並非 Gaucher disease；LAP score 低。
WHO 5th 取消 accelerated phase，只分 chronic 與 blast phase（blasts ≥20%、髓外芽細胞增生或 lymphoblasts 增加）；ICC 2022 仍保留 accelerated phase。
一線治療為 TKI（imatinib、dasatinib、nilotinib 等）；blast phase 需依 lymphoid/myeloid 譜系合併化療並考慮 allo-HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤當 leukemoid reaction；CML 有嗜鹼性球增多、myelocyte 峰、無毒性顆粒且 LAP 低，最終以 BCR::ABL1 確認。

quiz.q: BCR/ABL1 dual-fusion FISH 正常核為 2R2G，本例異常核訊號型態與意義？
quiz.a: 1R1G2F；BCR::ABL1 融合陽性（t(9;22)）

3045.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織被一群黏合成巢的上皮樣大細胞取代，核呈卵圓、染色質空泡狀、有明顯核仁，細胞質嗜酸性，周圍有纖維增生（desmoplastic）間質；這是轉移性攝護腺癌（prostatic carcinoma）侵犯骨髓的表現。
features: Cohesive nests and cords of large epithelioid tumor cells replacing marrow elements
Oval, vesicular nuclei with distinct, often single prominent nucleoli
Moderate amounts of eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Nuclear pleomorphism with hyperchromatic crushed/spindled nuclei at the edges
Loose fibrotic (desmoplastic) stroma surrounding the tumor nests; no residual hematopoiesis in this field
3045.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows replacement of hematopoietic tissue by cohesive nests and cords of large epithelioid cells set in a desmoplastic stroma. The tumor cells have moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli and moderate pleomorphism. No residual hematopoietic elements are present in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; in the clinical context, immunohistochemistry for NKX3.1, PSA, and PSMA would confirm prostatic origin.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma of other origin (breast, lung, kidney)
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; separated by GATA3/ER, TTF-1, or PAX8 immunostaining versus NKX3.1/PSA in prostate carcinoma.
May form cohesive-appearing sheets but is keratin negative and CD30/ALK positive.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and are CD61/CD42b positive, whereas carcinoma is keratin positive and forms cohesive nests.
Also shows prominent nucleoli but is keratin negative and S100/SOX10 positive.
